Exodus 28:24 & put the .ii. wrethen cheynes of gold in the .ij. rynges which are in the edges of the brestlappe.
Exodus 28:25 And the .ii. endes of the .ij. cheyns thou shalte fasten in the .ij. rynges, and put them vpon the shoulders of the Ephode on the foresyde of it.
Exodus 28:26 And thou shal yet make .ij. rynges of golde, and put them in the .ij. edges of the brestlappe euen in the borders therof towarde the insyde of the Ephod that is ouer agaynst it.
Exodus 28:27 And yet .ij. other rynges of golde thou shalt make, & put them on the .ij. sides of the Ephod, beneth ouer agaynste the brestlappe alowe where the sydes are ioyned together vpon the bordered gyrdel of the Ephod.
Exodus 28:28 And they shall bynde the brestlappe by hys ringes vnto the ringes of the Ephod with a lace of Iacyncte, that it maye lye close vnto the brodered gyrdell of the Ephod, that the brestlappe be not loosed from the Ephod.
Exodus 28:29 And Aaron shal beare the names of the chyldren of Israel in the brestlappe of iudgement vpon hys hert, when he goeth into the holy place for a remembraunce before the Lorde alwaye.
Exodus 28:30 And thou shalt put in the brestlappe of iudgement Vrim & Thumim: that they be euen vpon Aarons hert when he goeth in before the Lord & Aaron shall beare the ensample of the chyldren of Israell vpon his herte before the Lorde alwaye.
Exodus 28:31 And thou shalt make the tunycle vnto the Ephod altogether of Iacyncte.
Exodus 28:32 And there shalbe an hole for the head in the middes of it, and let there be a bonde of wouen worke rounde aboute the coller of it (as it were the coller of a partlet) that it rent not.
Exodus 28:33 And beneth vpon the hemme, thou shalt make pomgranates of Iacyncte, of scarlette, and of purpull rounde about the hemme,

Exodus 28:35 And Aaron shal haue it vpon him when he ministreth, that the sounde may be herde when he goeth into the holy place before the Lorde and when he cometh out, that he dye not.
Exodus 28:36 And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold and graue theron (as signettes are grauen) The holynes of the Lord,
Exodus 28:37 & put it on a lace of Iacyncte & tye it vnto the mytre, vpon the forefront of it,
Exodus 28:38 that it be vppon Aarons forehead: that Aaron beare the sinne of the holy thinges whiche the chyldren of Israell haue halowed in al their holy giftes. And it shalbe alwayes vppon Aarons forehead, that they maye be accepted before the Lord.
Exodus 28:39 And thou shalt make an albe of bysse, and thou shalt make a mytre of bysse & a gyrdell of nedle worde.
Exodus 28:40 And thou shalt make for Aarons sonnes also cotes, gyrdels and bonettes honourable and glorious,
Exodus 28:41 and thou shalt put them vppon Aaron thy brother and on hys sonnes wyth him & shalt anoynte them & fill their handes and consecrate them that they may ministre vnto me.
Exodus 28:42 And thou shalte make them lynnen breches too couer their preuityes: from the loynes vnto the thyes shall they reach.
Exodus 28:43 And they shalbe vpon Aaron & his sonnes, when they go into the tabernacle of witnesse, or when they go vnto the aultare to ministre in holynes, that they beare no sinne and so dye. And it shalbe a lawe for euer vnto Aaron & his sede after hym.

CHAPTER: 29

Exodus 29:1 This is the thing that thou shalt do vnto them when thou halowest theym to be my priestes. Take one oxe & two rammes that are without blemysh,
Exodus 29:2 and vnleuended bread and cakes of swete bread tempered with oyle & wafers of swete bread anoynted with oyle (of wheten floure shalte thou make them)
Exodus 29:3 & put them in a maunde and bringe them in the maunde with the oxe and the .ij. rammes.
Exodus 29:4 And bryng Aaron & his sonnes vnto the dore of the tabernacle of witnesse, & wash theym with water,
Exodus 29:5 & take the garmentes, & put vpon Aaron: the strayte coote, & the tunycle of the Ephod, & the Ephod & the brestlappe: & gyrd them to him with the brodered gyrdel of the Ephod.
Exodus 29:6 And put the mytre vpon his head & put the holy croune vpon the mytre.
Exodus 29:7 Then take the anoynting oyle & poure it vpon his head & anoynte hym.
Exodus 29:8 And bring his sonnes & put albes vpon them,
Exodus 29:9 & gyrd them with gyrdels: as well Aaron as his sonnes. And put the bonettes on them that the priestes office maye be theirs for a perpetuall lawe. And fyl the handes of Aaron and of hys sonnes,
Exodus 29:10 and brynge the oxe before the tabernacle of witnesse. And let Aaron and hys sonnes put their handes vpon hys head
Exodus 29:11 & kyl hym before the Lord in the dore of the tabernacle of wytnesse.
Exodus 29:12 And take of the bloude of the oxe and put it vpon the hornes of the alter with thy finger & poure all the bloude vpon the botome of the aulter,
Exodus 29:13 and take all the fat that couereth the inwardes, & the kal that is on the lyuer and the .ij. kydneys with the fat that is vpon them: and burne them vpon the aulter:
Exodus 29:14 But the flesh of the oxe & hys skynne and hys donge shalte thou burne wyth fyre without the host. For it is a synne offerynge.
Exodus 29:15 Then take one of the rammes, & let Aaron & hys sonnes put their handes vpon the head of the ramme,
Exodus 29:16 and cause him to be slaine, and take of hys bloude and sprenkell it rounde aboute vpon the alter,
Exodus 29:17 and cutt the ramme in peces and wash the inwardes of hym and hys legges, and put them vnto the peces and vnto his head,
Exodus 29:18 and burne the hole ram vpon the alter. For it is a burnt offeryng vnto the Lorde, and a swete sauoure of the Lordes sacryfyce.
Exodus 29:19 And take the other ram and let Aaron and his sonnes, put their handes vpon hys head
Exodus 29:20 and lett him than be kylled. And take of hys bloude and put it vpon the tippe of the right eare of Aaron and of hys sonnes, and vpon the thombe of their ryghte handes and vpon the greate too of their ryghte fete and sprenkel the bloude vpon the aulter round abonte.
Exodus 29:21 Then take of the bloude that is vpon the alter and of the anoyntynge oyle, and sprenkell it vpon Aaron and his veltimentes, and vpon his sonnes and vpon their garmentes also. Then is he and his clothes holy and his sonnes and their clothes holye also.
Exodus 29:22 Then take the fatte of the ramme and his rompe and the fat that couereth the inwardes and the kall of the lyuer and the two kidneis and the fat that is vpon them and the ryghte shoulder (for that ram is a fulloffring)
Exodus 29:23 and a symnell of bread, and a cake of oyled breade and a wafer out of the basket of swete bread that is before the Lord,
Exodus 29:24 and put all vpon the handes of Aaron and on the handes of hys sonnes: and waue them in and out, a waueoffrynge vnto the Lorde.
Exodus 29:25 Then take it from of their handes and burne it vpon the alter: euen vpon the burnteofferynge, to be a sauoure of swetnesse before the Lorde. For it is sacryface vnto the Lord.
Exodus 29:26 Then take the brest of the ramme that is Aarons ful offring and waue if a waueoffring before the Lorde, and lette that be thy part.
Exodus 29:27 And sanctify the brest of the waueoffrynge and the shoulder of the heueoffrynge whyche is waued and heued vp of the ram which is the fulloffringe of Aaron and of his sonnes.
Exodus 29:28 And it shalbe Aarons and his sonnes dutye for euer, of the chyldren of Israel, for it is an heueoffeynge. And the heueoffrynge shalbe the Lordes dutye of the children of Israell: euen of the sacrifyce of their peaceofferynges whyche they heue vnto the Lorde.
Exodus 29:29 And the holye garmentes of Aaron shalbe hys sonnes after hym, to anoint them therin, and to fyll to their handes therin.
Exodus 29:30 And that sonne that is priest in his stede after him shall put them on seuen dayes: that he go into the tabernacle of wytnesse, to mynyster in the holy place.
Exodus 29:31 Then take the ram that is the fuloffrynge and seth his flesh in an holy place.
Exodus 29:32 And Aron and his sonnes shall eate the flesh of hym, & the braede that is in the baskette: euen in the dore of the tabernacle of wytnesse.
Exodus 29:33 And they shall eate them because the attonement was made therwyth to fyll their handes & to sanctify them: but a straunger shall not eate therof because they are holy.
Exodus 29:34 If oughte of the flesh of the ful offeringes or of the bred remayne vnto the mornynge, thou shalt burne it wyth fyre: for it shall not be eaten, because it is holye.
Exodus 29:35 And se thou do vnto Aaron and his sonnes, euen so in al thinges as I haue commaunded the: that thou fyll their handes seuen dayes
Exodus 29:36 and offer euery day an oxe for a sinne offring for to reconcyle wyth al. And thou shalt halow the alter when thou reconcylest it, and shalt anoynte it to sanctyfy it.
Exodus 29:37 Seuen dayes thou shalte reconcile the alter and sanctyfye it, that it may be an alter most holy: so the no man may touch it but thei that be consecrate.
Exodus 29:38 This is that which thou shalt offer vpon the alter .ij. lambes of one yere olde, daye by daye for euer,
Exodus 29:39 the one thou shalte offer in the mornynge and the other at euen.
Exodus 29:40 And vnto the one lambe take a tenthe deale of floure mingled wt the fourth parte of an hinne of beten oyle, & the fourth parte of an hinne of wyne for a drynckeofferyng,
Exodus 29:41 And the other lambe thou shalt offer at euen and shalte doo therto accordyng to the meateofferynge and drinke offerynge in the mornynge, to be an odoure of a swete sauoure of the sacrifice of the Lorde
Exodus 29:42 And it shabe a continuall burntofferynge amonge youre chyldren after you, in the dore of the tabernacle of wytnesse before the Lorde where I wyll mete you to speake vnto you there.
Exodus 29:43 Ther I wyll mete wyth the chyldren of Israell, and wylbe sanctifyed in myne honoure.
Exodus 29:44 And I wyll sanctifye the tabernacle of wytnesse and the alter: and I wil sanctifie also both Aaron and hys sonnes to be my prestes.
Exodus 29:45 And more ouer I wyll dwell amonge the chyldren of Israel and wylbe their God.
Exodus 29:46 And they shall knowe that I am the Lorde their God that brought them out of the lande of Egypt for to dwell amonge them: euen I the Lorde their God.

CHAPTER: 30

Exodus 30:1 And thou shalt make an alter to burne cense therein, of sethym woode:
Exodus 30:2 a cubite long, and a cubyte brode, euen fouresquare shal it be: and two cubytes hie, wyth hornes procedinge oute of it,
Exodus 30:3 and thou shalt ouerlay it wt fine gold, both the roffe and the walles round about, and his hornes also, & shalt make vnto it a crowne of gold round about
Exodus 30:4 & .ii. golden ringes on ether side: euen vnder the croune, to put staues therin for to beare it wt al.
Exodus 30:5 And thou shalt make the staues of sethym woode & couer them wt gold.
Exodus 30:6 And thou shalt put it before the vaile that hangeth before the arcke of wytnesse, and before the mercyseate that is before the witnesse, wher I will mete the.
Exodus 30:7 And Aaron shall burne theron swete cense euery mornyng when he dresseth the lampes
Exodus 30:8 and lykewyse at euen when he setteth vp the lampes he shall burne cense perpetually before the Lorde thorow oute youre generacyons.
Exodus 30:9 Ye shall put no straunge cense theron, nether burntsacrifyce nor meateoffrynge, nether power any drinkeoffryng theron.
Exodus 30:10 And Aaron shall reconcyle vpon the hornes of it once in a yere, wyth the bloude of the synne offerynge of reconcylynge: euen once in the yere shall he reconcyle it thorow youre generacyons. And so is it most holye vnto the Lord.
Exodus 30:11 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses saiyng
Exodus 30:12 when thou takest the summe of the children of Israel and tellest them, they shal geue euery man a reconcylynge of his soule vnto the Lorde that there be no plage amonge them when thou tellest them.
Exodus 30:13 And thus much shall euery man geue that goth in the number: halfe a sycle, after the sicle of the sanctuarye: a sicle is .xx. gears: and an halfe sicle shalbe the heueoffrynge vnto the Lord.
Exodus 30:14 And all that are numbred of them that are .xx. yere olde and aboue shall geue an heueofferynge vnto the Lorde.
Exodus 30:15 The ryche shall not passe, and the poore shall not go vnder halfe a syckle, when they geue an heue offeringe vnto the Lorde for the attonemente of their soules.
Exodus 30:16 And thou shalt take the reconcilynge mony of the children of Israell and shalt put it vnto the vse of the tabernacle of witnesse, and it shall be a memorial of the chyldren of Israell before the Lord, to make an attonement for their soules.
Exodus 30:17 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saiynge:
Exodus 30:18 thou shalt make a lauer of brasse & hys fote also of brasse to wash with all, and shalt put it betwene the tabernacle of witnesse, and the alter and put water therin:
Exodus 30:19 that Aaron and hys sonnes maye wash both their handes & their fete thereoute,
Exodus 30:20 when they goo into the tabernacle of wytnesse, or when they go vnto the altare to minister and to burne the Lordesoffrynge, lest they dye.
Exodus 30:21 And it shalbe an ordinaunce for euer vnto him and his sede amonge youre chyldren after you.
Exodus 30:22 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saiynge:
Exodus 30:23 take principall spices: of pure myrre fyue hundred sycles, of swete cynamon halfe so much two hundred and fiftye sycles:
Exodus 30:24 of swete Calamite, two hundred and .l. of Cassia, two hundred and .l. after the holye sycle, and of oyle oliue an hin.
Exodus 30:25 And make of them holy anointynge oyle euen an oyle compounde after the crafte of the apoticarye.
Exodus 30:26 And noynte the tabernacle of wytnesse therewith, and the arke of wytnesse,
Exodus 30:27 and the table wyth all hys apparell, and the candelsticke wyth al hys ordynaunce, and the alter of incense,
Exodus 30:28 and the alter of burntsacrifyce and all his vessels, and the lauer and his fote.
Exodus 30:29 And sacrifice them that they maye be moste holye: so that no man touche them but they that be halowed.
Exodus 30:30 And anoynte Aaron and his sonnes and consecrate them to minister vnto me.
Exodus 30:31 And thou shalt speake vnto the children of Israell saiynge: thys shalbe an holye oyntynge oyle vnto me, thorowe out youre generations,
Exodus 30:32 No mans flesh shalbe anointed therwith: nether shall ye make any other after the makynge of it for it is holye, se therfore that ye take it for holye:
Exodus 30:33 whosoeuer maketh lyke that, or whosoeuer putteth anye of it vpon a straunger, shall peryshe from amonge hys people.
Exodus 30:34 And the Lorde sayd vnto Moses: take vnto the swete spices: stacte, onycha, swete galbanum and pure frankencens, of etche lyke much:
Exodus 30:35 and make cens of them compound after the crafte of the apoticarye, mingled together, that it may be made pure and holy.
Exodus 30:36 And beate it to powder and put it before the wytnesse in the tabernacle of wytnesse, where I wyll mete the,
Exodus 30:37 but let it be vnto you holye. And se that ye make none after the makyng of that, but let it be vnto you holye for the Lorde.
Exodus 30:38 And whosoeuer shal make lyke vnto that, to smel therto shall perysh from amonge his people.

CHAPTER: 31

Exodus 31:1 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses saiynge:
Exodus 31:2 behold I haue called by name. Bezaleel the sonne of Vrye sonne to Hurre of the trybe of Iuda
Exodus 31:3 And I haue fylled hym wyth the spirite of God, with wysdome, vnderstandynge and knoledge: euen in all maner worke,
Exodus 31:4 to fynd out suttle feaytes, to worcke in golde syluer and brasse
Exodus 31:5 and wyth the crafte to graue stones, to sette and to carue in tymber and to worke in al maner warkemanshype.
Exodus 31:6 And beholde. I haue geueth hym to be his companion Ahaliab the sonne of Ahisamach of the trybe of Dan, and in the hertes of al that are wyse harted I haue put wysdom to make al that I haue commaunded the:
Exodus 31:7 the tabernacle of wytnesse, and the arcke of wytnesse, and the mercyseate that is ther vpon all the ornamentes of the tabernacle,
Exodus 31:8 and the table wyth hys ordinaunce, and the pure candelsticke wt all hys apparell, and the aulter of incens,
Exodus 31:9 and the aulter of burntoffrynges with al his vessels, & the lauer wt his fot
Exodus 31:10 & the vestimentes to mynyster in & the holye garments for Aaron the prest, & the garments of his sons to minister in,
Exodus 31:11 & the anointing oile & swete sense for the sanctuarye: accordynge to all as I haue commaunded the shall they d
Exodus 31:12 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses saiynge
Exodus 31:13 speake vnto the chyldren of Israell and saye: in any wyse se that ye kepe my Sabboth, for it shalbe a sygne betwene me and you in youre generacyons for to knowe, that I the Lorde do sanctyfye you.
Exodus 31:14 Kepe my Sabboth therfore, that it be an holye thynge vnto you He that defyleth it shalbe slayne therfore. For whosoeuer worketh therein, the same soule shalbe roted oute from amonge hys people.
Exodus 31:15 Syxe dayes shall men worke, but the seuenth daye is the Sabboth of the holye reste of the Lorde: so that whosoeuer doeth anye worke in the Sabboth daye, shall dye for it:
Exodus 31:16 wherefore lette the children of Israel kepe the Sabboth, that they obserue it thorowe oute their generacyons, that it be an appoyntmente for euer.
Exodus 31:17 For it shalbe a sygne betwene me and the chyldren of Israell for euer. For in sixe daies the Lord made heauen and earth and the seuenth daye he rested and was refreshed,
Exodus 31:18 And when he had made an ende of commenyng wyth Moses vpon the mount Sinai he gaue hym two tables of witnesse: which were of stone and written with the fynger of God.

CHAPTER: 32

Exodus 32:1 And whan the people saw that it was long or Moses came down out of the mountaine, they gathered theym selues together and came vnto Aaron and sayd vnto him. Vp and make vs a God to goo before vs: for of thys Moises the felow that brought vs out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become.
Exodus 32:2 And Aaron sayd vnto them: plucke of the golden earynges whyche are in the eares of youre wyues, youre sonnes and of youre daughters: and brynge them vnto me.
Exodus 32:3 And all the people plucked of the golden earinges that were in their eares, and broughte them vnto Aaron.
Exodus 32:4 And he receiued them of their hands and facyoned it wyth a grauer & made it a calfe of molten metall. And they sayde This is thy God O Israel, which brought the out of the land of Egypte.
Exodus 32:5 And when Aaron sawe that, he made an altare before it, & made a proclamacion saiynge to morrow shalbe holye day vnto the Lorde.
Exodus 32:6 And they rose vp in the mornynge and offred burntoffringes, and brought offrynges of attonemente also. And than they satte them doune to eate and drinke, and rose vp agayne to play.
Exodus 32:7 Then the Lorde sayde vnto Moses: goo get the downe, for thy people whyche thou broughtest oute of the lande of Egypte
Exodus 32:8 haue marred all, they are turned at once out of the waye whihe I commaunded them: and haue made them a calfe of molten metall, & haue worshipped it and haue offred therto & saied Thys is thy God thou Israell, whyche hath brought the out of the lande of Egypte.
Exodus 32:9 And the Lord sayd vnto Moyses: beholde I se this people that it is a styfe necked people,
Exodus 32:10 & and nowe therfore suffer me that my wrath may waxe hote vpon them, and that I may consume them and then wyl I make of the a mightye people.
Exodus 32:11 Then Moyses besoughte the Lorde hys God and sayde: O Lorde, why shoulde thy wrath waxe hote vpon thy people whiche thou hast brought out of the Lande of Egipt wt great power and with a mighty hande?
Exodus 32:12 wherfore shuld the Egyptians speake & say: For a mychefe dyd he brynge them out: euen for to slee them in the mountayns, and to consume them from the face of the earth. Turne from thy fearse wrath, and haue compassion ouer the wickednesse of thy people.
Exodus 32:13 Remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel thy seruauntes, to whom thou sworest by thyne owne selfe & saidest vnto them. I wyll multiplye youre seed as the starres of heauen, and all thys lande which I haue sayd, I wyll geue vnto youre seede: and they shal enheret it for euer
Exodus 32:14 And the Lord refrained him selfe from the euil whych he sayed he wold do vnto his people.
Exodus 32:15 And Moses turned hys backe and wente downe from the hyl, and the .ij. tables of witnesse in his hand: which were written on both the leaues
Exodus 32:16 and were the worcke of God, and the wrytynge was the writynge of God grauen vpon the tables.
Exodus 32:17 And when Iosua herde the noyse of the people as they shouted, he said vnto Moses: there is a noyse of warre in the hoste.
Exodus 32:18 And he sayde: it is not the crye of them that haue the masterye, nor of them that haue the worse; but I doo heare the noyse of syngynge.
Exodus 32:19 And as soone as he came nie vnto the host and sawe the calfe and the daunsynge, hys wrath waxed hote, and he cast the tables out of his hande, and brake them euen at the hylle fote.
Exodus 32:20 And he toke the calfe whyche they had made and burned it wyth fyre, and stampte it vnto powder and strawed it in the water & made the children of Israel drynke.
Exodus 32:21 And than Moses sayde vnto Aaron: what dyd thys people vnto the that thou haste broughte so great a synne vpon them.
Exodus 32:22 And Aaron sayde: let not the wrath of my Lorde waxe fearse, thou knowest the people that they are euen sett on myschefe:
Exodus 32:23 they sayde vnto me: make vs a God to go before vs, for we wote not what is become of Moses the felow that brought vs out of the land of Egypte.
Exodus 32:24 And I sayde vnto them: let them that haue golde, take and brynge it me: and I cast it into the fyre, and there of came oute thys calfe.
Exodus 32:25 When Moses sawe that the people were naked (for Aaron had made them naked vnto their shame when they made insurrection)
Exodus 32:26 he went & stode in the gate of the hoste & sayde: If any man pertayne vnto the Lord, let him come to me. And all the sonnes of Leui gathered them selues together and came vnto him.
Exodus 32:27 And he sayd vnto them, thus sayeth the Lorde of Israel put euery man his swerde by hys syde, and go in and out from gate to gate thorow out the hoste: & slee euery man his brother, euery man his frende and euery man his neighbour.
Exodus 32:28 And the chyldren of Leui dyd as Moses had sayde. And there were slayne of the people the same daye, aboute thre thousande men.
Exodus 32:29 Then Moyses said: fyl your handes vnto the Lord thys day, euery man vpon hys sonne & vpon his brother: to brynge vpon you a blessyng this day.
Exodus 32:30 And on the morowe, Moyses sayde vnto the people: Ye haue sinned a great synne. But now I wyll goo vp vnto the Lorde, to wytt whether I can make an attonement for your synne.
Exodus 32:31 And Moses went agayne vnto the Lorde & sayd: Oh, thys people haue synned a great synne & haue made them a god of gold:
Exodus 32:32 Yet forgeue them their synne I praye the: If not wype me out of thy boke which thou hast written.
Exodus 32:33 And the Lorde sayde vnto Moses: I wyl put hym out of my boke that hath sinned agaynst me.
Exodus 32:34 But go & bryng the people vnto the land which I sayd vnto the: behold, myne angel shall go before the. Neuerthelater in the daye when I vyset. I wyll vyset their synne vpon them.
Exodus 32:35 And the Lord plaged the people, because they made the calf whych Aaron made.

CHAPTER: 33

Exodus 33:1 And the Lorde saide vnto Moses: departe and go hence: both thou & the people whych thou hast brought out of the land of Egypt, vnto the lande which I swore vnto Abraham, Isaac and Iacob sayinge: vnto thy seed I wyl geue it.
Exodus 33:2 And I wyll sende an angell before the, & wyll cast out the Cananytes, the Amorytes, the Hethites, the Pherezites, the Heuites, & the Iebusytes:
Exodus 33:3 that thou maist go into a land that floweth with mylke and honye. But I wyl not go amonge you my selfe, for ye are a styfnecked people: leste I consume you by the waye.
Exodus 33:4 And when the people herde this euell tydinges, they sorowed: and no man did put on hys best rayment.
Exodus 33:5 And the Lord spake vnto Moses, say vnto the chyldren of Israel: ye are a styfnecked people: I must come once sodenly vpon you, & make an ende of you. But now put youre goodly rayment from you, that I maye wete what to do vnto you.
Exodus 33:6 And the chyldren of Israel layde their goodly rayment from them euen vnder the mount Horeb.
Exodus 33:7 And Moses toke the tabernacle & pytched it without the hoste a ferre of from the hoste, & called it the tabernacle of wytnesse. And al that wold axe any question of the Lorde, went out vnto the tabernacle of wytnesse whyche was without the hoste.
Exodus 33:8 And when Moses went out vnto the tabernacle, all the people rose vp and stode euery man in his tent dore and loked after Moses, vntyll he was gone in to the tobernacle.
Exodus 33:9 And as sone as Moses was entred in to the tabernacle, the clouden pyller descended and stode in the dore of the tabernacle, and he talked with Moses.
Exodus 33:10 And when all the people sawe the clouden piller stande in the tabernacle dore, they rose vp & worshypped: euery man in hys tent dore.
Exodus 33:11 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh vnto hys frende. And when Moses turned agayne in to the hoste, the ladd Iosua his seruaunte the sonne of Nun departed not out of the tabernacle.
Exodus 33:12 And Moses sayde vnto the Lorde: se, thou saydest vnto me: leade thys people forth, but thou shewest me not whom thou wylt sende with me. And hast sayde moreouer: I know the by name and thou hast also founde grace in my syghte:
Exodus 33:13 Now therfore, yf I haue found fauoure in thy sight, then shewe me thy way & let me know the: that I may fynde grace in thy syghte. And loke on thys also, howe that this nacion is thy people.
Exodus 33:14 And he sayde: my presence shal goo wyth the, and I wyll geue the rest.
Exodus 33:15 And he sayde: If thy presence goo not wyth me, carye vs not hence
Exodus 33:16 for how shall it be knowne nowe that both I and thy people haue founde fauoure in thy syghte, but in that thou goest wyth vs: that both I and thy people haue a preemynence before all the people that are vpon the face of the erth.
Exodus 33:17 And the Lord sayd vnto Moses: I wyll do thys also that thou hast sayde, for thou hast founde grace in my syghte, and I knowe the by name.
Exodus 33:18 And he sayde: I beseche the, shewe me thy glorye:
Exodus 33:19 And he sayd: I wyl make al my good god before the, and I wyl be called in thys name Iehouah before the, & wil shew mercy to whom I shewe mercy, and wyll haue compassion on whom I haue compassion.
Exodus 33:20 And he sayed furthermore, thou maiste not see my for there shall no man se me and lyue.
Exodus 33:21 And the Lorde sayed, beholde, there is a place by me, & thou shalt stand vpon a rocke,
Exodus 33:22 and whyle my glory goeth forth I wyll put the in a clyfte of the rocke, & wyll put myne hand vpon the whyle I passe by.
Exodus 33:23 And then I wyl take away myne hande, and thou shalte se my backe partes: but my face shall not be seene.

CHAPTER: 34

Exodus 34:1 And the Lord sayed vnto Moses: hewe the two tables of stone lyke vnto the fyrste, that I may write in them the wordes whyche were in the fyrste two tables, whych thou brakest
Exodus 34:2 and be ready against the mornyng that thou mayst come vp early to the mount of Sinai and stande me there vppon the toppe of the mounte.
Exodus 34:3 But let no man come vp wyth the neither let any man be sene thorowout al the mount, neither let shepe nor oxen fede before the hyll.
Exodus 34:4 And Moses hewed .ij. tables of stone lyke vnto the fyrst, and rose vp earlye in the mornynge and wente vp into the mounte of Sinai as the Lord commaunded him: and toke in hys hand the two tables of stone.
Exodus 34:5 And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stode with hym there: and he called vpon the name of the Lorde.
Exodus 34:6 And when the Lord walked before him, he cried: Lord Lord God full of compassion and mercy, which are not lightly angry but abundaunt in mercy and truth,
Exodus 34:7 and kepest mercye in store for thousandes, & forgeueste wyckednes, trespace, and synne (for there is no man innocent before the) and vysitest the wyckednes of the father vpon the chyldren and vpon chyldrens chyldren, euen vnto the thyrd and fourth generation.
Exodus 34:8 And Moses bowed himselfe to the earth quickly & worshipped
Exodus 34:9 & said: If I haue found grace in thy sight, O Lorde, then let my Lorde go wyth vs (for it is a stubburne people) & haue mercy vpon our wickednes & our sinne, and let vs be thyne enheritaunce.
Exodus 34:10 And he sayd: behold, I make an appoyntment before all thys people, that I wyl doo maruails: such as haue not bene done in all the world, neither among any nation. And all the people among whych thou arte, shall se the worckes of the Lord: for it is a terrible thynge that I wyll do wyth the:
Exodus 34:11 kepe al that I commaund the thys daye, and beholde: I wyll caste out before the the Amorytes, Canaanites, Hethytes, Pherezites, Heuites, and Iebusites.
Exodus 34:12 Take hede to thy selfe, that thou make no compact wyth the inhabiters of the Lande whether thou goest, least it because of ruine among you.
Exodus 34:13 But ouerthrowe their aulters and breake theyr pillars, & cut downe their groues,
Exodus 34:14 for thou shalt worshyp no straunge God. For the Lorde is called gelousee bycause he is a gelouse God:
Exodus 34:15 lest if thou make any agremente wyth the inhabiters of the lande, when they go a whorynge after theyr Gods and do sacrifice vnto theyr Goddes, they cal the and thou eate of theyr sacrifyce:
Exodus 34:16 and thou take of theyr daughters vnto thy sonnes, and when theyr daughters goo a whorynge after theyr Goddes,
Exodus 34:17 they make thy sonnes goo a whoringe after their Goddes also. Thou shalt make the no Gods of metall.
Exodus 34:18 The feast of swete bread shalt thou kepe, & .vij. dayes thou shalt eat vnleauened bread (as I commaunded the) in the time appointed in the moneth of Abib: for in the moneth of Abib thou camest oute of Egypte.
Exodus 34:19 All that breaketh vp the matrice shall be myne, & all that breaketh the matryce among thy cattel, if it be male: whether it be oxe or shepe.
Exodus 34:20 But the fyrst of the asse thou shalt bye out wt a shepe or if thou redeme him not: se thou breake his necke. All the fyrst borne of thy sonnes thou must nedes redeme. And se that no man appeare before me empty.
Exodus 34:21 Sixe dayes thou shalt worcke, & the seuenth thou shalt rest: both from earyng and reaping
Exodus 34:22 Thou shalt obserue the feaste of wekes wt the fyrst fruites of wheate herueste, and the feast ingaderyng at the yeares ende.
Exodus 34:23 Thrise in a yeare shall all youre men chyldren appeare before the Lorde Iehouah God of Israell:
Exodus 34:24 for I wyll caste out the nations before the & wyll enlarge thy costes, so that no man shall desyre thy lande whylse thou goest vp to appeare before the face of the Lorde thy God, thryse in the yeare.
Exodus 34:25 Thou shalt not offer the bloud of my sacrifice wt leuened breade: neither shal oughte of the sacrifice of the feast of passeouer, beleft vnto the morning.
Exodus 34:26 The fyrst of the firstfrutes of thy Lande, thou shalt brynge vnto the house of the Lord thy God. And se, that thou seeth not a kydd in hys mothers milke.
Exodus 34:27 And the Lorde sayed vnto Moses: wryte these wordes, for vpon these wordes I haue made a couenaunt wyth the & wyth the chyldren of Israel.
Exodus 34:28 And he was there wyth the Lorde .xl. dayes & .xl. nightes, and nether ate bred not dranke water. And he wrote in the tables the wordes of the couenaunt: euen ten verses.
Exodus 34:29 And Moses came doune from mount Synay & the .ij. tables of wytnesse in his hande, & yet the wyst not that the skynne of his face shone wyth beames of hys comenyng with hym.
Exodus 34:30 And when Aaron and all the chyldren of Israel loked vpon Moses and sawe that the skynne of his face shone with beames they were afrayde to come nye hym.
Exodus 34:31 But he called them to hym, and then Aaron & all the chefe of the company came vnto him, & Moses talked with them.
Exodus 34:32 And at the last al the chyldren of Israel came vnto him, and he commaunded them all that the Lord had sayde vnto him in mounte Sinai.
Exodus 34:33 And as soone as he had made an ende of comenyng wyth them, he put a coueryng vpon his face.
Exodus 34:34 But when he went before the Lorde to speake wyth him, he toke the coueryng of vntyll he came out. And he came out & spake vnto the chyldren of Israel that whych he was commaunded.
Exodus 34:35 And the chyldren of Israel sawe the face of Moses, that the skynne of hys face shone with beames: but Moses put a coueryng vpon hys face, vntyl he went into comen with hym.

CHAPTER: 35

Exodus 35:1 And Moses gathered al the company of the chyldren of Israell together, and sayd vnto them: these are the thynges whiche the Lord hath commaunded to do:
Exodus 35:2 Syxe dayes ye shall worke, but the seuenth day shal be vnto you the holy Sabboth of the Lordes rest: so that whosoeuer doth any worke therin, shal dye.
Exodus 35:3 Moreouer ye shal kyndle no fyre thorowe out all your habitacions vpon the Sabboth day.
Exodus 35:4 And Moses spake vnto al the multytude of the chyldren of Israel sayinge this is the thynge which the Lord commaunded saying:
Exodus 35:5 Geue from amonge you an heue offeynge, vnto the Lorde. Al that are wyllynge in their hartes, shall brynge heue offeynges vnto the Lord: gold, syluer, brasse,
Exodus 35:6 Iacyncte, scarlet, purpull, bysse and gootes heare:
Exodus 35:7 rams skinnes red and tarus skynnes and Sethim wood:
Exodus 35:8 and oyle for lyghtes & spices for the anoyntynge oyle and for the swete cens:
Exodus 35:9 And Onixstones and stones to be sett for the Ephod and for the brestlappe.
Exodus 35:10 And let al them that are wyseherted among you, come and make all that the Lorde hath commaunded:
Exodus 35:11 the habitacion & the tent therof with his couerynge and his rynges, bordes, barres, pyllers & sockettes:
Exodus 35:12 the arke and the staues therof with the mercyseate & the vayle that couereth it:
Exodus 35:13 the table & hys staues wyth all that pertayneth therto & the shewebred:
Exodus 35:14 the candelstycke of lyghte wyth his apparel and his lampes and the oyle for the lyghtes:
Exodus 35:15 the cens alter & hys staues, the anoyntynge oyle and the swete cens and the hangynge before the tabernacle dore:
Exodus 35:16 the alter of burntsacryfices and his brasen gredyren that longeth therto wyth his staues & all hys ordinaunce and the lauer and his fote:
Exodus 35:17 the hangynges of the courte with his pyllers & their sockettes, and the hangynge to the dore of the courte:
Exodus 35:18 the pynnes of the habitacion and the pynnes of the courte with their boordes:

Exodus 40:24 And he put the candelsticke in the tabernacle of wytnes ouer agaynste the table in the south syde of the habitation,
Exodus 40:25 and sette vp the lampes before the Lorde: as the Lorde commaunded Moses.
Exodus 40:26 And he put the golden altare in the tabernacle of wytnes before the vayle,
Exodus 40:27 and brente swete sence thereon as the Lord commaunded Moses.
Exodus 40:28 And set vp the hangynge in the dore of the habitation,
Exodus 40:29 and set the burnt offering alter before the dore of the tabernacle of wytnes, & offered burnteofferynges and meate offerynges theron as the lord commaunded Moses.
Exodus 40:30 And he set the lauer betwene the tabernacle of witnes and the aultare, and poured water therin to washe wt all.
Exodus 40:31 And both Moses, Aaron & his sonnes washed their handes & their fete therat:
Exodus 40:32 boeth when they went into the tabernacle of wytnes, or when they went to the aultare, as the Lord commaunded Moses.
Exodus 40:33 And he reared vp the courte rounde about the habitation and the aultare & set vp the hangynge of the court gate: and so Moses finished the worcke.
Exodus 40:34 And the cloude couered the tabernacle of wytnes, and the glorye of the Lorde fylled the habitation:
Exodus 40:35 so that Moses coulde not enter into the Tabernacle of wytnesse bycause the cloude abode therin, and the glory of the Lord filled the habitation.
Exodus 40:36 When the cloude was taken vp from of the habitation the children of Israel toke their iourneys as oft as they had iourneyed.
Exodus 40:37 And if the cloude departed not, they iourneyed not tyll it departed:
Exodus 40:38 for the cloud of the Lord was vpon the habitation by daye, and fyre by nyght: in the syght of all the house of Israell in all theyr iourneys.

BOOK: Leviticus

CHAPTER: 1

Leviticus 1:1 And the Lorde called Moses & spak to hym oute of the tabernacle of wytnesse saiyng:
Leviticus 1:2 speake vnto the chyldren of Israel, and saye vnto them: who soeuer of you shal brynge a gyfte vnto the Lord, shal brynge it of the catel: euen of the oxen and of the shepe.
Leviticus 1:3 If he brynge a burntoffrynge of the oxen he shall brynge a male wythout blemysh, & shal brynge hym to the dore of the tabernacle of wytnesse, that he maye be accepted before the Lorde.
Leviticus 1:4 And let hym put hys hand vpon the heed of the burntsacryfice, and fauoure shalbe geuen hym to make an attonement for hym,
Leviticus 1:5 and let hym kyll the oxe before the Lorde. And let the preastes Aarons sonnes bringe the bloud and let them sprynkel it rounde aboute vpon the alter that is before the dore of the tabernacle of witnesse.
Leviticus 1:6 And let the burntoffrynges be strypped and hewed in peces.
Leviticus 1:7 And then let the sonnes of Aaron the preast put fyre vpon the alter,
Leviticus 1:8 & put wood vpon the fyre, & let them laye the peces with the heed and the fatte, vpon the wood that is on the fyre in the alter.
Leviticus 1:9 But the inwardes and the legges shey shall wash in water, and the preast shal burne altogether vpon the alter, that it be a burntsacrifyce & an offring of a swete odoure vnto the Lord.
Leviticus 1:10 Yf he wyl offer a burnt sacrifice of the shepe whether it be of the lambes or of the gootes he shal offer a male wythout blemysh.
Leviticus 1:11 And let hym kyll it on the northsyde of the alter, before the Lord. And let the Preastes Aarons sonnes sprynkle the bloude of it round about vpon the alter.
Leviticus 1:12 And let it be cut in peces: euen wyth hys heed and his fatte, and let the preast put them vpon the wood that lyeth vpon the fyre in the alter.
Leviticus 1:13 But let hym wash the inwardes and the legges wyth water, and than brynge all together and burne it vpon the alter: that is a burntoffryng and a sacrifyce of swete sauour vnto the Lorde.
Leviticus 1:14 If he wyl offer a burntoffrynge of the foules he shall offer eyther of the turtyll doues or of the yong pigeons.
Leviticus 1:15 And the Preast shal bryng it vnto the alter, and wrynge the necke a sundre of it, & burne it on the alter, and let the bloude runne out vpon the sydes of the alter,
Leviticus 1:16 and plucke awaye hys croppe & his fethers, & cast them besyde the alter on the east parte vpon the hepe of asshes,
Leviticus 1:17 and breke hys wynges, but plucke them not asundre. And then let the Preast burne it vpon the alter, euen vpon the wood that lyeth vpon the fyre, a burntsacryfyce and an offrynge of a swete sauoure vnto the Lorde.

CHAPTER: 2

Leviticus 2:1 If any soule wyl offer a meate offrynge vnto the Lorde, hys offrynge shalbe fyne floure, & he shal poure therto oyle, and put frankencens theron,
Leviticus 2:2 and shall brynge it vnto Aarons sonnes the preastes. And one of them shall take therout hys handfull of the floure, and of the oyle wyth all the franckencens, & burne it for a memoriall vpon the alter: an offryng of a swete sauoure vnto the Lord.
Leviticus 2:3 And the remnaunt of the meatoffring shalbe Aarons & his sonnes as a thynge most holy of the sacryfyces of the Lorde.
Leviticus 2:4 If anye man brynge a meatoffrynge that is baken in the ouen, let hym brynge swete cakes of fyue floure myngled wyth oyle, and vnleuended wafers anoynted wyth oyle.
Leviticus 2:5 If thy meatoffrynge be baken in the fryeng pan, then it shalbe of swete floure myngled wyth oyle.
Leviticus 2:6 And thou shalt mynce it smal, and poure oyle theron: and so it is a meatoffrynge.
Leviticus 2:7 If thy meatofferynge be a thyng broyled vpon the gredyren, of floure myngled wyth oyle it shalbe.
Leviticus 2:8 And thou shalt brynge the meatoffrynge that is made of these thynges vnto the Lorde, & shalt delyuer it vnto the preast, and he shal bryng it vnto the alter,
Leviticus 2:9 and shall heue vp parte of the meatoffrynge for a memoryal, & shal burne it vpon the alter: an offerynge of a swete sauoure vnto the Lorde.
Leviticus 2:10 And that whyche is left of the meatoffrynge shall be Aarons and hys sonnes, as a thyng that is moost holy of the offrynges of the Lorde.
Leviticus 2:11 Al the meatoffringes which ye shal bringe vnto the Lorde, shalbe made without leuen. For ye shall nether burne leuen nor honye in any offeryng of the Lorde:
Leviticus 2:12 Notwithstandyng ye shal brynge the fyrstlynges of them vnto the Lorde: but they shall not come vpon the alter to make a swete sauoure.
Leviticus 2:13 All thy meat offeringes thou shalt salt wt salt: neither shalt thou suffer the of the couenaunt of thy God to be sackyng from thy meat offeryng: but vpon al thyne offerynges thou shal bryng salt.
Leviticus 2:14 If thou offer a meatofferynge of the fyrste ripe frutes to the Lord, then take that whych is yet grene, & drye it by the fyre and beat it smal & so offer the mete offeryng of thy first rype frutes.
Leviticus 2:15 And then poure oyle therto, and put frankensence theron: & so it is a meatofferynge.
Leviticus 2:16 And the prieste shal burne parte of the beaten corne & parte of the oyle wythall the frankencense, for a remembraunce. That is an offeryng vnto the Lorde.

CHAPTER: 3

Leviticus 3:1 If a man brynge a peace offerynge of the oxen: whether it be male or female, he shal bringe such as is without blemish, before the Lorde:
Leviticus 3:2 and let hym put hys hande vppon the heade of hys offerynge, and kyll it before the dore of the tabernacle of wytnes. And Aarons sonnes the preastes shal sprinkle the bloud vpon the aulter round aboute.
Leviticus 3:3 And they shal offer of the peaceoffering to be a sacrifice vnto the Lord the fatt that couereth the inwardes, and all the fat that is vpon the inwardes:
Leviticus 3:4 & the two kidneys with the fatt that lyeth vpon the loynes: and the kall that is on the lyuer they shall take awaye wyth the kidneyes.
Leviticus 3:5 And Aarons sonnes shall burne them vpon the alter with the burnt sacrifice which is vpon the wodd on the fyre. That is a Sacrifice of a swete sauour vnto the Lorde.
Leviticus 3:6 If a man brynge a peace offeryng vnto the Lord from of the flocke, whether it be male or female, it shall be without blemysh.
Leviticus 3:7 If he offer a Lambe, he shall brynge it before the Lord,
Leviticus 3:8 and put his hand vpon his offeringes head, & kyll it in the dore of the Takernacle of wytnesse, & Aarons sonnes shall sprynkle the bloud therof round about the aulter.
Leviticus 3:9 And of the peace offering they shall bryng a sacrifyce vnto the Lorde: the fatt therof & the rompe altogyther, whych they shal take of hard by the backe bone: & the fatt that couereth the inwardes & al the fatt that is vpon the inwardes
Leviticus 3:10 & the two kydneys with the fatt that lyeth vpon them & vpon the loynes, and the kall that is vppon the lyuer he shall take awaye wyth the kydneys.
Leviticus 3:11 And the prieste shall burne them vpon the aulter to fede the Lordes offerynge wyth all.
Leviticus 3:12 If the offeryng be a goote, he shal brynge it before the Lorde,
Leviticus 3:13 & put his hande vpon the head of it, and kyl it before the tabernacle of wytnes, and the sonnes of Aaron shal sprinkle the bloud thereof vpon the aulter round aboute.
Leviticus 3:14 And he shal bryng therof his offring vnto the Lordes sacrifyce: the fatt that couereth the inwardes & all the fatte that is vpon the inwardes
Leviticus 3:15 & the two kydneys & the fatte that lieth vpon them and vpon the loynes, & the kal the is vpon the lyuer he shal take away with the kydneys.
Leviticus 3:16 And the prieste shal burne them vpon the alter to fede the Lordes sacrifice wt all, & to make a swete sauour.
Leviticus 3:17 And thus shall all the fat be the Lordes, and it shall be a lawe for euer amonge youre generations after you in your dwellynge places: that ye eate neyther fat nor bloud.

CHAPTER: 4

Leviticus 4:1 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses sayinge:
Leviticus 4:2 speake vnto the chyldren of Israell & say: when a soule synneth thorowe ignoraunce, and hath done anye of those thynges whyche the Lord hath forbidden in hys commaundementes to be done:
Leviticus 4:3 If the prieste that is anointed sinne, & make the people do amysse, he shall brynge for hys syn which he hath done: an oxe wythout blemysh vnto the Lord for a syn offeryng.
Leviticus 4:4 And he shall bryng the oxe vnto the dore of the tabernacle of witnesse before the Lorde, & shal put hys hand vpon the oxe heade, and kyll hym before the Lorde.
Leviticus 4:5 And the prieste that is anoynted shall take of the oxe bloude, and bryng it into the tabernacle of wytnes,
Leviticus 4:6 and shal dyp hys fynger in the bloude & sprinkle therof seuen tymes before the Lord: euen before the hanging of the holy place.
Leviticus 4:7 And he shal put some of the blud vpon the hornes of the alter of swete sence before the Lord which is in the tabernacle of wytnes, & shal poure all the bloud of the oxe vpon the bottome of the alter of burntoffrynges which is by the dore of the tabernacle of witnes.
Leviticus 4:8 And he shal take away all the fatte of the oxe that is the synne offering: the fatt that couereth the inwardes and all the fatte that is aboute them,
Leviticus 4:9 & the .ij. kydneys with the fatt that lyeth vpon them & vpon the loynes, and the kall vpon the liuer let them take awaye also wyth the kidneis:
Leviticus 4:10 as it was taken from the oxe of the peace offeringe & let the prieste burne theim vppon the alter of burnt offringes.
Leviticus 4:11 But the skinne of the oxe & al hys flesh wyth his head, hys legges, his inwardes with his dong,
Leviticus 4:12 shal he carye altogither out of the host vnto a clene place: euen wher the ashes are poured out, & burne him on wodd wyth fyre: euen vpon the heape of ashes.
Leviticus 4:13 If the hole comenaltye of the children of Israel sinne thorow ignoraunce, & the thyng be hid from theyr eyes: so that they haue committed any of these thynges which the Lord hath forbydden to be done in his commaundementes & haue offended,
Leviticus 4:14 & the synne which they haue synned be afterward knowne, then shall they offer an oxe for a synne offeryng, & shal bryng him before the tabernacle of witnes,
Leviticus 4:15 and the elders of the multitude shal put theyr handes vpon his head before the Lord.
Leviticus 4:16 And the priest that is anoynted shal bringe of his bloud into the tabernacle of wytnes,
Leviticus 4:17 and shal dype hys fynger in the bloude, and sprinkle it seuen tymes before the Lorde: euen before the vayle.
Leviticus 4:18 And shall put of the bloude vpon the hornes of the alter whych is before the Lorde in the tabernacle of wytnes, and shall poure al the bloud vpon the botome of the alter of burnt offeringes whych is by the dore of the tabernacle of witnes,
Leviticus 4:19 & shal take all hys fatte frome hym, & burne it vpon the alter,
Leviticus 4:20 & shal do wyth hys oxe as he dyd with the synne offerynge oxe. And the priest shall make an atonement for them, and so it shalbe forgeuen them.
Leviticus 4:21 And he shall bring the oxe without the hoste, and burne hym as he burned the fyrst: so is thys the sinneofferynge of the cominalty.
Leviticus 4:22 When a Lorde synneth and commytteth thorow ignoraunce any of these things whiche the lord his God hath forbiden to be done in his commaundementes & hath so offended: when hys synne is shewed vnto him,
Leviticus 4:23 which he hath synned, he shall brynge for hys offerynge an he goote wythoute blemish
Leviticus 4:24 & laye his hand vpon the head of it, and kil it in the place where the burntofferynges are kylled before the Lord: this is a synneoffring.
Leviticus 4:25 Then let the priest take of the bloude of the synneofferyng with hys fynger, and put it vpon the hornes of the burnt offeryng aulter, & poure his bloud vpon the botome of the burntofferyng alter,
Leviticus 4:26 & burne all his fatt vpon the aulter, as he doth the fatt of the peaceoffringes. And the prieste shall make an atonement for hym as concerning his synne, and so it shalbe forgeuen hym.
Leviticus 4:27 If one of the common people of the land sinne thorowe ignoraunce and commit anye of the thynges whych the Lord hath forbydden in hys commaundementes to be done & so hath trespaced,
Leviticus 4:28 when hys synne which he hath sinned is come to hys knowledge, he shal bring for hys offering, a she gote without blemish for hys sinnes whych he hath synned,
Leviticus 4:29 & laye hys hand vpon the head of the synne offering & slea it in the place of burnt offringes
Leviticus 4:30 And the priestes shall take of the bloud wyth hys fynger, & put it vpon the hornes of the burntofferyng alter, and poure al the bloud vpon the botome of the alter,
Leviticus 4:31 and shall take away al his fatt as the fatt of the peaceofferynges is taken awaye. And the priest shall burne it vpon the alter for a swete sauoure vnto the Lorde, and the prieste shall make an atonement for hym, & it shalbe forgeuen hym.
Leviticus 4:32 If he bringe a lambe & offer it for a synne offeryng, he shall bryng a female wythoute blemysh,
Leviticus 4:33 & lay hys hand vpon the head of the synneofferyng, & slea it in the place wher the burntoffringes ar slayne.
Leviticus 4:34 And the priest shal take of the bloud of the synne offeryng wyth his fynger, and put it vpon the hornes of the burntoffring alter, & shal poure al the bloud therof vnto the botome of the alter.
Leviticus 4:35 And he shall take away all the fatt therof, as the fat of the shepe of the peace offringes was taken awaye. And the prieste shall burne it vpon the alter for the Lordes sacrifice, and the prieste shall make an atonement for hys synne, and it shalbe forgeuen hym.

CHAPTER: 5

Leviticus 5:1 When a Soule hath synned and hearde the voyce of cursynge, and is a wytnesse: whether he hath sene or knowne of it, if he haue not vttered it, he shal bere hys synne.
Leviticus 5:2 Eyther when a manne toucheth anye vncleane thynge: whether it be the caryon of an vncleane beast or of vncleane catell or vncleane worme and is not ware of it is also vncleane & hath offended.
Leviticus 5:3 Either when he toucheth any vncleannes of man (whatsoeuer vncleannes it be that a man is defyled wythall) & is not ware of it and afterwarde cometh to the knowelege of it, he is a trespasour.
Leviticus 5:4 Either when a soule sweareth: so that he pronounceth wyth his lyps to do euil or to do good (whatsoeuer it be that a man pronounceth wyth an othe) and the thynge be out of hys mynde & afterwarde cometh to the knowelege of it, then he hath offended in one of these.
Leviticus 5:5 Then when he hath synned in one of these thynges, he shall confesse that wherin he hath synned,
Leviticus 5:6 and shall brynge hys trespaceofferyng vnto the Lorde for hys synne which he hath synned. A female from the flocke whether it be a Lambe or a she goote for a synneofferyng. And the priest shal make an atonement for hym for hys synne.
Leviticus 5:7 But if he be not able to brynge a Shepe, then lette hym bryng for his trespace whych he hath sinned two turtle doues or two yong pygeons vnto the Lord, one for a synne offering and another for a burnt offeryng.
Leviticus 5:8 And he shall bring them vnto the Prieste whyche shall offer the synneoffering fyrst, & wring the necke a sunder of it, but plucke it not cleane of.
Leviticus 5:9 And let hym sprynkle of the bloude of the synneofferynge vpon the syde of the aulter, and let the rest of the bloude blede vpon the bottome of the alter, & then it is a synneofferyng.
Leviticus 5:10 And let hym offer the second for a burntofferinge as the maner is: & so shall the prieste make an atonemente for hym for the synne whych he hath synned, and it shalbe forgeuen him.
Leviticus 5:11 And yet if he be not able to bringe two turtyll doues or two yonge Pygeons, then lette hym bryng hys offeryng for hys synne the tenth parte ef an Epha of fyne floure for a synneofferynge, but putt none oyle therto neyther put any franckencense theron, for it is a synneoffering.
Leviticus 5:12 And let hym bringe it to the prieste, & the priest shall take his handfull of it, and burne it vpon the alter for a remembraunce to be a sacrifice for the Lord: that is a synneoffering.
Leviticus 5:13 And let the prieste make an attonemente for hym for hys synne (whatsoeuer of these he hath synned) and it shall be forgeuen. And the remnaunte shall be the pristes, as it is in the meatofferynge.
Leviticus 5:14 And the Lord comened wt Moses saying:
Leviticus 5:15 When a soule trespaceth & synneth thorowe ignoraunce in any of the holy thynges of the Lorde, he shall brynge for hys trespace vnto the Lorde a ram without blemish out of the flocke valued at two sicles after the sycle of the sanctuarye, for a trespace offerynge.
Leviticus 5:16 And he shal make amendes for the harme that he hath done in the holy thing, and put the fifte part more to, & geue it vnto the prieste. And the priest shall make an atonemente for hym with the ram of the trespace offerynge, & it shal be forgeuen hym.
Leviticus 5:17 When a soule synneth & committeth any of these thynges whyche are forbidden to be done by the commaundement of the Lorde: though he wyst it not, he hath yet offended & is in synne,
Leviticus 5:18 & shal bryng a ram wythout blemyshe out of the flocke that is estemed to be worth a synne offeryng vnto the prieste. And the prieste shall make an atonement for hym for the ignoraunce whych he dyd, & was not ware, and it shal be forgeuen hym.
Leviticus 5:19 This is a trespace offeryng, for he trespaced agaynste the Lorde.

CHAPTER: 6

Leviticus 6:1 And the Lord talked with Moses sayinge:
Leviticus 6:2 when a soule synneth and trespaceth agaynste the Lorde, and denyeth vnto hys neyghboure that whyche was taken hym to keepe, or that was putte vnder hys hande, or that whych he hath violently taken away, or that which he hath deceaued his neighbour of wt soteltie,
Leviticus 6:3 or hathe founde that whych was lost and denyeth it, & sweareth falsly in whatsoeuer thinge it be that a man doth & synneth therin.
Leviticus 6:4 Then when he hath synned or trespaced, he shall restore agayne that he toke violently awaye, or the wrong which he dyd, or that whych was deliuered him to kepe, or the lost thyng whiche he found,
Leviticus 6:5 or whatsoeuer it be about whyche he hath sworne falselye he shall restore it agayne in the whole somme, and shall adde the fyfte part more thereto, and giue it vnto hym to whome it pertayneth, the same daye that he offereth for his trespace,
Leviticus 6:6 & shal bryng for hys trespace offerynge vnto the Lorde a ram wythout blemysh out of the flocke, that is estemed worth a trespace offering vnto the prieste.
Leviticus 6:7 And the prieste shall make an attonemente for hym before the Lorde, and it shall be forgeuen hym, in whatsoeuer thynge it be that a man doth & trespaceth therin.
Leviticus 6:8 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Leviticus 6:9 Commaunde Aaron and his sonnes saying: this is the law of the burntoffring. The burntoffering shal be vpon the harth of the alter all nyght vnto the mornyng, and the fyre of the alter shall burne therin.
Leviticus 6:10 And the prieste shall put on his lynen albe, and his lynen breches vpon hys fleshe, and take awaye the ashes whyche the fyre of the burnt sacrifyce in the aulter hath made, and put theym besyde the aulter,
Leviticus 6:11 and then put of hys rayment and put on other, and cary the ashes out without the host vnto a cleane place.
Leviticus 6:12 The fire that is vpon the alter shal burne therin and not go out. And the priest shal put wodde on the fyre euery mornynge, and put the burnt sacrifice vpon it, and he shal burne thereon the fat of the peaceofferynges.
Leviticus 6:13 The fyre shall euer burne vpon the alter, & neuer go oute.
Leviticus 6:14 This is the law of the meatofferyng: Aarons sonnes shall bryng it before the Lorde, vnto the alter:
Leviticus 6:15 and one of them shall take his hand ful of the floure of the meat offeryng & of the oyle wyth al the frankencens whych is theron, & shall burne it vnto a remembraunce vpon the aultare to be a swete sauoure of the memoriall of it vnto the Lorde.
Leviticus 6:16 And the rest therof Aaron & his sonnes shal eate vnleuended: it shal be eaten in the holy place: euen in the court of the tabernacle of wytnes they shall eat it.
Leviticus 6:17 Their part which I haue geuen them of my sacrifice shall not be baken with leuen, for it is most holy, as is the synne offeryng, & trespace offerynge.
Leviticus 6:18 All the males amonge the chyldren of Aaron shall eate of it: and it shall be a dutye for euer vnto youre generacions of the sacrifices of the Lorde, neyther shal any man touch it, but he that is halowed.
Leviticus 6:19 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Leviticus 6:20 this is the offeryng of Aaron and his sonnes whych he shal offer vnto the Lord in the day when they are anoynted: the tenth part of an Epha of flour, which is a daily meatoffring perpetually: halfe in the mornyng & halfe at nyght:
Leviticus 6:21 & in the frying panne it shal be made wyth oyle. And when it is fryed, thou shalte brynge it in as a baken meatofferynge mynsed small, & shalt offer it for a swete sauoure vnto the Lord.
Leviticus 6:22 And that priest of hys sonnes that is anoynted in hys stede shall offer it: & it shalbe the Lordes dutye for euer, & it shall be burnt altogyther.
Leviticus 6:23 For al the meatofferinges of the prestes shal be burnt altogither, & shal not be eaten.
Leviticus 6:24 And the Lord talked wyth Moses sayinge:
Leviticus 6:25 speake vnto Aaron & vnto hys sonnes & say: This is the law of the sinne offring. In the place wher the burnt offring is killed shall the synne offering be killed also before the Lord, for it is moste holy.
Leviticus 6:26 The prieste that offereth it shall eat it in the holye place: euen in the court of the tabernacle of wytnes.
Leviticus 6:27 No man shal touch the flesh therof saue he that is halowed. And if any raimente be sprynkeled therwyth, it shalbe washed in the holy, place,
Leviticus 6:28 & the earthen pot that it is soden in shalbe broken. If it be sodden in brasse then the potte shalbe scoured & rynsed in the water.
Leviticus 6:29 All the males amonge the priestes shall eate thereof for it is mooste holye.
Leviticus 6:30 Notwythstandynge no synne offeryng that hathe hys bloude brought into the tabernacle of wytnesse to reconcyle wythall in the holye place, shall be eaten: but shal be burnt in the fyre.

CHAPTER: 7

Leviticus 7:1 This is the law of the trespace offeryug whych is moste holy.
Leviticus 7:2 In the place where the burnte offering is kylled, the trespace offeryng shall be kylled also: & hys bloud shalbe sprinkeled round about vpon the aultare.
Leviticus 7:3 And all the fat thereof shalbe offered: the rompe and the fatt that couereth the inwardes,
Leviticus 7:4 and the two kydneys wt the fatt that lyeth on them & vpon the loynes & the kall on the liuer shal be taken away wt the kydneys:
Leviticus 7:5 & the prieste shall burne theym vpon the aultare to be an offerynge vnto the Lorde, this is a trespace offeryng.
Leviticus 7:6 Al the males amonge the priestes shall eate therof in the holy place, for it is moste holy
Leviticus 7:7 As the synne offerynge is, so is the trespaceofferyng, one lawe serueth for both: & it shall be the priestes that reconcileth therwyth.
Leviticus 7:8 And the priest that offered a mans burntoffering, shall haue the skynne of the burnt offeryng whych he hath offred.
Leviticus 7:9 And al the meatofferynges that are baken in the ouen, and all that is dressed vppon the gredyren and in fryinge panne, shal be the priestes that offereth them.
Leviticus 7:10 And all the meat offerynges that are myngled wt oyle or drye, shall pertayne vnto all the sonnes of Aaron, & one shal haue as muche as an other.
Leviticus 7:11 Thys is the lawe of the peaceofferinges which shalbe offered to the Lorde.
Leviticus 7:12 If he offer to gyue thanckes, he shal bryng vnto hys thanke offeringe: swete cakes mingled wyth oyle and swete wafers anoynted wyth oyle, & cakes mingled wyth oyle of fyne flower fryed,
Leviticus 7:13 & he shal bring his offeryng vpon cakes made of leuended bread vnto the thankeoffering of his peace offeringes
Leviticus 7:14 and of them al he shal offer one to be an heueofferynge vnto the Lorde, and it shall be the Priestes that sprynkeleth the bloude of the peaceofferynges.
Leviticus 7:15 And the flesh of the thankeoffering of his peaceofferinges shalbe eaten the same day that it is offered, and there shal none of it be layed vp vntil the mornyng.
Leviticus 7:16 If it be a vowe or a fre wyloffringe that he bryngeth, the same daye that he offereth it it shal be eaten, & that which remaineth may be eaten on the morowe:
Leviticus 7:17 but as much of the offered flesh as remaineth vnto the third day shalbe burnt with fyre.
Leviticus 7:18 For if ani of the flesh of the peaceofferynges be eaten in the thirde day, then shal he that offred it optayne no fauour, neyther shall it be rekened vnto hym: but shall be an abhomination, and the soule that eateth of it shal beare the sinne therof.
Leviticus 7:19 The fleshe that toucheth any vncleane thing shall not be eaten, but burnte wyth fyre: & all that be cleane in theyr flesh, may eat flesh.
Leviticus 7:20 If any soule eat of the flesh of the peace offrings that pertaine vnto the Lorde, & his vncleannesse yet vpon hym, the same Soule shal peryshe from amonge hys people.
Leviticus 7:21 Moreouer if a soule touch any vncleane thing, whether it be the vnclennes of man or of any vncleane beast, or of any abhomination that is vnclene and then eat of the fleshe of the peaceofferynges which pertaine vnto the Lord, that soule shal peryshe from his people.
Leviticus 7:22 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Leviticus 7:23 speake vnto the chyldren of Israel and saye: Ye shal eate no maner fatte of oxen, shepe or gotes,
Leviticus 7:24 neuerthelater that fatte of the beast that dyeth alone & the fatt of that whych is torne with wylde beastes, maye be occupied in all maner vses: but ye shall in no wyse eat of it.
Leviticus 7:25 For whosoeuer eateth the fat of the beast of which men bryng an offeryng vnto that Lord, that soule that eateth it shall perish from his people.
Leviticus 7:26 Moreouer ye shall eate no maner of bloud, wherso euer ye dwel, whether it be of foule or of beast.
Leviticus 7:27 Whatsoeuer soule it be that eateth anye maner of bloude the same soule shall perysh from hys people.
Leviticus 7:28 And the Lord talked with Moses saying:
Leviticus 7:29 speake vnto the children of Israel & say: he that offereth his peaceoffring vnto the Lord, shal bryng his gyfte vnto the Lord of hys peaceofferynges,
Leviticus 7:30 hys owne handes shal bring the offeryng of the Lord: euen the fatt vpon the breast he shal bryng with the breast to waue it a waueofferynge before the Lord.
Leviticus 7:31 And the priest shal burne the fatt vpon the alter, & the breast shalbe Aarons & his sonnes.
Leviticus 7:32 And the right shoulder they shal geue vnto the priest, to be an heueoffringe, of their peaceofferinges.
Leviticus 7:33 And the same that offereth the bloude of the peace offerynges and the fatte, amonge the sonnes of Aaron shall haue the ryght shoulder vnto hys parte,
Leviticus 7:34 for the waue breast, & the heue shoulder I haue taken of the chyldren of Israell, euen of theyr peaceofferynges, & haue geuen it vnto Aaron the priest and vnto hys sonnes: to be a dutye for euer of the children of Israel.
Leviticus 7:35 This is the anoyntynge of Aaron & of the sacrifices of the Lord, in the day when they were offered to the priestes vnto the Lorde,
Leviticus 7:36 which the Lord commaunded to be geuen them in the day when he anoynted them, of the children of Israel, & to be a duty for euer amonge theyr generations,
Leviticus 7:37 This is the lawe of burntofferynges, of meateofferynges, of sinne offerynges, of trespace offerynges, of ful offerynges, of peace offeringes,
Leviticus 7:38 which the Lord commaunded Moses in the mount of Sinai, in the day when he commaunded the chyldren of Israel to offer theyr offerynges vnto the Lord in the wyldernes of Sinai.

CHAPTER: 8

Leviticus 8:1 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses saying:
Leviticus 8:2 take Aaron and his sonnes wyth hym, and the vestures, and the anointyng oyle and an oxe for a synne offering and two rammes, & a basket of swete bread:
Leviticus 8:3 and gather all the comentye togyther vnto the dore of the Tabernacle of wytnes.
Leviticus 8:4 And Moses dyd as the Lorde commaunded him, & the people gathered them selues togyther vnto the dore of the tabernacle of wytnes.
Leviticus 8:5 And Moses sayed vnto the people: thys is the thing which the Lord commaunded to do.
Leviticus 8:6 And Moses brought Aaron & his sonnes & washed them with water,
Leviticus 8:7 & put vpon him the albe & gyrded hym wyth a gyrdle, & put vpon hym the tunicle, & put the Ephod theron, and gyrded hym with the brodered gyrdle of the Ephod, and bound it vnto hym therwt.
Leviticus 8:8 And he put the brestlappe theron, and put in the breastlappe Vrim & Thumim.
Leviticus 8:9 And he put the miter vpon his heade, & put vpon the myter euen vpon the forefront of it, the golden plate of the holy crowne, as the Lord commaunded Moses.
Leviticus 8:10 And Moses toke the anoyntyng oyle and anoynted the habitation & al that was therin, and sanctified them,
Leviticus 8:11 & sprinkeled therof vpon the alter seuen tymes, and anoynted the alter & all his vessels, & the lauer wyth his fote, to sanctifye them.
Leviticus 8:12 And he poured of the anoyntynge oyle vpon Aarons heade, & anoynted hym to sanctify hym.
Leviticus 8:13 And he brought Aarons sonnes and put albes vpon them, and gyrded them wyth gyrdelles, and put bonetes vpon theyr heades: as the Lorde commaunded Moses.
Leviticus 8:14 And the synne offeryng was brought. And Aaron and his sonns put their handes vpon the head of the oxe of the sinne offering.
Leviticus 8:15 And when it was slaine, Moses toke of the bloude and put it vpon the hornes of the alter round aboute wt hys finger, & purified it, & poured the bloud vnto the botome of the alter, & sanctified it & reconciled it.
Leviticus 8:16 And he toke all the fatt that was vpon the inwardes, & the kall that was on the lyuer and the two kydneys with their fatt, & burned it vpon the alter.
Leviticus 8:17 But the oxe, the hyde, hys flesh and his donge, he burnt with fyre wtout the hoste, as the Lord commaunded Moses.
Leviticus 8:18 And he brought the ram of the burntoffryng & Aaron & hys sonnes put theyr handes vpon the head of the ram,
Leviticus 8:19 & it was killed. And Moses sprynkeled the bloud vpon the alter round aboute,
Leviticus 8:20 and cut the ram in peces & burnt the head, the peces, & the fatte,
Leviticus 8:21 & washed the inwardes & the legges in water, and burnt the ram euery whyt vpon the alter. That was a burnte Sacrifice of a swete sauoure, and an offeryng vnto the Lorde, as the Lorde commaunded Moses.
Leviticus 8:22 And he brought the other ram that was the fulofferyng, & Aaron & hys sonnes put their handes vpon the head of the ram:
Leviticus 8:23 and when it was slayne, Moses toke of the bloude of it, and put it vpon the typpe of Aarons ryght eare, and vpon the thombe of his right hand & vpon the great too of hys right fote.
Leviticus 8:24 Then were Aarons sonnes broughte, and Moses put of the bloude on the typpe of the ryghte eare of them, and vpon the thombes of their ryght handes, and vpon the greate tooes of theyr right fete, and sprinkled the bloud vpon the alter round about.
Leviticus 8:25 And he toke the fatt and the rompe and al the fatt that was vpon the inwardes, & the kall of the liuer, & the .ij. kidneys with their fatt and theyr right shoulder.
Leviticus 8:26 And out of the basket of swete breade that was before the Lord, he toke one swete cake of oyled breade and one wafer, put them on the fatt and vpon the ryght shoulder:
Leviticus 8:27 & put altogither vpon Aarons handes & vpon his sonnes handes, and waued it a waue offeryng before the Lorde.
Leviticus 8:28 And then Moses toke theym from of theyr handes agayne, and burnte theym vpon the aulter, euen vpon the burnt offeryng: These are the fulofferynges of a swete sauoure & a sacrifice vnto the Lorde.
Leviticus 8:29 And Moses toke the breste & waued it a waue offering before the Lorde, of the ram of the fulofferynges: and it was Moses part, as the Lord commaunded Moses.
Leviticus 8:30 And Moses toke the anoyntyng oyle and of the bloud which was vpon the alter, and sprinkled it vpon Aaron & vpon his vestimentes & vpon his sons, & on their vestimentes wyth him, & sanctified Aaron & hys vestures & his sonnes & his sonnes vestures also.
Leviticus 8:31 Then Moses sayd vnto Aaron & his sonnes: boyle the flesh in the dore of the tabernacle of wytnes & there eate it wyth the breade that is in the basket of fulofferyngs, as the Lord commaunded saying: Aaron and hys sonnes shall eate it:
Leviticus 8:32 & that whiche remayneth of the fleshe and of the bread, burne it with fyre.
Leviticus 8:33 And se that ye departe not from the doore of the tabernacle of witnes seuen daies longe vntil the dayes of your ful offerynges be at an ende. For seuen daies must your hands be filled,
Leviticus 8:34 as they were this day: euen so the Lord hath commaunded to do, to reconcyle you with all.
Leviticus 8:35 Se therfore that ye abyde in the dore of the tabernacle of wytnes day & nyght seuen dayes longe, & kepe the watch of the Lorde that ye dye not, for soo I am commaunded.
Leviticus 8:36 And Aaron and hys sonnes dyd all thynges whyche the Lorde commaunded by the hand of Moses.

CHAPTER: 9

Leviticus 9:1 And the .viij. day Moses called Aaron and his sonnes, and the elders of Israel,
Leviticus 9:2 and said vnto Aaron, take a calfe for a synne offeryng, and a Ramme for a burntoffering: both without blemish, & bring them before the Lord.
Leviticus 9:3 And vnto the children of Israel he spake saying: take ye an he gote for a synne offering, & a calfe & a lambe both two of a yere olde, & wythout blemysh for a burnt sacrifice,
Leviticus 9:4 & an oxe & a ram for a peaceofferinges to offer before the lord, & a meatoffering mingled with oile, for to day the Lord wyll appeare vnto you.
Leviticus 9:5 And they broughte that which Moses commaunded to the tabernacle of witnes, & al the people came & stode before the Lorde.
Leviticus 9:6 And Moses said, thys is the thyng whych the Lord commaunded that ye should do, and then the glory of the Lord shal appeare vnto you.
Leviticus 9:7 And Moses said vnto Aaron: go vnto the alter & offer thy synne offeryng, & make an atonemente for the and for the people: and then offer the offeryng of the people, and reconcyle theym also, as the Lord commaunded Moses.
Leviticus 9:8 And Aaron went vnto the aulter, & slewe the calfe that was his sinne offring.
Leviticus 9:9 And the sonnes of Aaron broughte the bloude vnto hym, & he dypt hys fingers in the bloud and put it vpon the hornes of the alter, & poured the bloud vnto the bottome of the alter.
Leviticus 9:10 And the fatte & the two kydneys wyth the kall of the lyuer of the synneofferyng, he burnt vpon the aulter as the Lorde commaunded Moses:
Leviticus 9:11 but the fleshe & the hyde, he burnte with fyre wythout the hoste.
Leviticus 9:12 Afterwarde he slewe the burntoffering, & Aarons sonnes brought the bloud vnto hym, and he sprinkeled it rounde about vpon the aulter.
Leviticus 9:13 And they brought the burntofferyng vnto hym in peces & the head also, and he burnte it vpon the aulter,
Leviticus 9:14 & dyd washe the inwardes and the legges, & burnt them also vpon the burntoffering in the alter.
Leviticus 9:15 And then he brought the peoples offering & toke the goote that was the peoples synne offering, & slewe it & offered it for a sinne offering: as he dyd she fyrst.
Leviticus 9:16 And then brought the burnt offeryng, & offered it as the maner was,
Leviticus 9:17 & brought the meat offering & filled his hand therof, & burnt it vpon the alter, besyde the burnt sacrifice in the morninge.
Leviticus 9:18 Then he slewe the oxe & the ram that were the peoples peaceofferynges, & Aarons sonnes brought the bloud vnto hym, & he sprynkled it vpon the alter round aboute,
Leviticus 9:19 and toke the fatt of the oxe & of the ram: the rompe & the fatt that couereth the inwardes and the kidneyes & the cal of the liuer:
Leviticus 9:20 & put them vpon the breastes & burnt it vpon the alter:
Leviticus 9:21 but the breastes & the ryght shoulders Aaron waued before the Lord, as the Lorde commaunded Moses.
Leviticus 9:22 And Aaron lyft vp hys hand ouer the people & blessed them, and came down from offering of syn offeringes, burntofferings, & peace offerynges.
Leviticus 9:23 Then Moses & Aaron went into the tabernacle of wytnes and came out agayne and blessed the people, and the glory of the Lord appered vnto al the people.
Leviticus 9:24 And there came a fyre out from before the Lord, & consumed vpon the alter the burntofferyng and the fatt. And all the people sawe it, and showted, and fell on theyr faces.

CHAPTER: 10

Leviticus 10:1 And Nadab and Abihu the Sonnes of Aaron toke eyther of theym hys censor, and putte fyre therin, and put cense vpon and brought straunge fyre before the Lord: which he commaunded them not,
Leviticus 10:2 and ther went a fyre out from the Lord, and consumed them, & they dyed before the Lorde.
Leviticus 10:3 Then Moses sayed vnto Aaron: this is that the Lorde spake saying: I wyl be sanctified in them that come nye me, & before all the people I wil be glorified. And Aaron helde hys peace.
Leviticus 10:4 And Moses called Misael and Elisaphan the sonnes of Oziel the vncle of Aaron, and sayed vnto them: goo and carye youre brethren from the holy place out of the host.
Leviticus 10:5 And they went to theym, and caried them in their albes out of the host, as Moses bade.
Leviticus 10:6 And Moses said vnto Aaron & vnto Eleazar & Ithamar his eldest sonnes: vncouer not your heades, neither rent your clothes, lest ye dye and wrath come vpon all the people, let your brethren the whole house of Israell bewepe the burnynge whyche the Lorde hathe burnt.
Leviticus 10:7 But go ye not out from the dore of the tabernacle of wytnes, least ye dye: for the anoyntyng oyle of the Lord is vpon you. And they dyd as Moses bad.
Leviticus 10:8 And the Lord spake vnto Aaron sayinge:
Leviticus 10:9 dryncke no wyne, no strong drynke, neither thou nor thy sonnes wyth the: when ye go into the tabernacle of wytnes, lest ye dye. And let it be a lawe for euer vnto youre chyldren after you:
Leviticus 10:10 that ye may put difference betwene holy & vnholi, & betwene vncleane & cleane,
Leviticus 10:11 and that ye may teach the chyldren of Israel al the ordinances whych the Lord hath commaunded them by the handes of Moses.
Leviticus 10:12 And Moses sayed vnto Aaron and vnto Eliazar & Ithamer his sons that were lefte: take the meatoffering that remayneth of the sacrifices of the Lorde, and eat it without leuen besyde the alter, for it is most holy:
Leviticus 10:13 eat it therfore in the holye place, because it is thy dutie and thy sonnes dutie of the sacrifice of the Lorde: for so I am commaunded.
Leviticus 10:14 And the wauebrest and heueshoulder eate in a cleane place: both thou, & thy sonnes, & thy daughters with the. For it is thy duty & thy sonnes duty with the, of the peace offerynges of the children of Israel.
Leviticus 10:15 For the heueshoulder & the wauebreast whyche they bryng wyth the sacrifices of the fat to waue it before the Lord shall be thyne and thy sonnes wyth the and be a lawe for euer, as the Lorde hath commaunded.
Leviticus 10:16 And Moses sought for the goote that was the synne offeryng, and se it was burnt. And he was angry wyth Eliazar & Ithamar the sonnes of Aaron, whyche were lefte a lyue saying:
Leviticus 10:17 wherfore haue ye not eaten the sinne offeryng in the holy place, seynge it is moste holy: and for as muche as it is geuen you to beare the sinne of the people, and make agrement for them before the Lord?
Leviticus 10:18 Beholde, the bloude of it was not brought in wythin the holy place, therfore should ye haue eaten it in the holy place as I commaunded.
Leviticus 10:19 And Aaron sayed vnto Moses: beholde thys daye haue they offred theyr sinne offering & their burntoffering before the Lord, and it is chaunced me after thys maner. If I shold eat of the synne offeryng to day, would the Lord be content wythal.
Leviticus 10:20 And when Moses hearde that he was content.

CHAPTER: 11

Leviticus 11:1 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses and Aaron sayinge,
Leviticus 11:2 speake vnto the children of Israel and say, these are the beastes which shall eate amonge all the beastes that are on the earth:
Leviticus 11:3 whatsoeuer hathe hoofe and deuideth it into two clawes and chewe cudde amonge the beastes that shall ye eate.
Leviticus 11:4 Neuertheles, these shall ye not eate of them that chewe cud and haue hoofes. The camel for he cheweth cud but he deuyded not the hoofe into two clawes, therfore he shall be vncleane vnto you.
Leviticus 11:5 And the cony for he cheweth the cud but deuideth not the hoofe into two clawes, therefore he is vncleane to you.
Leviticus 11:6 And the hare, for he lykewyse cheweth the cud, but deuideth not the hoofe into .ij. clawes, he is therfore vnclene to you.
Leviticus 11:7 And the swyne, for thoughe he deuyde the hooffe into two clawes, yet he cheweth not the cudde, and therfore is vncleane to you.
Leviticus 11:8 Of theyr fleshe se that ye eate not, and theyr carkasses se that ye touche not, for they are vncleane to you.
Leviticus 11:9 These shal ye eate of al that are in the waters: whatsoeuer hath fynnes & skales in the waters, seas, & ryuers, that shal ye eat.
Leviticus 11:10 And all that haue not fynnes & skales in the seas & ryuers of al that moue and lyue in the waters shal ye abhorre.
Leviticus 11:11 Se that ye eate not of theyr flesh, and also that ye abhore theyr carkases:
Leviticus 11:12 for all that haue no fynnes nor scales in the waters, shalbe abhomination vnto you
Leviticus 11:13 These are the foules which ye shal abhorre, & whych shal not be eaten, for they are an abhomination. The egle, the goshauke, the cormoraunte,
Leviticus 11:14 the kyete, the vulture & al his kind
Leviticus 11:15 & all kynde of rauens,
Leviticus 11:16 the estriche, the nightcrowe, the cocow, the sparowhauke, & al the kynde:
Leviticus 11:17 the lytle oule, the storcke, the greate oule,
Leviticus 11:18 the backe, the pellicane, the pye,
Leviticus 11:19 the heron, the iay with the kynd, the lapwyng, and the swalowe.
Leviticus 11:20 And all foules that crepe & go vpon al foure shalbe an abhomination to you.
Leviticus 11:21 Yet these may ye eate of al the foules that moue and go vpon .iiij. fete: euen those that haue no knees aboue vpon theyr fete to lepe wyth al vpon the erth,
Leviticus 11:22 euen these of them ye maye eate: the arbe & al hys kynde: the Selaam with al hys kynde: the Hargol and all the kynde, the Hagab and all hys kynde.
