Numbers 16:29 If these men dye the commen death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men, then the Lorde hathe not sent me.
Numbers 16:30 But and if the Lorde make a newe thyng, and the earth open hyr mouth & swalowe theim, and all that pertayne vnto them, so that they go downe quicke vnto hel: then ye shal vnderstand, that these men haue rayled vpon the Lord.
Numbers 16:31 And assone as he hadde made an ende of speakyng al these wordes, the ground cloue a sunder that was vnder them,
Numbers 16:32 and the earth opened hyr mouth and swalowed them and theyr houses, and al menne that were wyth Corah and al theyr goodes.
Numbers 16:33 And they and all that pertained vnto them, went downe aliue vnto hell, and the earth closed vppon theim and they peryshed from amonge the congregation.
Numbers 16:34 Ad all Israel that were aboute them fledde at the cry of them. For they said: The earth myght haply swalow vs vp also.
Numbers 16:35 And there came out a fyre from the Lord and consumed the two hundred and fyftye men that offered cense.
Numbers 16:36 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Numbers 16:37 Speake vnto Eleazar the sonne of Aaron the prieste and lette hym take vp the censers oute of the burnynge & scatter the fyre here and there,
Numbers 16:38 for the censers of the synners are halowed in theyr deathes: and let them be beaten, into thyne plates and fastened vpon the alter. For they offered theim before the Lorde, and therfore they are holye and they shalbe a sygne vnto the children of Israel.
Numbers 16:39 And Eleazar the Prieste toke the brasen censers whych they that were burnt had offered, & beate them and fastened them vpon the alter,
Numbers 16:40 to be a remembraunce vnto the children of Israel, that no straunger which is not of the seed of Aaron, come nere to offer cense before the Lord, that he be not made lyke vnto Corah and hys companye: as the Lord sayd vnto hym by the hand of Moses.
Numbers 16:41 And on the morrowe all the multitude of the chyldren of Israell murmured agaynste Moses and Aaron sayinge: ye haue kylled the people of the Lorde.
Numbers 16:42 And when the multitude was gathered against Moses & Aaron thei loked toward the tabernacle of witnes. And beholde, the cloude had couered it and the glory of the Lord appeared.
Numbers 16:43 And Moses & Aaron went before the tabernacle of wytnesse.
Numbers 16:44 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Numbers 16:45 Get you from this congregation, that I may consume them quyckely. And they fel vpon theyr faces.
Numbers 16:46 And Moses sayd vnto Aaron: take a censer, and put fyre therein out of the alter, and poure on cense, and go quickely vnto the congregation and make an atonement for them For there is wrath gone out from the Lord and ther is a plage begone.
Numbers 16:47 And Aaron toke as Moses commaunded hym, and ran vnto the congregation, & beholde, the plage was begonne amonge the people, and he putt on cense, & made an atonemente for the people.
Numbers 16:48 And he stode betwene the deade, & them that were a lyue and the plage ceased.
Numbers 16:49 And the numbre of them that dyed in the plage, were .xiiij. thousand and seuen hundred: beside them that dyed about the busines of Corah.
Numbers 16:50 And Aaron wente againe vnto Moses vnto the dore of the Tabernacle of wytnesse, and the plage ceased.

CHAPTER: 17

Numbers 17:1 And the Lord spake vnto Moses sayinge:
Numbers 17:2 speake vnto the chyldren of Israel and take of them for euery principal house a rodde, of theyr prynces ouer the houses of their fathers: euen .xij. roddes, & write euery mans name vpon his rod.
Numbers 17:3 And write Aaron a name vpon the state of Leui: for euerye headman ouer the house of theyr fathers shal haue a rodde.
Numbers 17:4 And put them in the tabernacle of wytnesse where I wyll mete you.
Numbers 17:5 And hys rodde whome I chose, shall blossome: So I wyl make cease from me the grudgynges of the chyldren of Israel whyche they grudge agaynst you.
Numbers 17:6 And Moses spake vnto the chyldren of Israel, and al the princes gaue him for euery prynce ouer theyr fathers houses, a rod: euen .xij. rods, and the rod of Aaron was among the roddes.
Numbers 17:7 And Moses put the roddes before the Lord in the tabernacle of witnes.
Numbers 17:8 And on the morow, Moses wente into the tabernacle: and beholde the rodd of Aaron of the house of Leuy was budded & bare blossoms and almondes.
Numbers 17:9 And Moses brought out all the staues frome before the Lorde, vnto all the children of Israel, & they loked vpon them and toke euery man hys staffe.
Numbers 17:10 And the Lorde sayed vnto Moses: bryng Aarons rod agayne before the wytnes to be kepte for a token vnto the chyldren of rebellyon, that theyr murmurynges may cease fro me, that they dye not.
Numbers 17:11 And Moses did as the Lorde commaunded hym.
Numbers 17:12 And the chyldren of Israell spake vnto Moses sayinge: beholde, wee are destroyed and all come to nought:
Numbers 17:13 for whosoeuer cometh nye the dwellynge of the Lorde, dyeth. Shall we vtterlye consume away.

CHAPTER: 18

Numbers 18:1 And the Lorde sayed vnto Aaron. Thou and thy sonnes, and thy fathers house wyth the, shall bear the faulte of that whyche is done amysse in the holye place. And thou & thy sonnes wyth the, shal beare the fault of that whyche is done amysse in your priesthode.
Numbers 18:2 And thy brethren also the trybe of Leui, the trybe of thy father take wyth the, and let them be ioyned vnto the, and minister vnto the. And thou and thy sonnes wyth the shall minister before the tabernacle of wytnes.
Numbers 18:3 And let them wayte vp the & vpon al the tabernacle: onely let them not come nye the holy vesselles & the alter, that boeth they & ye also dye not.
Numbers 18:4 And let them be by the and wayte on the tabernacle of wytnesse, and on all the seruyce of the tabernacle, and let no straunger come nye vnto you.
Numbers 18:5 Wayte therfore vpon the holy place and vpon the alter, that there fal no more wrath vpon the chyldren of Israel:
Numbers 18:6 behold, I haue taken youre brethren the Leuites frome amonge the chyldren of Israell, to be yours, as gyftes geuen vnto the Lord to do the seruyce of the tabernacle of wytnesse.
Numbers 18:7 And se that both thou and thy sonnes wyth the take hede vnto your priestes offyce, in al thinges that pertayne vnto the alter, and wythin the vayle. And se that ye serue, for I haue geuen youre prestes offyce vnto you for a gifte to do seruyce, and the straunger that commeth nye, shall dye.
Numbers 18:8 And the Lorde spake vnto Aaron: behold I haue geuen the, the kepyng of mine heueofferynges in al the halowed thynges of the chyldren of Israel. And vnto the I haue geuen them vnto anoyntynge and to thy sonnes: to be a dutye for euer.
Numbers 18:9 Thys shall be thyne of most holy sacrifices. Al theyr giftes, thorow out al their meateofferynges synofferinges and trespace offerynges whyche they bringe vnto me. They shall be most holy vnto the & vnto thy sonnes.
Numbers 18:10 And ye shal eat it in the most holy place: all that are males shall eate of it for it shal be holye vnto the.
Numbers 18:11 And this shalbe thine: the heueofferinges of theyr gyftes, thorowout all the waueofferynges of the chyldren of Israel, for I haue geuen them to the, & thy sonnes, & thy daughters wyth the to be a dutye for euer: and all that are cleane in thy house, shall eate of it,
Numbers 18:12 al the fatt of the oyle, of the wyne and of the corne theyr fyrste frutes whych they geue vnto the Lorde that haue I geuen vnto the.
Numbers 18:13 The first frutes of all that is in theyr Landes whyche they brynge vnto the Lorde, shall be thyne: and all that are cleane in thyne house, shall eate of it.
Numbers 18:14 Al dedicate thynges in Israel, shalbe thine
Numbers 18:15 All that breaketh the matryce of all fleshe that men brynge vnto the Lorde, both of man and beast, shall be thyne. Neuerthelater the fyrst borne of man shall be redemed, and the fyrst borne of vncleane beastes shal be redemed.
Numbers 18:16 And theyr redemptions shall be at a moneth olde, valued at fyue sycles of siluer, of the holye sycle. A sycle maketh twentye Geras.
Numbers 18:17 But the fyrst borne of oxen, shepe, & gotes shall not be redemed. For they are holy, and thou shalt sprinkle theyr bloud vpon the alter, and shalt bourne their fat to be a sacrifice of a swete sauour vnto the Lord.
Numbers 18:18 And the fleshe of them shal be thyne, as the wauebrest & all the ryght shoulder is thyne
Numbers 18:19 al the holy heaueofferinges whych the chyldren of Israel heaue vnto the Lorde, I gyue the and thy sonnes and thy daughters with the to be a duti foreuer. And it shalbe a salted couenaunte for euer, before the Lorde: vnto the and thy seed wyth the.
Numbers 18:20 And the Lorde spake vnto Aaron: thou shalt haue none enheritaunce in theyr Land nor parte amonge them. For I am thy parte and thy enheritaunce amonge the children of Israel.
Numbers 18:21 And behold I haue geuen the children of Leuy, the tenthe in Israell to enherite, for the seruice whych they serue in the tabernacle of wytnesse,
Numbers 18:22 that the chyldren of Israell henceforth come not nye the Tabernacle of wytnesse, and beare synne and dye.
Numbers 18:23 And the Leuites shal do the seruyce in the tabernacle of wytnes and beare theyr synne, & it shal be a lawe for euer vnto youre chyldrene after you: But amonge the children of Israel they shall enherete none enherytannce.
Numbers 18:24 For the tythes of the chyldren of Israell whych they heaue vnto the Lorde, I haue geuen the Leuites to enherite. Wherfore I haue said vnto them: Among the children of Israel ye shal enherite none enheritaunce.
Numbers 18:25 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Numbers 18:26 speake vnto the Leuites and say vnto them: when ye take of the chyldren of Israel the tithes whych I haue geuen you of them to your enheritaunce, ye shall take an heaueoffering of that same for the Lorde: euen the tenthe of that tythe.
Numbers 18:27 And it shall be rekened vnto you for your heaueofferynge, euen as though ye gaue corne out of the barne or a fulofferyng from the wyne presse.
Numbers 18:28 And of this maner ye shal heaue an heaueofferynge vnto the Lorde, of all your tythes whyche ye receyue of the chyldren of Israel and ye shal gyue therof the lordes heaueofferyng vnto Aaron the prieste.
Numbers 18:29 Of all your giftes, ye shal take out of the Lordes heaueofferynge: euen the fatt of all theyr halowed thynges.
Numbers 18:30 And thou shalte saye vnto them: when ye haue take away the fatt of it from it, it shal be counted vnto the Leuytes, as the encrease of corne and wyne.
Numbers 18:31 And ye shall eate it in all places both ye and youre housholdes, for it is youre rewarde for youre seruice in the tabernacle of wytnesse.
Numbers 18:32 And ye shall beare no synne by the reason of it, when ye haue taken from it the fatte of it, neyther shall ye vnhalowe the halowed thynges of the chyldren of Israel, and so shal ye not dye.

CHAPTER: 19

Numbers 19:1 And the Lord spake vnto Moses and Aaron saynge:
Numbers 19:2 this is the ordinaunce of the lawe whiche the Lorde commaundeth sayinge, speake vnto the chyldren of Israell and let them take the a redde kowe wythout spotte wherin is no blemish and whyche neuer bare yocke vpon hyr.
Numbers 19:3 And ye shal gyue hyr vnto Eliazar the priest and he shall bryng hyr wythout the host and cause hyr to be slayne before hym.
Numbers 19:4 And Eliazar the Prieste shall take of hyr bloud vpon his finger, & sprynkle it strayght toward the tabernacle of witnes .vij. times. And he shall cause the kowe to be burnt in hys syght:
Numbers 19:5 both skinne flesh and bloud, with the doung also.
Numbers 19:6 And let the priest take Cedar wodd, and Isope and purple cloth, and cast it vpon the kowe as she burneth.
Numbers 19:7 And let the priest wash hys clothes and bath his flesh in water, & then come into the host, & the prieste shalbe vncleane vnto the euen.
Numbers 19:8 And he that burneth hyr, shall wash hys clothes in water & bath hys flesh also in water and be vncleane vntil euen.
Numbers 19:9 And one that is cleane shall goo and take vp the ashes of the kowe, and put them wythout the host in a cleane place, where they shall be kepte to make sprinkelynge water for the multitude of the children of Israel: for it is a synoffering
Numbers 19:10 And let hym that gathered the ashes of the kowe wash his clothes, & remaine vncleane vntyll euen. And thys shall be vnto the children of Israell and vnto the straunger that dwelleth amonge them, a maner for euer.
Numbers 19:11 He that toucheth any dead person, shall be vncleane .vij. dayes.
Numbers 19:12 And he shal purify him selfe wyth the ashes the thyrd daye and then he shall be cleane the seuenth day. And if he purify not hym selfe the thyrde daye, then the seueuth daye, he shal not be cleane.
Numbers 19:13 Whosoeuer toucheth any person that dyeth & sprinkeleth not hym self, defileth the dwelling of the Lord: & therfore that soul shalbe roted out of Israel, bicause he hath not sprynkled the sprinkelynge water vpon hym he shal be vncleane, and hys vncleannesse shal raygne vpon hym.
Numbers 19:14 This is the lawe of the man that dyeth in a tent: al that come into the tente and all that is in the tent, shalbe vnclene .vij. dayes.
Numbers 19:15 And al the vessels that be open which haue no lid nor coueryng vpon them, are vncleane.
Numbers 19:16 And whasoeuer toucheth one that is slayne wyth a swerde in the feldes, or a dead person, or a bone of a deade man, or a graue: shall be vncleane .vij. dayes.
Numbers 19:17 And they shall take for an vncleane person of the burnt ashes of the synofferynge, & put runnynge water therto into a vessel,
Numbers 19:18 And a cleane person shal take Isope & dippe it in the water, and sprinkle it vpon the tente & vpon al the vessels & on the soules that were there, & vpon hym that toucheth a bone or a slaine person or a dead body or a graue.
Numbers 19:19 And the cleane person shal sprinkle vpon the vncleane the thyrde daye and the seuenth daye. And the seuenth day he shall purify him selfe and washe hys clothes and bathe hym selfe in water, and shalbe cleane at euen.
Numbers 19:20 If any be vncleane & sprinkle not him selfe the same soule shalbe destroied from among the congregation: for he hath defiled the holy place of the Lorde & is not sprinkeled wyth sprynling water, therfore is he vncleane. And this shalbe a perpetual lawe vnto them. And he that sprynkeleth the sprinkelyng water, shal wash his clothes.
Numbers 19:21 And he that toucheth the sprynklyng water shall be vncleane vntyll euen.
Numbers 19:22 And whatsoeuer the vncleane person toucheth, shal be vncleane. And the soule that toucheth it shal be vncleane vntil the euen.

CHAPTER: 20

Numbers 20:1 And the whole multitude of the chyldren of Israell, came into the deserte of Syn in the fyrste moneth, and the people dwelt at Cades. And ther dyed MirIam, and was buried ther.
Numbers 20:2 Moreouer there was no water for the multitude, wherefore they gathered them selues togyther againste Moses and againste Aaron.
Numbers 20:3 And the people chode wt Moses & spake saying: wolde God that we had perished when our brethren perished before the Lord.
Numbers 20:4 Whi haue ye brought the congregation of the Lord vnto this wildernes that both we & our cattel should dye here?
Numbers 20:5 Wherfore brought ye vs out of Egipt to bring vs into this vngratious place, whiche is no place of seed nor of figes nor vines nor of pomgranates, neyther is there anye water to drynke.
Numbers 20:6 And Moses & Aaron went from the congregation vnto the dore of the tabernacle of witnes, and fel vpon their faces. And the glory of the Lord appered vnto them.
Numbers 20:7 And the Lord spake vnto Moses, sayinge:
Numbers 20:8 take thy staffe, & gather thou & thy brother Aaron the congregation togither, & say vnto the rocke before their eyes, that he geue forth his water. And thou shalt brynge them water oute of the rocke & shalt gyue the companye dryncke and theyr beastes also.
Numbers 20:9 And Moses toke the staffe from before the Lord as he commaunded hym.
Numbers 20:10 And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation togither before the rocke, and he sayd vnto them here ye rebellious, muste we fette you water out of thys rocke?
Numbers 20:11 And Moses lyfte vp hys handes wyth hys staffe, and smote the rocke two tymes, and the water came oute abundauntly, and the multitude dranke and the beastes also.
Numbers 20:12 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses & Aaron: bicause ye beleued me not to sanctify me in the eyes of the chyldren of Israel, therfore ye shall not brynge thys congregation into the land which I haue geuen them.
Numbers 20:13 This is the water of stryfe, bicause the children of Israel stroue wyth the Lord, and he was sanctified vpon them.
Numbers 20:14 And Moses sente messengers from Cades vnto the kyng of Edom. Thus sayeth thy brother Israel. Thou knowest al the trauel that hath happened vs,
Numbers 20:15 how our fathers went downe into Egypt, and how we haue dwelt in Egypt a longe tyme, and how the Egypcians vexed both vs and our fathers.
Numbers 20:16 Then we cried vnto the Lorde and he hearde oure voyces, and sent an angell & hath fet vs oute of Egypte. And beholde, we are in Cades a city harde by the borders of thy contry
Numbers 20:17 let vs go a good felowshype thorow thy contrey we wil not go thorow thi feldes nor thorow the viniyardes, neither wyl we drinke of the water of the fountaynes, but we wyll go vp the hye way, & neyther turne vnto the righte hand nor to the lift, vntyl we be past thy contrye.
Numbers 20:18 And Edom answered him: Se thou come not by me, least I come out against the with the swerde.
Numbers 20:19 And the chyldren of Israel sayed vnto him: we wyl go by the beaten way: and if eyther we or our cattell drynke of thy water, we wyll pay for it, we wyll do no more but passe thorow by fote onelye.
Numbers 20:20 And he said ye shal not go thorow. And Edom came out against hym with much people and wyth a mighty power.
Numbers 20:21 And thus Edom denied to giue Israel passage thorow his contrie. And Israel turned away from him.
Numbers 20:22 And the children of Israel remoued from Cades & went vnto mount Hor wyth all the congregation.
Numbers 20:23 And the Lord spake vnto Moses and Aaron in mounte Hor, sayinge:
Numbers 20:24 lett Aaron be putt vnto hys people, for he shall not come into the lande whiche I haue geuen vnto the chyldren of Israel: bicause ye disobeied my mouth at the water of strife.
Numbers 20:25 Take Aaron and Eliazar hys sonne, and brynge them vp into mount Hor,
Numbers 20:26 and strippe Aaron out of hys vestimentes and putt them vpon Eliazar hys sonne, and let Aaron be put vnto hys people and dye there.
Numbers 20:27 And Moses dyd as the Lord commaunded: and they went vp into mount Hor in the syght of all the multitude.
Numbers 20:28 And Moses toke of Aarons clothes, and put them vpon Eleazar his sonne, & Aaron dyed there in the topp of the mount.
Numbers 20:29 And Moses and Eleazar came downe out of the mounte. And all the house of Israell mourned for Aaron .xxx. dayes.

CHAPTER: 21

Numbers 21:1 And when king Arad the Cananite which dwelt in the south partyes, heard tell that Israell came by the waye that the spyes hadde founde out, he came and fought wyth Israel and toke some of them prysoners.
Numbers 21:2 Then Israel vowed a vowe vnto the Lord & sayd: If thou wylte gyue thys people into oure handes, we wyll destroye theyr cyties.
Numbers 21:3 And the Lorde hearde the voyce of Israell, and deliuered them the Cananites. And they destroyed both them and their cityes, & called the place Horma.
Numbers 21:4 Then they departed from mount Hor toward the red sea: to compasse the land of Edom. And the soules of the people faynted by the way.
Numbers 21:5 And the people spake against God and against Moses: wherfore hast thou brought vs oute of Egypte, for to dye in the wyldernes, for here is neither bread nor water, and our soules lotheth thys light bread.
Numbers 21:6 Then the Lord sent fiery serpentes amonge the people, which stonge them: so that much people dyed in Israell.
Numbers 21:7 And the people came to Moses and sayed: we haue sinned, for we haue spoken agayust the Lord and againste the, make intercession to the lorde, that he take away the serpentes from vs. And Moses made intercession for the people.
Numbers 21:8 And the Lord saide vnto Moses. Make the a serpente, and hang it vp for a sygne, and let as many as are byten loke vpon it, and they shall lyue.
Numbers 21:9 And Moses made a serpent of brasse & set it vp for a sygne. And when the serpentes had bytten any man, he went and beheld the serpent of brasse, and recouered.
Numbers 21:10 And the children of Israell remoued and pytched in Oboth.
Numbers 21:11 And they departed from Oboth and lay at Egebarim in the wyldernesse which is before Moab on the east syde
Numbers 21:12 And they remoued thence, and pytched vpon the riuer of zarad.
Numbers 21:13 And they departed thence and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which ryuer is in the wyldernesse, and cometh out of the costes of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, betwen Moab & the Amorites.
Numbers 21:14 Wherfore it is spoken in the boke of the warre of the Lorde: goo wyth vyolence, both on the ryuer of Arnon
Numbers 21:15 and on the ryuers head, which shoteth downe to dwel at Ar, & leaneth vpon the costes of Moab.
Numbers 21:16 And from thence thei came to Bear, which is the wel wherof the Lord spake vnto Moses: gather the peopple togither, that I may gyue them water.
Numbers 21:17 Then Israell sange thys songe: Aryse vp wel, synge thereto:
Numbers 21:18 The wel whych the rulers dygged and the captaines of the people wt the healpe of the lawe geuer and with their staues. And from thys wyldernesse they went to Matana,
Numbers 21:19 and from Matana to Nahaliel, & from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
Numbers 21:20 & from Bamoth to the valay that is in the feylde of Moab in the top of Phasgah which boweth toward Iesimon.
Numbers 21:21 And Israell sent messengers vnto Sehon, kyng of the Amorites sayinge:
Numbers 21:22 lett vs go thorowe thy lande: we wyll not turne into thy feildes nor into thy viniyardes, neither dryncke of the water of the welles: but we wil go alonge by the commen way vntyll we be past thy contrey.
Numbers 21:23 And Sehon wold giue Israel no lycence to passe thorow hys contrey, but gathered al hys people togyther, & went oute agaynste Israell into the wyldernesse. And he came to Iaheza and foughte wyth Israell.
Numbers 21:24 And Israel smote hym wt the edge of the swerde & conquered his Land, from Arnon vnto Iabock: euen vnto the children of Ammon For the borders of the chyldren of Ammon, are strong.
Numbers 21:25 And Israell toke all these cytyes & dwelte in all the cyties of the Amorites: in Hesbon & in al the townes that longe therto.
Numbers 21:26 For Hesbon was the city of Sehon the kinge of the Amorites whych Sehon had foughte before with the kinge of the Moabites, and had taken al hys land out of hys hande, euen vnto Arnon.
Numbers 21:27 Wherefore it is a prouerbe, go to Hesbon & lette the city of Sehon be builte & made ready,
Numbers 21:28 for there is a fyre gone out of Hesbone & a flame from the city of Sehon & hath consumed Ar of the Moabites and the men of the hilles of Arnon.
Numbers 21:29 Wo be to the Moab: o people of Chamos ye ar vndone. His sonnes are put to flyght and hys daughters broughte captyue vnto Sehon kynge of the Amorites.
Numbers 21:30 Their lyghte is out from Hesbon vnto Dibon and we made a wyldernes euen vnto Nopha which reacheth vnto Mediba.
Numbers 21:31 And thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
Numbers 21:32 And Moses sente to searche oute Iaezer, and they toke the townes belongynge therto and conquered the Amorites that were there.
Numbers 21:33 And then they turned & went vp towarde Basan. And Og the kynge of Basan came out against them, both he and al hys people, to warre at Adrei.
Numbers 21:34 And the Lorde sayed vnto Moses: feare hym not, for I haue deliuered him into thy handes with all his people & his land. And thou shalt do with him as thou didest with Sehon the king of the Amorites whiche dwelt at Hesbon.
Numbers 21:35 And they smote him & hys sonnes and all hys people, vntyll there was nothyng left hym. And they conquered hys land

CHAPTER: 22

Numbers 22:1 and the children of of Israel remoued & pytched in the feldes of Moab, on the other syde of Iordane, by Iericho.
Numbers 22:2 And Balac the sonne of Ziphor sawe all that Israell had done to the Amorites,
Numbers 22:3 and the Moabites were sore afraied of the people bycause they were many, and abhorred the children of Israel.
Numbers 22:4 And Moab sayed vnto the Elders of Madian, nowe shall thys companye lycke vp all that are rounde aboute vs, as an oxe lycketh vp the grasses of the fyeld. And Balac the sonne of Ziphor was Kynge of the Moabites at that tyme.
Numbers 22:5 And he sent menssengers vnto Balam the sonne of Beor, the interpreter which dwelte vpon the riuer of the lande of the children of hys folke, to call hym saying: beholde, there is a people come out of Egypte which couereth the face of the earth and lyeth euen hard by me.
Numbers 22:6 Come nowe a feloweshyp and curse me thys people. For they are to myghty for me, so peraduenture I might be able to smite them & to dryue them out of the Land. For I wot that whom thou blessest shalbe blessed, and whom thou cursest shalbe cursed.
Numbers 22:7 And the elders of Moab wente wyth the elders of Madian, & the reward of the sothsayinge in their handes. And they came vnto Balam and tolde hym the wordes of Balac.
Numbers 22:8 And he sayed vnto them, tary here al night and I wyll brynge you worde, euen as the Lorde shal saye vnto me. And the Lordes of Moab abode with Balam.
Numbers 22:9 And God cam vnto Balam & said: what men are these whych are wyth the?
Numbers 22:10 And Balam sayed vnto God: Balac the sonne of Ziphor kyng of Moab hath sente vnto me sayinge:
Numbers 22:11 beholde ther is a people come out of Egypt and couereth the face of the earth: come nowe therefore and curse me them, that so peraduenture I maye be able to ouercome them in battell, & to driue them oute.
Numbers 22:12 And God sayed vnto Balam: thou shalt not go wt them, neyther curse the people, for they are blessed.
Numbers 22:13 And Balam rose vp in the mornyng and sayd vnto the Lordes of Balac: get you vnto your land, for the Lorde wyll not suffer me to go wt you.
Numbers 22:14 And the Lordes of Moab rose vp & went vnto Balac and said. Balam wolde not come wyth vs.
Numbers 22:15 And Balac sent againe a greater company of lordes & more honourable then they.
Numbers 22:16 And they came to Balam and tolde hym. Thus sayeth Balac the sonne of Ziphor: oh, let nothynge let the to come vnto me,
Numbers 22:17 for I wyll greately promote the vnto greate honour. and wyl do whatsoeuer thou sayeste vnto me, come therefore I praye the curse me thys peole.
Numbers 22:18 And Balam answered and sayd vnto the seruauntes of Balac. If Balac would gyue me hys house ful of syluer and gold, I can go no further then the worde of the Lorde my God, to do lesse or more.
Numbers 22:19 Neuertheles tarye ye here al nyght: that I may wete, what the Lorde wil say vnto me once more.
Numbers 22:20 And God came vnto Balam by nyghte and sayd vnto hym: If the men come to fette the ryse vp & go wyth them: but what I say vnto the, that onely thou shalt do.
Numbers 22:21 And Balam rose vp early & saddeled hys asse & went wyth the Lordes of Moab.
Numbers 22:22 But God was angry bycause he wente. And the angel of the Lorde stode in the way agaynst hym. And he ryd vpon hys asse & .ij. seruauntes wyth him.
Numbers 22:23 And when the asse sawe the angel of the Lorde stand in the waye & his swerde drawen in hys hand, she turned a side out of the way & went out into the feld. And Balam smot the asse, to turne hir into the waye.
Numbers 22:24 And the angell of the Lord wente & stode in a path betwen the viniyardes, wher was a wal on the one syde, & another on the other.
Numbers 22:25 When the asse sawe the angel of the Lorde, she wrenched vnto the wall and thrust Balams fote vnto the wall, and he smote hyr againe.
Numbers 22:26 And the angel of the Lorde went further and stode in a narrow place, whher was no waye to turne, eyther to the ryghte hande or to the lyfte.
Numbers 22:27 And when the asse saw the angel of the lord, she fel downe vnder Balam: and Balam was wrath and smote the asse wyth a staffe.
Numbers 22:28 And the Lorde opened the mouth of the asse, & she sayed vnto Balam: what haue I done vnto the, that thou smyteste me thus .iij. tymes?
Numbers 22:29 And Balam sayed vnto the asse: bycause thou hast mocked me? I would that I had a swerde in myne hande, that I myght now kyll the.
Numbers 22:30 And the asse sayd vnto Balam am I not thyne asse whych thou hast ridden vpon sence thou wast borne vnto this daye? Was I euer wont to do so vnto the? And he sayed naye.
Numbers 22:31 And the Lord opened the eyes of Balam that he sawe the angel of the Lord standyng in the waye, wyth hys swerd drawen in hys hande. And he bowed him selfe & fel flatt on hys face.
Numbers 22:32 And the angell of the Lorde sayed vnto him. Wherfore smitest thou thyne asse thus .iij. tymes? behold I came out to resiste the for the waye is contrarye vnto me,
Numbers 22:33 & the asse sawe me and auoyded me thre tymes: or else (had she not turned fro me). I had surely slayne the and saued hyr a lyue.
Numbers 22:34 And Balam sayed vnto the aungell of the Lorde: I haue synned for I wist not that thou stodest in the wai against me. Now therfore if it displease thine eyes, I wyl turne agayne.
Numbers 22:35 And the angel sayed vnto Balam, go wyth the men: but in any myse, what I saye vnto the, that saye. And Balam went with the lordes of Balac.
Numbers 22:36 And when Balac heard that Balam was come he went out agaynst him vnto a city of Moab that stode in the border of Arnon whiche was the vtmost part of his contrye.
Numbers 22:37 And Balac sayd vnto Balam: did I not sende for the, to call the? wherfore camest thou not vnto me? thinkest thou that I am not able to promote the vnto honour.
Numbers 22:38 And Balam sayd vnto Balac: Loo, I am come vnto the. But I can saye nothynge at all saue what God putteth into my mouth that must I speake.
Numbers 22:39 And Balam went wyth Balac, & they came vnto the large city.
Numbers 22:40 And Balac offered oxen & shepe and sente for Balam and for the Lordes that were with hym.
Numbers 22:41 And on the mornynge Balac toke Balam and brought hym vp into the hye place of Baal: and thence he sawe vnto the vtmost part of the people.

CHAPTER: 23

Numbers 23:1 And Balam sayed vnto Balac: buyld me here seuen alters and prouide here seuen bullockes and seuen rammes.
Numbers 23:2 And Balac dyd as Balam said. And Balac and Balam offered on euery alter a bullock and a ram.
Numbers 23:3 And Balam sayd vnto Balac: stande by the Sacrifyce whyle I go to wete whether the Lorde wil come and mete me, & whatsoeuer he sheweth me, I wyl tel the, & he went forthewyth.
Numbers 23:4 And God came vnto Balam, & Balam sayed vnto hym: I haue prepared .vij. alters & haue offered vpon euerye alter, a bullock and a ram.
Numbers 23:5 And the Lorde put a sayinge in Balams mouth and sayd: go agayne to Balac & say on thys wyse.
Numbers 23:6 And he went againe vnto hym and loo, he stode by hys sacrifice, both he and all the Lordes of Moab.
Numbers 23:7 And he began hys parable and said: Balac the king of Moab hath fette me from Mesopotamia out of the mountaynes of the east, sayinge: come and curse me Iacob, come & defye me Israel.
Numbers 23:8 How shal I curse whom God curseth not and howe shall I defy whome the Lord defieth not?
Numbers 23:9 from the toppes of the rockes I se hym, & from the hylles I behold him: loo, the people shal dwel by him selfe and shal not be rekened among other nations.
Numbers 23:10 Who can tell the dust of Iacob and the numbre of the fourth parte of Israell. I pray God that my soul may dye the death of the rightuous and that my laste ende may be lyke his.
Numbers 23:11 And Balac sayed vnto Balam, what haste thou done vnto me? I fette the to curse myne enemies: and behold, thou blessest them.
Numbers 23:12 And he answered and sayed: must I not kepe that & speake it, whyche the Lorde hath put in my mouthe?
Numbers 23:13 And Balac sayd vnto hym: Come I pray the with me to an other place whence thou shalt se them, and shalt se but the vtmoste parte of theim and shall not se theim all and curse me them there.
Numbers 23:14 And he brought hym into a playne felde where men myght se farre euen to the toppe of Phasgah, & built .vij. alters and offered a bullocke & a ram on euery alter.
Numbers 23:15 And he sayd vnto Balac: stand here by thy Sacrifyce whyle I go yonder.
Numbers 23:16 And the Lorde mette Balam and put wordes in hys mouth and sayd: go agayne vnto Balac and thus say.
Numbers 23:17 And when he came to him: behold, he stode by hys Sacrifice and the Lordes of Moab with him. And Balac said vnto hym: what sayth the Lord?
Numbers 23:18 And he toke vp hys parable and said: rise vp Balac and heare, & herken vnto me thou sonne of Ziphor.
Numbers 23:19 The Lorde is not a man, that he can lye, neither the sonne of man that he can repente: should he saye and not do, or shoulde he speake and not make it good?
Numbers 23:20 beholde, I haue begone to blesse and haue blessed, and can not goo backe therefro.
Numbers 23:21 He beheld no wyckednes in Iacob nor saw idolatry in Israel: The Lord hys God is wyth hym, and the triumphe of a kynge is among them.
Numbers 23:22 God hath brought them out of Egypt is as the strength of an vnicorne vnto them,
Numbers 23:23 for there is no sorcerer, in Iacob, nor sothsayer in Israell. When the tyme cometh, it wyll be sayed of Iacob and of Israell, what God hath wrought.
Numbers 23:24 Behold the people shall ryse vp as a lyonesse and heaue vp him selfe as a lyon, & shall not lye downe agayne, vntyl he haue eaten of the praye and dronke of the bloud of them that are slayne.
Numbers 23:25 And Balac saied vnto Balam: neither curse them nor blesse them.
Numbers 23:26 And Balam answered & sayd vnto Balac: tolde not I the sayinge: all that the Lorde byddeth me, that I muste doo?
Numbers 23:27 And Balac sayed vnto Balam: come I praye the, I wyl bryng the yet vnto an other place: so peraduenture it shall please God, that thou maist curse them there.
Numbers 23:28 And Balac broughte Balam vnto the toppe of Peor, that boweth towarde the wyldernesse.
Numbers 23:29 And Balam sayed vnto Balac: make me here .vij. altares, and prepare me here .vij. bullockes and .vij. rammes.
Numbers 23:30 And Balac dyd as Balam had sayed, and offered a bullocke and a ram on euery alter.

CHAPTER: 24

Numbers 24:1 When Balam sawe that it pleased the Lorde that he shoulde blesse Israell, he wente not as he dyd twise before to fet sothsayinge, but sette hys face towarde the wildernes,
Numbers 24:2 and lyfte vp hys eyes and loked vpon Israel as he laye wyth hys tribes, and the spirite of God came vppon hym.
Numbers 24:3 And he toke vp hys parable and saied Balam the sonne of Beor hathe sayed,
Numbers 24:4 and the manne whose eye is open hath sayed: he hath sayd whych heareth the words of God & seeth the visions of the almyghty, whiche falleth downe: & hys eyes are opened.
Numbers 24:5 Howe goodlye are the tentes of Iacob & thyne habitation Israel,
Numbers 24:6 euen as the brod valeys, and as gardens by ryuers syde, as the tentes whyche the Lodre hath pytched & as cypres trees vpon the water.
Numbers 24:7 The water shal flowe out of hys bouket & hys seed shal be many waters, and hys kyng shalbe hyer then Agag. And hys kyngdome shalbe exalted,
Numbers 24:8 God that brought him out of Egipt his strength is as the strengthe of an vnicorne, & he shal eate the nations that are hys enemies & breake theyr bones, and perce them thorowe wyth hys arrowes.
Numbers 24:9 He touched hym selfe & laye downe as a lyon and as a lyones, who shall sterre him vp, blessed is he that blesseth the, & cursed is he that curseth the.
Numbers 24:10 And Balac was wroth wyth Balam and smote hys hands togyther, & sayd vnto him: I sent for the to curse myne enemies: and behold, thou hast blessed them thys thre times
Numbers 24:11 and now gette the quyckly vnto thy place. I thought that I would promote the vnto honour, but the Lorde hath kept the backe from worshyp.
Numbers 24:12 And Balam sayed vnto Balac: told I not thy messengers which thou sentest vnto me saying.
Numbers 24:13 If Balac would giue me his house full of syluer and gold, I can not passe the mouth of the Lorde, to do eyther good or bad of myne owne mynde. What the Lord saith, that must I speake.
Numbers 24:14 And now beholde, I go vnto my people: come let me shew the what thys people shall do to thy folke in the later dayes.
Numbers 24:15 And he began hys Parable and sayed: Balam the sonne of Beor hath sayed, & the man that hath his eyes open hath said,
Numbers 24:16 and he hath saied that heareth the wordes of God & hath the knowledge of the most hie & beholdeth the vision of the almyghtye, and when he falleth downe hath his eyes opened
Numbers 24:17 I se him but not now, I behold hym but not nye. There shall come a starre of Iacob and ryse a scepter of Israel, which shal smite the costes of Moab and vndermine all the chyldren of Seth.
Numbers 24:18 And Edom shalbe hys possession, and the possession of Seir shall be theyr enemies, and Israel shall do manfully.
Numbers 24:19 And out of Iacob shal come he that shal destroye the remnaunt of the cityes.
Numbers 24:20 And he loked on Amaleck and began hys parable and sayd: Amaleck is the first of the nations, but hys later ende shall peryshe vtterli.
Numbers 24:21 And he loked on the Kenites, & toke his parable and sayd: stronge is thy dwellynge place & put thy neste vpon a rocke.
Numbers 24:22 Neuerthelater thou shalt be a burnyng to Kain, vntyl Assar take the prisoner.
Numbers 24:23 And he toke hys parable & sayed. Alas, who shal lyue when God doth this?
Numbers 24:24 The shyppes shal come out of the cost of Chittim & subdue Assur and subdue Eber, & he him selfe shal perish at the laste.
Numbers 24:25 And Balam rose vp and went & dwelt in his place: & Balac also went hys way.

CHAPTER: 25

Numbers 25:1 And Israel dwelt in Sittim, and the people beganne to commytte whoredome wyth the daughters of Moab,
Numbers 25:2 whych called the people vnto the sacrifice of theyr Goddes. And the people ate & worshypped their Goddes,
Numbers 25:3 and Israel coupled him selfe vnto Baal Peor. Then the Lorde was angry with Israel,
Numbers 25:4 and sayed vnto Moses: take al the heades of the people, and hange them vp vnto the Lorde agaynste the sunne, that the wrathe of the Lorde maye turne away from Israel.
Numbers 25:5 And Moses sayed vnto the iudges of Israel: go and slea those men that ioyned theym selues vnto Baal Peor.
Numbers 25:6 And behold, one of the children of Israell came & broughte vnto hys brethren, a Madianitish wyfe euen in the syght of Moses & in the sighte of al the multitude of the children of Israel, as they were weppyng in the dore of the tabernacle of wytnes.
Numbers 25:7 And when Phinehes the sonne of Eleazar the sonne of Aaron the prieste sawe it, he rose vp out of the company & toke a weapen in hys hand,
Numbers 25:8 & went after the man of Israel into the hore house and thrust them thorow: both the man of Israel and also the woman euen thorowe the bealy of hyr. And the plage ceased from the children of Israel.
Numbers 25:9 And ther dyed in the plage .xxiiij. thousand.
Numbers 25:10 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Numbers 25:11 Phinehes the sonne of Eleazar the sonne of Aaron the prieste, hathe turned myne anger awaye from the chyldren of Israel, bycause he was gelouse for my sake amonge them that I had not consumed the chyldren of Israel in my gelousy.
Numbers 25:12 Wherfore say: beholde I geue vnto him my couenaunt of peace,
Numbers 25:13 & he shall haue it and hys sede after him, euen the couenaunt of the priestes office for euer, bycause he was gelous for his Goddes sake & made an atonement for the children of Israel.
Numbers 25:14 The name of the Israelite whiche was smitten wyth the Madianityshe wyfe, was Zamri the sonne of Salu, a Lorde of an aunciente house among the Simeonites.
Numbers 25:15 And the name of the Madianittshe wyfe, was Cozby the daughter of Zura heade ouer the people of an auncient house in Madian.
Numbers 25:16 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Numbers 25:17 vexe the Madianytes & smyte them,
Numbers 25:18 for they haue troubled you with their wiles with the whych they haue begiled you, thorow Peor and thorowe their sister Cozbi the daughter of a Lord in Madian, whiche was slayne in the day of the plage for Peors sake.

CHAPTER: 26

Numbers 26:1 And after the plage, the Lorde spake vnto Moses and vnto Eleazar the sonne of Aaron the prieste sayinge:
Numbers 26:2 take the numbre of all the multitude of the chyldren of Israell frome .xx. yeare & aboue thorow out theyr fathers houses all that are able to go to warre in Israell.
Numbers 26:3 And Moses & Eleazar the prieste tolde them in the feldes of Moab: by Iordane fast by Iericho,
Numbers 26:4 from .xx. yeare and aboue, as the Lord commaunded Moses. And the children of Israell that came out of Egypt were.
Numbers 26:5 Ruben the eldest sonne of Israel. The children of Ruben were, Hanoch, of whom cometh the kynred of the Hanochites: & of Palu, cometh the kynred of the Paluites:
Numbers 26:6 And of Hesron commeth the kinred of the Hesronites: and of Carmi cometh the kinred of the Carmites.
Numbers 26:7 These are the kinreds of the Rubenites whiche were in numbre .xliij. thousande .vi. hundred, & .xxx.
Numbers 26:8 And the sonnes of Palu were Eliab.
Numbers 26:9 And the sonnes of Eliab were: Nemuel, Dathan, & Abiram. Thys is that Dathan & Abiram councelers in the congregation, whiche stroue against Moses and Aaron in the companye of Corah, when they stroue against the Lord.
Numbers 26:10 And the earth opened hir mouth & swalowed them and Corah also, when the multitude dyed, what tyme the fyre consumed .ij. hundred & fyfty men, & they became a sygne:
Numbers 26:11 Notwithstandyng the children of Corah dyed not.
Numbers 26:12 And the children of Simeon in theyr kynreds were: Nemuel, of whom cometh the kinred of the Nemuelites: Iamin, of whom cometh the kinred of the Iaminites: Iachin, of whom cometh the kinred of the Iachinites:
Numbers 26:13 Zareh, of whom cometh the kinred of the Zarehites: Saule, of whom cometh the kinred of the Saulites.
Numbers 26:14 These are the kinredes of the Simeonites: in numbre .xxij. thousand and two hundred.
Numbers 26:15 And the chyldren of Gad in theyr kynredes were: Zephon, of whom cometh the kinred of the Zephonytes: & of Haggi, cometh the kynred of the Haggites: and of Suni, cometh the kinred of the Sunites:
Numbers 26:16 and of Aseni, cometh the kinred of the Asenites: and of Eri cometh the kynred of the Erites:
Numbers 26:17 and of Arod cometh the kinred of the Arodites: & of Ariel cometh the kinred of the Arielites.
Numbers 26:18 These are the kinreds of the children of Gad in numbre .xl. thousand & .v. hundred.
Numbers 26:19 The children of Iuda: Er & Onan, whiche dyed in the lande of Canaan.
Numbers 26:20 But the chyldren of Iuda in theyr kynred were: Sela of whom cometh the kynred of the Selamites: & of Phares cometh the kynred of the Pharesites: and of Zareh cometh the kynred of the Zarehites.
Numbers 26:21 And the children of Phares were Hesron, of whom cometh the kynred of the Hesronites: and of Hamul commeth the kynred of the Hamulites.
Numbers 26:22 These are the kinredes of Iuda, in numbre .lxxvi. thousand & fyue hundred.
Numbers 26:23 And the children of Isachar in their kinreds were: Thola, of whom cometh the kinred of the Tholaites: & Phuna, of whom cometh the kinred of the Phunaites:
Numbers 26:24 & of Iasub cometh the kynred of the Iasubites: and of Simron cometh the kynred of the Simronites.
Numbers 26:25 These are the kynredes of Isachar in numbre .lxiiij. thousand & .iij. hundred,
Numbers 26:26 The children of Zabulon in their kinredes were: Sered, of whom cometh the kynred of the Seredites: and Elon, of whom cometh the kynred of the Elonites: and of Iaheliel cometh the kynred of the Iahelelites,
Numbers 26:27 These are the kynredes of Zabulon: in numbre, .lx. thousand & fiue hundred.
Numbers 26:28 The children of Ioseph in their kinredes were: Manasse and Ephraim,
Numbers 26:29 The chyldren of Manasse: Machir, of whom cometh the kynred of the Machirites. And Machir begat Galaad, of whom cometh the kynred of the Galaadites.
Numbers 26:30 And these are the chyldren of Galaad: Hieser, of whom cometh the kynred of the Hieserites: and of Helech cometh the kynred of the Helechites:
Numbers 26:31 and of Asriel the kynred of the Asrielites: and of Sichem cometh the kynred of the Sichemites:
Numbers 26:32 and of Simida cometh the kynred of the Simidites: and of Hepher cometh the kynred of the Hepherites.
Numbers 26:33 And Zelaphead the sonne of Hephera had no sonnes but daughters. And the names of the daughters of Zelaphead were Mahela, Noa, Hagla, Milcha and Thirza.
Numbers 26:34 These are the kinredes of Manasse, in numbre .lij. thousand & seuen hundred.
Numbers 26:35 These are the children of Ephraim in their kynredes: Suthelah, of whom commeth the kynred of the Suthelahites: and Becher, of whom cometh the kinred of the Becherites: & of Thehen cometh the kynred of the Thehenites.
Numbers 26:36 And these are the children of Suthelah: Eran, of whom commeth the kinred of the Eranites.
Numbers 26:37 These are the kynredes of the chyldren of Ephraim in numbre .xxxij. thousand and .v. hundred. And these are the chyldren of Ioseph in theyr kinredes.
Numbers 26:38 These are the chyldren of BenIamin in their kynredes: Bela, of whome cometh the kinred of the Belaites: & of Asbel cometh the kynred of the Asbelites: and of Ahiram, the kinred of the Ahiramites:
Numbers 26:39 and of Supham the kynred of the Suphamites: & of Hupham the kynred of the Huphamites.
Numbers 26:40 And the children of Bela were Ard & Naaman fro whence come the kinreds of the Ardites & of the Naamites.
Numbers 26:41 These ar the children of BenIamin in their kinredes, and in numbre .xlv. thousande and sixe hundred.
Numbers 26:42 These are the children of Dan in their kinredes: of Suham, of whom cometh the kinred of the Suhamites. These are the kinredes of Dan in their generations.
Numbers 26:43 And al the kinredes of the Suhamites were in numbre .lxiiij. thousand and .iiij. hundred.
Numbers 26:44 The chyldren of Aser in theyr kynredes were Iemna, of whom cometh the kinred of the Iemnites: and Iesui, of whom cometh the kinred of the Iesuites: & of Bria cometh the kynred of the Brites.
Numbers 26:45 And the chyldren of Bria were Heber, of whom cometh the kinred of the Heberites: & of Malchiel came the kinred of the Malchealites.
Numbers 26:46 And the daughter of Aser was called Sarah.
Numbers 26:47 These are the kynredes of Aser in numbre .liij. thousand & .iiij. hundred.
Numbers 26:48 The children of Nephthali in ther kynredes were: Ieheziel, of whom came the kinred of the Iahezielites: & Guni, of whom came the kynred of the Gunites:
Numbers 26:49 & of Iezer, came the kinred of the Iezerites: & of Selem the kynred of the Selemites.
Numbers 26:50 These are the kynredes of Nephthali in theyr generations in numbre .xlv. thousande and .iiij. hundred.
Numbers 26:51 These are the numbres of the chyldren of Israel: syxe hundred thousand, and a thousande .vij. hundred and .xxx.
Numbers 26:52 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Numbers 26:53 vnto these the land shalbe deuided to enheret, accordyng to the numbre of names:
Numbers 26:54 to many thou shalte gyue the more enheritaunce and to few the lesse: to euery tribe shal the enheritaunce be geuen according to the numbre therof.
Numbers 26:55 Notwythstanding, the land shalbe deuided by lot, & accordinge to the names of the tribes of theyr, fathers they shall enheritt:
Numbers 26:56 & according to theyr lot thou shalt deuide theyr lande both to the many & to the fewe.
Numbers 26:57 These ar the summes of the Leuites in their kynredes of Gerson, came the kynred of the Gersonites: and of Cahath came the kinred of the Cahathites: and of Merari came the kynred of the Merarites.
Numbers 26:58 These are the kinredes of Leui: the kinred of the Libnites, the kynred of the Hebronites, the kynred of the Mahelites, the kinredes of the Musites, the kinred of the Karahites. Kahath begate Amram,
Numbers 26:59 and Amrams wyfe was called Iochebed a daughter of Leui, whyche was borne hym in Egypte. And she bare vnto Amram, Aaron, Moses, & MyrIam theyr sister.
Numbers 26:60 And vnto Aaron were borne, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar & Ithamar.
Numbers 26:61 But Nadab & Abihu dyed, as they offered straunge fyre before the lord.
Numbers 26:62 And the numbre of them was .xxiij. thousande of all the males from a moneth olde & aboue For they were not numbred among the children of Israel, bycause there was no enheritaunce geuen theym amonge the children of Israel.
Numbers 26:63 These are the numbres of the children of Israel which Moses & Eleazar the priest numbred in the feldes of Moab, fast bi Iordane nye to Iericho.
Numbers 26:64 And among these there was not a man of the numbre of the children of Israel whyche Moses and Aaron told in the wyldernes of Sinai.
Numbers 26:65 For the Lord sayed vnto them, that they should dye in the wildernes and that there should not be lefte a man of them: saue Caleb the sonne of Iephune & Iosua the sonne of Nun.

CHAPTER: 27

Numbers 27:1 And the daughters of Zelaphead the Sonne of Heber the sonne of Gilead, the sonne of Machir the sonne of Manasse of the kynredes of Manasse, the sone of Ioseph (whose names were Mahela, Noha, Hagla, Melcha, and Thyrza)
Numbers 27:2 came and stode before Moses & Eleazar, the priest & before the Lordes & all the multitude in the dore of the tabernacle of wytnes saying
Numbers 27:3 our father dyed in the wyldernesse, & was not amonge the companye of theim that gathered them selues togyther agaynst the Lord in the congregation of Corah: But dyed in hys owne synne, and had no sonnes.
Numbers 27:4 Wherfore sholde the name of our fathers be taken away from amonge hys kynred, bycause he had no sonne? Gyue vnto vs a possession among the brethren of our father.
Numbers 27:5 And Moses brought theyr cause before the Lorde.
Numbers 27:6 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses sayinge:
Numbers 27:7 The daughters of Zelaphead speake ryght thou shalt gyue them a possession to enherit among their fathers brethren, & shalte turne the enheritaunce of their father vnto theim.
Numbers 27:8 And speake vnto the children of Israel saying If a man dye & haue no sonne ye shall turne hys enheritaunce vnto hys daughter.
Numbers 27:9 If he haue no doughter, ye shall gyue hys enheritaunce vnto hys brethren.
Numbers 27:10 If he haue no brethren, ye shall gyue hys enheritaunce vnto hys fathers brethren.
Numbers 27:11 If he haue no fathers brethren, ye shal giue hys enheritaunce vnto hym that is nexte to hym of hys kynred, and lette hym possesse it. And thys shall be vnto the chyldren of Israell an ordinaunce, and a lawe, as the Lorde hathe commaunded Moses.
Numbers 27:12 And the Lorde saied vnto Moses: get the vp into thys mount Abarim, & behold, the land whych I haue geuen vnto the children of Israel.
Numbers 27:13 And when thou hast sene it, thou shalt be gathered vnto thy people also, as Aaron thy brother was gathered vnto hys people.
Numbers 27:14 For ye were disobedient vnto my mouthe in the deserte of Sin in the stryfe of the congregation that ye sanctified me not in the water before their eyes. That is the water of stryfe in Cades in the wildernes of Zin.
Numbers 27:15 And Moses spake vnto the Lord saying:
Numbers 27:16 lett the Lord God of the spirites of al fleshe, sette a man ouer the congregation,
Numbers 27:17 which may go in and out before them, & to lead them in & out that the congregation of the Lord be not as a flocke of shepe without a shepeheard.
Numbers 27:18 And the Lord said to Moses: take Iosua the sonne of Nun in whom there is a spirite, & put thine handes vpon him,
Numbers 27:19 and set hym before Eleazar the prieste and before all the congregation and gyue him a charge in their syght.
Numbers 27:20 And put of thy prayse vpon him that all the company of the chyldren of Israell may heare
Numbers 27:21 And he shal stand before Eleazar the prieste which shal axe councel for him after the iudgement of Vrim before the Lorde. And at the mouthe of Eleazar shall both he and all the chyldren of Israell with him and al the congregation go in and out.
Numbers 27:22 And Moses did as the Lorde commaunded hym, and he toke Iosua and set hym before Eleazar the prieste & before all the congregation
Numbers 27:23 and put hys handes vpon hym & gaue hym a charge, as the Lord commaunded thorowe the hande of Moses.

CHAPTER: 28

Numbers 28:1 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses sayinge:
Numbers 28:2 gyue the chyldren of Israell a charge and saye vnto them, that they take hede to offer vnto the offerynge of my breade in the Sacrifyce of swete sauoure, in hys due season.
Numbers 28:3 And saye vnto them. Thys is the offerynge whyche ye shall offer vnto the Lorde two Lambes of a yere olde wythout spotte daye by day to be a burnt offerynge perpetually.
Numbers 28:4 One Lambe thou shalt offer in the mornyng and the other at euen.
Numbers 28:5 And therto the tenthe parte of an Epha of floure for a meate offerynge myngled with beaten oyle, the fourth parte of an Hin:
Numbers 28:6 whych is a dayly offerynge ordeyned in the mounte Sinai vnto a swete sauour in the sacrifice of of the Lord.
Numbers 28:7 And the drynkeofferinge of the same the .iiij. part of an Hin vnto one Lambe, & poure the drynke offering in the holy place, to be good drynke vnto the Lord.
Numbers 28:8 And the other Lambe thou shalte offer at euen, wyth the meatofferyng & the dryncke offeryng after the maner of the mornynge: a sacrifyce of a swete sauour vnto the Lorde.
Numbers 28:9 And on the Sabboth day .ij. Lambes of a yere olde a pece & without spot, and two tenth deales of floure for a meat offerynge myngeled wyth oyle, & the dryncke offerynge therto.
Numbers 28:10 This is the burntoffering of euery Saboth, besides the dayly burnt offeryng, and hys drinkeofferyng.
Numbers 28:11 And in the fyrste daye of your moneth, ye shall offer a burnt offerynge vnto the Lorde two yonge bullockes, and a ram, and seuen Lambes of a yere olde wythout spotte,
Numbers 28:12 & .iij. tenthdeales of floure for a meateofferynge myngeled wyth oyle vnto one bullocke, & .ij. tenthdeales of floure for a meate offerynge myngled wyth oyle vnto one ram.
Numbers 28:13 And euermore a tenthdeale of floure myngled wyth oyle, for a meate offerynge vnto one lambe. That is a burnt offerynge of a swete sauour in the sacrifyce of the Lord.
Numbers 28:14 And their drinkofferynges shal be halfe an Hin of wine vnto one bullocke, and the thyrde parte of an Hin of wyne vnto a ram & the fourthe parte of an hin vnto a lambe. This is the burntofferynge of euery moneth thorow out all the monethes of the yeare,
Numbers 28:15 and one he gote for a synneoffering vnto the Lorde, which shal be offered with the dayly burntofferyng & hys drynkeofferynge.
Numbers 28:16 And the .xiiij. daye of the first moneth shalbe passeouer vnto the Lord
Numbers 28:17 And the .xv. day of the same moneth shall be a feast, in whych .vij. dayes men muste eate vnleuended bread.
Numbers 28:18 The fyrst daye shalbe an holy feast, so that ye shall do no maner of laboryous worke therin.
Numbers 28:19 And ye shall offer a burntoffrynge vnto the Lorde two younge bullockes, one ram, and .vij. lambes of a yere olde wythout spott,
Numbers 28:20 and their meatoffring of floure myngled wyth oyle .iij. tenthdeales vnto a bullocke, and two tenthdeales vnto a ram,
Numbers 28:21 and euermoare one tenthdeale vnto a lambe, thorow out the .vij. lambes:
Numbers 28:22 & an he goote for a synofferynge to make an attonement for you.
Numbers 28:23 And ye shall offer these, besyde the burntofferyng in the mornyng that is alway offered.
Numbers 28:24 And after thys maner ye shal offer thorow out the .vij. dayes, the fode of the sacryfice of a swete sauoure vnto the Lord. And it shalbe done besyde the dayly burntofferyng & hys drynkofferynge.
Numbers 28:25 And the seuenth daye shal be an holy feast vnto you, so that ye shal do no laborious worke therin.
Numbers 28:26 And the daye of your fyrst frutes when ye brynge a newe meateofferyng vnto the Lord in your wekes shalbe an holy feast vnto you:
Numbers 28:27 so that ye shal do no laborious worke therin. And ye shall offer a burntoffring of a swete sauoure vnto the Lord two young bullockes, and a ram, & .vij. lambes of a yere olde a pece,
Numbers 28:28 wt their meatofferynges of floure myngled with oyle .iij. tenthdeales vnto a bullocke two tenthdeales to a ram,
Numbers 28:29 & euermoare one tenthdeale vnto a lambe thorow out the .vij. lambes,
Numbers 28:30 and an he goote to make an attonement for you.
Numbers 28:31 And thys ye shal do besydes the daily burntoffring & his meateoffrynge: & they shalbe wythout spot, with their drynkoffrynges.

CHAPTER: 29

Numbers 29:1 And the fyrst day of the .vij. moneth shalbe an holy feast vnto you and ye shall do no laboryous worke therin. It shalbe a day of trompet blowyng vnto you.
Numbers 29:2 And ye shal offer a burntofferyng of a swete sauour vnto the Lorde: one younge bullocke and one ram and .vij. lambes of a yere olde a peace that are pure.
Numbers 29:3 And their meatoffringes of floure myngled wyth oyle .iij. tenth deales vnto the bullocke, & two vnto the ram,
Numbers 29:4 & one tenth deale vnto one lambe thorow the .vij. lambes.
Numbers 29:5 And an he goote for a synoffryng to make an attonement for you,
Numbers 29:6 besyde the burntofferyng of the moneth and his meatofferynge & besyde the dayly burntofferyng & his meatofferyng, and the drynkofferynges of the same: accordynge vnto the maner of them for a sauoure of swetnesse in the sacryfice of the Lord.
Numbers 29:7 And the tenth daye of that same seuenth moneth shalbe an holy feast vnto you, & ye shall humble youre soules and shall doo no maner worke therin.
Numbers 29:8 And ye shall offer a burntofferyng vnto the Lorde of a swete sauour: one bullocke, and a ram, & .vij. lambes of a yere olde a pece, without faute
Numbers 29:9 and their meateoffringes of floure mingled with oyle .iij. tenthdeales to a bullocke, & .ij. to a ra
Numbers 29:10 & al waye a tenth deale vnto a lambe, thorowe out the .vij. lambes.
Numbers 29:11 And one he goote for a synofferynge, besyde the synneofferynge of attonement and the dayly burntofferynge, & the meate and drynkoffrynges that longe to the same.
Numbers 29:12 And the .xv. day of the .vij. moneth shalbe holy day & ye shall doo no laborious worcke therin, and ye shall kepe a feast vnto the Lord of .vij. dayes longe.
Numbers 29:13 And ye shal offer a burntoffrynge of a swete sauoure vnto the Lord .xiij. bullockes .ij. rammes and .xiiij. lambes which are yerelynges & pure,
Numbers 29:14 wyth oyle .iij. tenthdeales vnto euery one of the .xiij. bullockes .ij. tenthdeales to ether of the rammes
Numbers 29:15 & one tenthdeale vnto eche of the .xiiij. lambes.
Numbers 29:16 And one he goote vnto a synoffering, besyde the dayly burntoffrynge with his meate and drynckofferynges.
Numbers 29:17 And the seconde day .xij. young bullockes .ij. rammes & .xiiij. yerlynge lambes without spot:
Numbers 29:18 & their meatoffringes and drynkofferinges vnto the bullockes, rammes and lambes accordynge to the nombre of them and after the maner.
Numbers 29:19 And an he goote for a synofferynge, besyde the dayly burntoffryng and his meate and drynkofferynges.
Numbers 29:20 And the .iij. daye .xi. bullockes twoo rammes and .xiiij. yerelynge lambes without spot:
Numbers 29:21 & their meat and drynkofferynges vnto the bullockes, rammes and lambes, after the nombre of them and according to the maner.
Numbers 29:22 And an he goote for a synoffrynge, besyde the daylye burntoffrynge and hys meate and drynke offrynges.
Numbers 29:23 And the fourth daye .x. bullockes two rammes and .xiiij. lambes yerelynges pure,
Numbers 29:24 and their meate and drynkofferynges vnto the bullockes, rammes & lambes, according to the nombre of them and after the maner.
Numbers 29:25 And an he goote for a synneoffrynge, besyde the dayly burntofferynge and his meate and drynkofferynges.
Numbers 29:26 And the fyfte daye .ix. bullockes two rammes and .xiiij. lambes of one yere old a pece wtout spot.
Numbers 29:27 And their meate and drynckofferynges vnto the bullockes, rammes and lambes, accordynge to the nombre of them and after the maner.
Numbers 29:28 And an he goote for a synne offerynge, besyde the dayly burntofferynge and his meate and drynkoffrynges.
Numbers 29:29 And the syxte daye .viij. bullockes twoo rammes and .xiiij. yerelynge lambes without spot.
Numbers 29:30 And theyr meate & drynkofferynges vnto the bullockes, rammes and lambes, accordyng to the maner.
Numbers 29:31 And an he goote for a synneofferynge, besyde the dayly burntofferynge and hys meate and drynckofferynges.
Numbers 29:32 And the seuenth daye .vij. bullockes .ij. rammes and .xiij. lambes that are yerelynges & pure.
Numbers 29:33 And their meate and drinkofferinges vnto the bullockes, rammes and lambes, accordynge to their nombre and to the maner.
Numbers 29:34 And an he goote for a synoffering, besyde the dayly burntofferyng & his meate & drynkofferynges.
Numbers 29:35 And the eyght day shalbe the conclusyon of the feaste vnto you, and ye shall do no maner laborious worck therin.
Numbers 29:36 And ye shall offer a burntofferyng of a swete sauoure vnto the Lorde: one bullocke, one ram and seuen yerelynge lambes wythout spott.
Numbers 29:37 And the meate & drynkofferynges vnto the bullocke, ram and lambes, accordynge to their nombres and accordyng to the maner.
Numbers 29:38 And an he goote for a synneofferynge besyde the dayly burntoffering and his meate and drynkofferynges.
Numbers 29:39 These thynges ye shal do vnto the Lorde in your feastes: besyde your vowes and frewyll offerynges, in youre burntofferynges meatofferynges, drynkofferynges and peace offrynges.
Numbers 29:40 And Moses tolde the chyldren of Israel, accordyng to all that the Lorde commaunded hym.

CHAPTER: 30

Numbers 30:1 And Moses spake vnto the heades of the trybes of the chyldren of Israell sayinge: thys is the thyng which the Lord commandeth.
Numbers 30:2 If a man vowe vnto the Lorde or swere an othe and bynde hys soule, he shall not go backe with hys worde: but shal fulfyll all that proceadeth out of his mouth.
Numbers 30:3 If a damsell vowe a vowe vnto the Lord and bynde her selfe beyinge in her fathers house and vnmaried.
Numbers 30:4 If her father heare her vowe & bond which she hath made vpon her soule, & holde hys peace therto: then all her vowes & bondes which she hath made vpon her soule shall stande in effecte.
Numbers 30:5 But & yf her father forbyd her the same daye that he heareth it, none of her vowes nor bondes whych she hath made vpon her soule shalbe of value, & the Lorde shall forgeue her, because her father forbade her.
Numbers 30:6 If she had an husband when she vowed or pronounced oughte out of her lyppes wherwith she bonde her soule,
Numbers 30:7 and her husbande hearde it and helde hys peace there at the same daye he hearde it: Then her vowes and her bondes wherwyth she bounde her soule, shall stande in effecte.
Numbers 30:8 But and yf her husbande forbade her the same day that the heard it, then hath he made her vowe whyche she had vpon her of none effecte, and that also which she pronounced wt her lyppes wherwyth she bounde her soule, and the lord shal forgeue her.
Numbers 30:9 The vowe of a wyddowe and of her that is deuorced, and all that they haue bounde their soules wyth all, shall stande in effecte wyth them.
Numbers 30:10 If she vowed in her husbandes house or bounde her soule with an oth,
Numbers 30:11 & her husband heard it and helde hys peace and forbade her not: then al her vowes & boundes wherwith she bound her soule, shall stande.
Numbers 30:12 But yf her husband disanulled them the same daye that he heard them, then nothyng that proceded out of her lippes in vowes & boundes wherwith she bounde her soule shall stande in effecte: for her husbande hath loused them. And the Lord shal forgeue her.
Numbers 30:13 All vowes and othes that bynde to humble the soule, maye her husbande stablyshe or breake.
Numbers 30:14 But yf her husbande holde hys peace from one day vnto another, then he stablysheth al her vowes and bondes whyche she had vpon her, because he helde his peace the same day that he heard them.
Numbers 30:15 And yf he afterward breake them, he shal beare her sinne hym selfe.
Numbers 30:16 These are the ordynaunces whyche the Lord commaunded Moses, betwene a man and hys wyfe, and betwene the father & hys daughter, beyinge a damsell in her fathers house.

CHAPTER: 31

Numbers 31:1 And the Lorde spake vnto Moses saying:
Numbers 31:2 aueng the chyldren of Israel of the Madianites, and afterward be geathered vnto thy people.
Numbers 31:3 And Moses spake vnto the folke saying: Harnesse some of you vnto warre, & let them go vpon the Madianites and auenge the Lord of the Madianites.
Numbers 31:4 Ye shal sende vnto the warre a thousand of euery trybe thorow out all the trybes of Israell.
Numbers 31:5 And there were taken oute of the thousandes of Israell .xij. thousand prepared vnto warre, of euery trybe a thousande.
Numbers 31:6 And Moses sent them a thousande of euery trybe, wyth Phineas the sonne of Eleazar the Preast to warre, and the holy vessels and the trompettes to blowe in hys hande.
Numbers 31:7 And they warred agaynst the Madianites, as the Lord commaunded Moses, and slewe al the males.
Numbers 31:8 And they slewe the kynges of Madian amonge other that were slayne: Eui, Rehem, zur, Hur & Reba: fyue kynges of Madian. And they slew Balaam the sonne of Beor with the swerde.
Numbers 31:9 And the children of Israel toke all the wemen of Madian presoners and their chyldren, and spoyled al theyr catel, their substance and their goodes.
Numbers 31:10 And they burnt al their cities wherin they dwelt, and al their castels with fyre.
Numbers 31:11 And they toke all the spoyle and al they coulde catche, both of men and beastes.
Numbers 31:12 And they broughte the captyues and that which they had taken and all the spoyle vnto Moses and Eleazar the Preast and vnto the company of the children of Israel, euen vnto the hoste, in the feldes of Moab by Iordan nye to Iericho.
Numbers 31:13 And Moses and Eleazar the Preast and al the Lordes of the congregacion went out of the hoste agaynst them.
Numbers 31:14 And Moses was angrye with the offycers of the hoste, wyth the captaynes ouer thousandes and ouer hundredes, whyche came from warre & battell,
Numbers 31:15 and sayd vnto them: Haue ye saued the wemen alyue?
Numbers 31:16 beholde these caused the chyldren of Israel thorow Balam, to commyt trespace agaynst the Lorde, by the reason of Peor, & there folowed a plage among the congregacion of the Lorde.
Numbers 31:17 Now therfore slee al the men chyldren and the wemen that haue lien with men fleshlye:
Numbers 31:18 But all the wemen chyldren that haue not lyen with men, kepe a lyue for your selues.
Numbers 31:19 And lodge without the hoste seuen dayes al that haue kylled any persone and al that haue touched any dead body, & purifye both your selues & youre presoners the .iij. day and the .vij.
Numbers 31:20 And sprynkle al your raymentes and all that is made of skynnes, and al worke of gootes here, and al thynges made of wood.
Numbers 31:21 And Eleazar the Preast sayde vnto al the men of warre which went out to battel: this is the ordinaunce of the law which the Lord commaunded Moses:
Numbers 31:22 Golde, syluer, brasse, yron, tyn and leade,
Numbers 31:23 and all that may abyde the fyre, ye shall make it go thorow the fyre, & then it is cleane. Neuerthelater, it shalbe sprynkled with sprynklynge water. And all that suffreth not the fyre, ye shall make goo thorow the water.
Numbers 31:24 And wash youre clothes the seuenth day, and then ye are cleane. And afterward come into the hoste.
Numbers 31:25 And the Lord spake vnto Moses saying:
Numbers 31:26 take the summe of the pray that was taken, both of the wemen & of catell, thou & Eleazar the preast and the auncient heades of the congregacion.
Numbers 31:27 And deuyde it in to two partis, betwene them that toke the warre vpon them and went out to battell and al the congregacion.
Numbers 31:28 And take a porcion vnto the Lord of the men of warre which went out to battell: one of fyue hundred, of the wemen and of the oxen and of the asses and of the shepe:
Numbers 31:29 and ye shal take it of their halfe and geue it vnto Eleazar the preast, an heaueofferynge vnto the Lorde.
Numbers 31:30 And of the halfe of the chyldren of Israel, take one of fyfty, of the wemen, of the oxen, of the asses and of the shepe, and of all maner of beastes, and geue them vnto the leuites which wayte vpon the habitacyon of the Lord.
Numbers 31:31 And Moses and Eleazar the preast did as the Lorde commaunded Moses.
Numbers 31:32 And the botye and the praye which the men of warre had caught was .vi. hundred thousande and .lxxv. thousand shepe:
Numbers 31:33 & .lxxij. thousand oxen
Numbers 31:34 .lxi. thousande asses:
Numbers 31:35 and .xxxij. thousand wemen that had lyen by no man.
Numbers 31:36 And the halfe which was the parte of them that went out to warre, was .iij. hundred thousande and .xxxvij. thousande and fyue hundred shepe:
Numbers 31:37 And the Lordes parte of the shepe was .vi. hundred and .lxxv.
Numbers 31:38 And the oxen were .xxxvi. thousande, of which the Lordes parte was .lxxij.
Numbers 31:39 And the asses were .xxx. thousande and fyue hundred, of whych the Lordes parte was .lxi.
Numbers 31:40 And the wemen were .xvi. thousande, of whiche the Lordes parte was .xxxij. soules.
Numbers 31:41 And Moses gaue that summe which was the lordes heaueoffryng vnto Eleazar the preast: as the Lorde commaunded Moses.
Numbers 31:42 And the other halfe of the chyldren of Israel which Moses separated from the men of warre
Numbers 31:43 (that is to wete, the halfe that pertayned vnto the congregacion) was .iij. hundred thousande and .xxxvij. thousand and fyue hundred shepe:
Numbers 31:44 & .xxxvi. thousande oxen:
Numbers 31:45 and .xxx. thousand asses and fyue hundred:
Numbers 31:46 & .xvi. thousande wemen.
Numbers 31:47 And Moses toke of this halfe that pertayned vnto the chyldren of Israel: one of euery fyftye, both of the wemen and of the catel, and gaue them vnto the Leuites whyche wayted vpon the habitacion of the Lorde, as the Lorde commaunded Moses.
Numbers 31:48 And the offycers of thousandes of the hoste, the captaynes ouer the thousandes and the captaynes ouer the hundredes came forth & sayd vnto Moses:
Numbers 31:49 Thy seruauntes haue taken the summe of the men of warre, which were vnder oure hand, and there lacked, not one man of them.
Numbers 31:50 We haue therfore brought a present vnto the Lorde what euery man found of Iewels of golde, cheynes, bracelettes, rynges, earynges and spangels, to make an attonement for our soules before the Lord.
Numbers 31:51 And Moses and Eleazar toke the golde of them: Iewels of all maner facions.
Numbers 31:52 And al the gold of the heaueoffring of the Lord, of the captaynes ouer thousandes & hundredes was .xvi. thousand .vij. hundred and .l. sicles
Numbers 31:53 for the men of warre had spoyled, euery man for him selfe.
Numbers 31:54 And Moses & Eleazar the preast toke the golde of the captaynes ouer the thousandes and ouer the hundredes, and brought it into the tabernacle of wytnesse: to be a memorial vnto the children of Israel, before the Lorde.

CHAPTER: 32

Numbers 32:1 The chyldren of Ruben and the children of Gad, had an exceadyng greate multitude of catel. And when they sawe the lande of Iazer and the land of Galaad that it was an apte place for catell,
Numbers 32:2 they came and spake vnto Moses and Eleazar the preast and vnto the Lordes of the congregacion sayinge.
Numbers 32:3 The land of Ataroth & Dibo and Iazer, and Nemrah & Hesbon & Elealeh and Sabam & Nebo and Beon,
Numbers 32:4 whiche contrye the Lord smote before the congregacion of Israel: is a land for catel and we thy seruauntes haue catel
Numbers 32:5 wherfore (sayde they) yf we haue found grace in thy syghte, let thys lande be geuen vnto thy seruauntes to possesse, & brynge vs not ouer Iordan.
Numbers 32:6 And Moses sayd vnto the chyldren of Gad & of Ruben: shall your brethren go to warre and ye tarye here?
Numbers 32:7 Wherfore discorage ye the hertes of the chyldren of Israel for to go ouer into the land whych the Lord hath geuen them.
Numbers 32:8 This dyd your fathers, when I sent them from Cades barne to se the land.
Numbers 32:9 And they went vp euen vnto the ryuer of Escol and sawe the lande, and dyscoraged the hertes of the chyldren of Israell, that they should not go into the land which the Lorde had geuen them.
Numbers 32:10 And the Lorde was wroth the same tyme and sware sayinge.
Numbers 32:11 None of the men that came out of Egypte from twenty yere olde and aboue, shal se the lande whych I sware vnto Abraham, Isaac and Iacob, because they haue not contynually folowed me:
Numbers 32:12 saue Caleb the sonne of Iephune the Kenesite, & Iosua the sonne of Nun, for they haue folowed me continually,
Numbers 32:13 And the Lord was angry wyth Israel, & made them wandre in the wyldernesse .xl. yere, vntyl al the generacion that had done euel in the syghte of the Lord were consumed.
Numbers 32:14 And beholde, ye are rysen vp in your fathers steade, to the encrease of synfull men, and to augment the fearse wrath of the lord to Israell warde.
Numbers 32:15 For yf ye tourne awaye from after him, he wyll yet agayn leaue the people in the wyldernesse, so shal ye destroy al thys folke.
Numbers 32:16 And they went nere hym and sayde: we wyl buylde shepefoldes here for our shepe and for oure catell, and cyties for our chyldren.
Numbers 32:17 But we our selues wil go ready armed before the chyldren of Israell, vntyll we haue brought them vnto their place. And oure chyldren shall dwell in the fenced cyties, because of the inhabiters of the land.
Numbers 32:18 And we wyll not retourne vnto oure houses, vntyll the chyldren of Israel haue enhereted: euery man hys enheritaunce.
Numbers 32:19 For we wyll not enheret wyth them on yonder side Iordan forwarde, because oure enheritaunce is falled to vs on thys syde Iordan eastwarde.
Numbers 32:20 And Moses sayd vnto them: If ye wyl do thys thynge, that ye wyl go all harnessed before the Lord to warre,
Numbers 32:21 and wyll go all of you in harnesse ouer Iordan before the Lord, vntyll he haue cast out hys enemyes before him,
Numbers 32:22 and vntyl the land be subdued before the Lord, then ye shall retourne and be without synne agaynst the Lord & agaynst Israell, & thys lande shalbe your possessyon before the Lorde.
Numbers 32:23 But and yf ye wyl not do so, behold, ye synne agaynst the Lord: and be sure your synne wyll fynde you out.
Numbers 32:24 Bylde youre cyties for your chyldren and fouldes for your shepe, and se ye do that ye haue spoken.
Numbers 32:25 And the chyldren of Gad and of Ruben spake vnto Moses sayinge: thy seruauntes wyl do as my Lorde commaundeth.
Numbers 32:26 Our children our wyues substance and all oure catell shall remayne here in the cyties of Galaad.
Numbers 32:27 But we thy seruauntes wyll go all harnessed for the warre vnto battell before the Lorde, as my Lord hath sayd.
Numbers 32:28 And Moses commaunded Eleazar the Preast: and Iosua the sonne of Nun and the auncient heades of the trybes of the chyldren of Israel,
Numbers 32:29 and sayd vnto them: If the children of Gad and Ruben wyll go wyth you ouer Iordan, al prepared to feyght before the Lord then when the land is subdued vnto you, geue them the lande of Galaad to possesse,
Numbers 32:30 but & yf they wyll not go ouer wyth you in harnesse, then they shall haue their possessyons among you in the land of Canaan.
Numbers 32:31 And the children of Gad & Ruben answered saying: that whych the Lord hath sayd vnto thy seruauntes we wyl do.
Numbers 32:32 We wyl go harnessed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, and the possessyon of our enheritaunce shalbe on thys syde Iordan.
Numbers 32:33 And Moses gaue vnto the chyldren of Gad and of Ruben and vnto halfe the trybe of Manasse the sonne of Ioseph, the kyngdome of Sehon kynge of the Amorites, and the kyngdome of Og kynge of Bason, the lande that longed vnto the cyties therof in the costes of the countre rounde aboute.
Numbers 32:34 And the chyldren of Gad bylte Didon, Ataroth, Aroer, Atroth,
Numbers 32:35 Sophan, Iaeser, Iegabea,
Numbers 32:36 Bethnimra and Betharan fenced cytyes, and they buylt foldes for the shepe.
Numbers 32:37 And the chyldren of Ruben bylte Hesbon, Eleale, Kiriathaim,
Numbers 32:38 Nebo, Baal, Meon and turned theyr names, and Sibaina also: and gaue names vnto the cyties whych they buylt.
Numbers 32:39 And the chyldren of Machir the sonne of Manasse went to Galaad and toke it, and put oute the Amorites that were therin.
Numbers 32:40 And Moses gaue Galaad vnto Machir the sonne of Manasse, and he dwelt therin.
Numbers 32:41 And Iahir the sonne of Manasse went and toke the small townes therof, and called them the townes of Iair.
Numbers 32:42 And Nobah went and and toke Kenath wyth the townes longynge therto, and called it Nobah after his awne name.

CHAPTER: 33

Numbers 33:1 These are the iourneyes of the children of Israell which went out of the land of Egypte wt theyr armies vnder Moses and Aaron.
Numbers 33:2 And Moses wrote theyr goyinge oute by their iourneyes at the commaundement of the Lord: euen these are the iourneyes of their goynge out.
Numbers 33:3 The chyldren of Israel departed from Rahemses the .xv. day of the fyrst moneth, on the morow after. Passeouer, and went out wyth an hye hand in the syghte of all Egypte,
Numbers 33:4 whyle the Egypcyans buryed al their fyrstborne which the Lord had smytten amonge them. And vpon their goddes also the Lorde dyd execucyon.
Numbers 33:5 And the children of Israel remoued from Rahemses and pitched in Socoth.
Numbers 33:6 And they departed from Socoth & pytched their tentes in Ethan, whyche is in the edge of the wyldernesse.
Numbers 33:7 And they remoued from Ethan & tourned vnto the entring of Hiroth whych is before Baall Zephon, and pitched before Migdol.
Numbers 33:8 And they departed from before Hiroth and went thorowe the myddes of the sea into the wyldernesse, and went .iij. dayes iourney in the wildernesse of Ethan and pytched in Marah.
Numbers 33:9 And they remoued from Marah and went vnto Elim where were .xij. fountaynes & .lxx. paulmetrees and they pitched there.
Numbers 33:10 And they remoued from Elim & laye fast by the red sea.
Numbers 33:11 And they remoued from the red sea and laye in the wyldernesse of Sin.
Numbers 33:12 And they toke their iourney out of the wyldernesse of Sin, and set vp their tentes in Daphka.
Numbers 33:13 And they departed from Daphka, & lay in Alus.
Numbers 33:14 And they remoued from Alus, and lay at Raphedim, where was no water for the people to drynke.
Numbers 33:15 And they departed from Raphedim, and pitched in the wyldernesse of Sinai.
Numbers 33:16 And they remoued from the desert of Sinay, and lodged at the graues of lust.
Numbers 33:17 And they departed from the sepulchres of lust, & lay at Hazeroth.
