2 Chronicles 1:15 And the kynge made syluer & gould at Ierusalem as plenteous as stones & Cedar trees as plentye as the mulbery trees that grow in the valeys.
2 Chronicles 1:16 And the horses whiche Salomon had, were brought hym oute of Egypt from Keua. The kynges marchauntes fet them out at Keua at a pryce.
2 Chronicles 1:17 They came and broughte out of Egypte a charet for syxe hundred sycles, and an horse for an hundred & fyfty. And so broughte they to all the kynges of the Hethites, and to the kynges of Syrya thorow the handes of the sayde marchauntes.

CHAPTER: 2

2 Chronicles 2:1 And Salomon determined to buylde an house for the name of the Lorde, and an house for hys kyngedome:
2 Chronicles 2:2 and tolde out thre skore and ten thousand men to beare burdens and foure skore thousande to hewe in the mountayne, and thre thousande and sixe hundred to ouer se them.
2 Chronicles 2:3 And Salomon sent to Hiram kynge of Tyre, saying: As thou diddest deale with Dauid my father, and dyddest sende hym Cedar woode, to buylde hym an house to dwell in, euen so deale wyth me now:
2 Chronicles 2:4 that I may builde an house for the name of the Lorde my God, to consecrate it to hym to burne swete odours & to set shewbread before hym perpetuallye, & for burntsacrifyce mornynge and euenyng, & on the Saboth dayes, and the fyrst daye of euery newe mone, and in the solempne feastes of the Lorde oure God, so to continue euer in Israel.
2 Chronicles 2:5 And the house which I buyld, is great: for great is oure God aboue all Goddes:
2 Chronicles 2:6 So that wo can be able to buylde hym an house: when that heauen, neyther heauen aboue all heauens is able to receyue hym, what am I then that I shulde buylde hym an house? nay, but to burne sacryfyce before hym:
2 Chronicles 2:7 sende me now therfore a connynge man to worcke in goulde, syluer, brasse, yron, scarlet, cremosyn & Iacincte coloure, & that can skylle to graue, to be wyth the connynge men that are wyth me in Iuda and Ierusalem, which Dauid my father dyd prepare.
2 Chronicles 2:8 And sende me also Cedar trees, fyrre trees, & Algume trees out of Lybanon. For I wote well thy seruauntes can skylle to hew timbre in Lybanon. And se, my men shalbe wyth thyne,
2 Chronicles 2:9 that they may prepare me tymbre ynough. For the house which I builde is great & wonderfull.
2 Chronicles 2:10 And beholde, I sente for thy seruauntes the cutters and hewers of tymbre .xx. thousande quarters of beaten whete, & .xx. thousande quarters of barleye, & .xx. thousande bathes of wyne, & .xx. thousand bathes of oyle.
2 Chronicles 2:11 And Hyram kynge of Tyre aunswered in wrytynge & sente to Salomon: because the Lord loueth hys people, therfore he hath made the kyng ouer them.
2 Chronicles 2:12 And Hiram sayde moreouer: blessed be the Lord God of Israel which hath made bothe heauen and earth, that he hath geuen Dauid the kynge a wyse sonne that hath discrecyon and vnderstandynge, to buylde an house for the Lorde, and auother for his kingdome.
2 Chronicles 2:13 And nowe I haue sente a wyse man & a man of vnderstandyng called Hyram Abi,
2 Chronicles 2:14 and is the sonne of a woman of the doughters of Dan (howe be it, hys father was a Tiryan) and he can skylle to worke in gould, syluer, brasse, yron, stone, tymbre, scarlet, Iacinct bysse & cremosyn: and graue all maner of grauynges, & to fynde oute all maner sotle worck that shalbe set before hym, wyth thy conning men, and with the conning men of my Lorde Dauid thy father.
2 Chronicles 2:15 And now the whete, barleye, oyle and wyne whiche my Lorde hath sayde: let hym sende hys seruauntes.
2 Chronicles 2:16 And we wyll cut wood oute of Lybane, as muche as thou shalte nede, and wyll brynge it to the in shippes by the sea to porte Iapo: & thence thou mayest carye them to Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 2:17 And Salomon numbred all the straungers that were in the lande of Israel, after the tyme hys father Dauid had nombred them. And they were found an hundred, and .liij. thousande and syxe hundred.
2 Chronicles 2:18 And he set .lxx. thousande of them to beare burthens, and .lxxx. thousande to hewe in the mountayne, and thre thousand and syxe hundred to courage and to set the people a worck.

CHAPTER: 3

2 Chronicles 3:1 And Salomon beganne to build the house of the Lorde at Ierusalem in mount Moriah, whiche was shewed Dauid hys father when he prepared a place in the treshyng floure of Ornan the Iebusite.
2 Chronicles 3:2 And he began to buylde the seconde daye of the seconde moneth the fourth yeare of hys raigne.
2 Chronicles 3:3 And thys is the foundacyon of Salomon in buyldyng the house of God. The lenght was thre skore cubytes after the olde cubyte, and the bredeth .xx.
2 Chronicles 3:4 And the porche at the end was as large as the house bredeth .xx. cubytes: and the heyght was an hundred & .xx. cubites. And he ouerlayd it on the ynner syde wt pure gold.
2 Chronicles 3:5 And the great house he syled with fyrre tre, & ouerlayde it with good goulde, and graued therto paulmetrees and cheynes.
2 Chronicles 3:6 And he paued the house with preciouse stone goodlye. And it was goulde of Pharuaim.
2 Chronicles 3:7 And he ouerlayde the house: bothe beames, postes, walles & dores with goulde, & graued Cherubes vpon the walles.
2 Chronicles 3:8 And he made the house moost holy, whose length was .xx. cubytes lyke to the breadeth of the house, and the breadeth thereof was also .xx. cubytes. And he ouerlayde it with the best goulde, that drue to the summe of .vi. hundred talentes.
2 Chronicles 3:9 And the wayghte of the nayles of goulde was therto fyftye sycles. And he ouerlayde the vpper chambres wyth goulde.
2 Chronicles 3:10 And he made in the house moost holy two Cherubes of Image worke, & ouerlayd them with goulde.
2 Chronicles 3:11 And the wynges of the Cherubes were .xx. cubytes longe. The one wynge was fyue cubytes, and touched the wall of the house, and the other wynge was lykewyse .v. cubytes, & touched the wyng of the other Cherub.
2 Chronicles 3:12 And the one wynge of the other Cherub was fyue cubytes, and touched the wal of the house, and the other wynge was fyue cubites also, and raught to the wing of the other Cherub.
2 Chronicles 3:13 So that the wynges of the sayde Cherubes raughte .xx. cubytes. And they stode on theyr fete, & loked inwardes.
2 Chronicles 3:14 And he made a fore hangynge of Iacincte coloure, of scarlet, cremosyne & bysse: & caused Cherubes to be bourdered thereon.
2 Chronicles 3:15 And he made before the house two pyllers of .xxxv. cubytes long. And the heade that was aboue on the toppe of one of them was fyue cubytes.
2 Chronicles 3:16 And he made such chaynes as was in the quere, & put them on the heades of the pyllers, & made an hundred pomegranates, & put them on the chaines.
2 Chronicles 3:17 And he rered vp the pyllers before the temple, one on the ryghte hand, and another on the left, & called the ryght Iachin & the lefte Boaz.

CHAPTER: 4

2 Chronicles 4:1 And he made an aulter of brasse .xx. cubytes longe & .xx. cubytes broade & ten cubytes hye.
2 Chronicles 4:2 And he caste a brasen sea of ten cubytes from brym to brym, & round in compase & fyue cubytes hye: and a lyne of .xxx. cubytes myght haue compased it rounde about.
2 Chronicles 4:3 And the fashyon of oxen dyd compase it rounde about vnder it: that is to wete, two rowes of oxen cast when it was caste, dyd compase that sea which was ten cubytes wyde, rounde aboute.
2 Chronicles 4:4 And it stode also vpon twelue oxen: of which thre loked North thre West, thre Southe and thre East, and the sea vpon them aboue an hye, and the hynder partes of them inwarde.
2 Chronicles 4:5 And the thickest of it was an handebreade, and the brym lyke the brym of a cuppe, with floures of lylyes. And it receyued & helde the thousande bathes.
2 Chronicles 4:6 And he made ten lauers: & put fyue on the ryght hande & fyue on the left, to washe with all. And in them they thruste the fleshe of the burntofferynges. But the sea was for the priestes to washe in.
2 Chronicles 4:7 And he made ten candelstyckes of goulde in the fashyons, and put them in the temple: fyue on the ryghte hand & fyue on the lefte.
2 Chronicles 4:8 And he made also ten tables, and put them in the temple: fyue on the ryght syde and fyue on the lefte. And he made an hundred basens of goulde.
2 Chronicles 4:9 And he made the courte of the priestes, and the great courte and dores to it: and ouerlaid the dores of them with brasse.
2 Chronicles 4:10 And he set the sea in the ryghte syde of the East ende, towarde the Southe.
2 Chronicles 4:11 And Hyram made pottes, shouelles and basens. And Hyram fynyshed the worcke, he made for kynge Salomon vnto the temple of God,
2 Chronicles 4:12 the two pyllers with their scalpes of the two heades that were on the toppes of the pillers: and the two wrethes to couer the two scalpes of the heades that were on the toppes of the pillers,
2 Chronicles 4:13 and foure hundred pomegranates for the two wrethes, two rowes of pomegranates for euery wrethe, to couer the two scalpes of the heades that were on the pyllers.
2 Chronicles 4:14 And he made bottomes, and lauers vpon the bottomes,
2 Chronicles 4:15 & the sea wyth twelue oxen vnder it.
2 Chronicles 4:16 And therto pottes, schouelles, flesh hokes, and all theyr vesselles dyd Hyram Abi make for king Salomon for the house of the Lorde, of bright brasse.
2 Chronicles 4:17 In the playne of Iordan dyd the kyng caste them, in the thicke earthe, betwene Socoth & Zaredatha.
2 Chronicles 4:18 And made of all these vesselles so myghty great aboundaunce, that the weight of brasse coulde not be rekened.
2 Chronicles 4:19 And Salomon made all the vesselles that pertayned to the house of God: the goulden aulter and the tables with the shewe breade vpon them,
2 Chronicles 4:20 the candelstickes with theyr lampes to burne after the maner before the quere, & that of pure goulde,
2 Chronicles 4:21 and the floures and the lampes, and the snoffers were goulde, & that perfecte goulde:
2 Chronicles 4:22 and the dressynge knyues, basens, spones and censers of pure goulde. And the ynner dores of the place moost holye, and the dores of the temple to, were goulde.

CHAPTER: 5

2 Chronicles 5:1 And so was all the worcke that Salomon made for the house of the Lorde fynyshed. And when the worcke that Salomon made in the house of the Lorde was fynyshed: then Salomon brought in the gyftes dedicate by Dauid hys father, the syluer and the goulde and all the Iewelles, and put them amonge the treasure of the house of God.
2 Chronicles 5:2 Then Salomon gathered the elders of Israell together and all the heades of the tribes and auncyent Lordes amonge the chyldren of Israell, vnto Ierusalem, to brynge the arcke of the couenaunt of the Lorde oute of the cyty of Dauid which is Zion.
2 Chronicles 5:3 And all the men of Israell resorted vnto the kynge in the feaste of the seuenthe moneth.
2 Chronicles 5:4 And when all the elders of Israell were come, the Leuites toke vp the arcke.
2 Chronicles 5:5 And the priestes of the Leuytes brought away the arcke & the tabernacle of wytnesse, and all the holy vesselles that were in the tabernacle.
2 Chronicles 5:6 And king Salomon and all the congregacyon of Israel that were assembled vnto hym before the arck, offered shepe and oxen, so manye that they coulde not be tolde or numbred for multitude.
2 Chronicles 5:7 And the priestes broughte the arcke of the appoyntment of the Lorde vnto hys place in the quere of the temple & place moste holye: euen vnder the wynges of the Cherubes,
2 Chronicles 5:8 that the Cherubes stretched oute theyr wynges ouer the place of the arcke, & couered the arcke and her staues aboue on hye.
2 Chronicles 5:9 And the staues of the arcke were so longe, that they were sene a lytle before the quere, but not farre wythoute. And there it remayneth vnto this daye.
2 Chronicles 5:10 More ouer there was nothinge in the arcke saue the two tables whiche Moses put therein at Horeb, when the Lorde made a couenaunte with the chyldren of Israell, after they were come oute of Egypte.
2 Chronicles 5:11 And when the priestes were come oute of the holye place (for all the priestes that were founde, sanctyfyed them selues and dyd not wayt by course.)
2 Chronicles 5:12 But the Leuites euery one of them that were vnder Asaph, Heman and Iduthun, and among theyr chyldren and brethren, were arayed in bysse and sang wyth Simbales, Psalteryes, and harpes standyng East from the aulter, and wyth them an hundred and .xx. priestes blowynge trompettes.
2 Chronicles 5:13 And the trompette blowers & the syngers so agreed, that it semed but one voice in praysing & thankynge the Lorde. And as the voyce of the trompettes, symbales and instrumentes of melodye arose, & as they praysed the Lord, how that he was good and that hys mercye lasteth euer, the house of the Lorde was fylled with a cloude,
2 Chronicles 5:14 so that the priestes coulde not endure to mynyster by the reason of the cloude. For the glorye of the Lorde had fylled the house of God.

CHAPTER: 6

2 Chronicles 6:1 Then Salomon sayde: the Lorde hath spoken it, how that he wyll dwel in darckenesse.
2 Chronicles 6:2 And I haue buylt an habitacyon for the and a place to dwell in for euer.
2 Chronicles 6:3 And the kynge turned hys face, & blessed the hole congregacyon of Israel, and all the congregacyon of Israel stode.
2 Chronicles 6:4 And he sayde: blessed be the Lorde God of Israell which spake wyth hys mouthe to my father Dauid, & hath fulfylled it wyth handes, for God sayde:
2 Chronicles 6:5 sence the tyme I broughte my people oute of the lande of Egypte, I chose no cytye amonge all the trybes of Israell to buylde an house in, that my name myght be there, nether chose I any man to be a ruler ouer my people Israel.
2 Chronicles 6:6 But nowe I haue chosen Ierusalem to haue my name there, & haue chosen Dauid to be ouer my people Israell.
2 Chronicles 6:7 And it was in the herte of Dauid my father to buylde an house for the name of the Lorde God of Israel:
2 Chronicles 6:8 But the Lorde sayde to Dauid my father: for as muche as it was in thyne herte, to buylde an house for my name, thou dyddest well that thou haddest it in thine herte.
2 Chronicles 6:9 Notwithstandyng thou shalt not build the house, but thy sonne whiche shall Issue oute of thy loynes, he shall buyld an house for my name.
2 Chronicles 6:10 And the Lorde hath made good his saying that he hath spoken. For I arose in the roume of Dauid my father, & sate on the seate of Israel, as the Lorde promysed, & haue buylt an house for the name of the Lorde God of Israel.
2 Chronicles 6:11 And therein I haue put the arcke wherin the couenaunte of the Lorde made with the chyldren of Israel, is.
2 Chronicles 6:12 And he stepte forthe before the aulter of the Lord in the presence of all the congregacion of Israel, and stretched out his handes,
2 Chronicles 6:13 now Salomon had made a brasen pulpyte of fyue cubytes longe, and fyue cubytes broad, and thre of heyght, and had set it in the middes of the greate courte, vpon that he stept & kneled doune vpon hys knees before all the congregacyon of Israel & stretched oute hys handes to heauen
2 Chronicles 6:14 & sayde: Lorde God of Israel there is no God lyke the eyther in heauen or in earth, whiche kepest couenaunt & sheweste mercy vnto thy seruauntes that walck before the with all theyr hertes.
2 Chronicles 6:15 Which hast kepte with Dauid my father that thou promysedest him: thou saydeste it wyth thy mouthe, and haste fulfylled it with thyne hande, as it is to se this day.
2 Chronicles 6:16 Now Lord God of Israel kepe wt thy seruaunt Dauid my father, that thou promisedest him saying: thou shalt not be without one or other in my sight that shall sitte vpon the seate of Israel. Of this condicion yet, yf thy children will take hede to theyr waies to walcke in my lawe, as thou hast walcked before me.
2 Chronicles 6:17 Nowe Lorde God of Israel, let thy sayinge be true, whiche thou saydest vnto thy seruaunte Dauid.
2 Chronicles 6:18 How be it in very dede, can God dwel wt man on earth? Behold, nether heauen or heauen aboue all heauens is able to containe the: howe shuld the house then which I haue built for the do it?
2 Chronicles 6:19 But turne to the praier of thy seruaunte & to his supplicacion (O Lord my God) to herken vnto the voyce & prayer which thy seruaunte maketh before the.
2 Chronicles 6:20 That thyne eyes be open ouer this house daye & nyght, & ouer the place of which thou hast said, that thou woldest put thy name there: to herken vnto the prayer which thy seruaunte prayeth at thys place:
2 Chronicles 6:21 herken therfore vnto the prayers of thy seruaunt & of thy peole Israel, whiche they praye in thys place. But heare thou it oute of thy dwellyng place heauen: & when thou hearest it be mercyfull.
2 Chronicles 6:22 If a man synne agaynst his neybour, & an adiuracyon be layd to hys charge, to adiure him with al, & the adiuracion come before thine aulter in thys house:
2 Chronicles 6:23 then heare thou from heauen, & worcke & iudge thy seruauntes, that thou rewarde the euyll, and bring his waye vpon hys heade, & iustify the ryghteous & geue him accordynge to hys ryghteousnesse.
2 Chronicles 6:24 Lykewyse yf thy people Israel be put to the worse before theyr enemies, because they haue synned agaynste the: Yet yf they turne and confesse thy name, and make intercessyon & praye before the in thys house,
2 Chronicles 6:25 then heare thou from heauen and be mercyful vnto the synne of thy people Israel, and brynge them agayne vnto the lande which thou gauest to them and to theyr fathers.
2 Chronicles 6:26 If heauen be shut vp, that there be no raine, because they haue synned agaynste the: yet yf they praye at thys place, and confesse thy name and turne from theyr synnes at thy scourgynge:
2 Chronicles 6:27 then heare thou from heauen, and be mercyfull vnto the synne of thy seruauntes, & of thy people Israel, that thou shewe them a good waye to walke in, and sende rayne vpon thy lande whiche thou haste geuen vnto thy people, for an enherytaunce.
2 Chronicles 6:28 If there chaunce darthe in the lande, pestilence, burnynge or smytynge of corne, grashoppers or caterpyllers, or that theyr enemies besege them in the cytyes of theyr owne land, or what soeuer plage or syckenesse it be.
2 Chronicles 6:29 Then all the supplicacyons and prayers that shalbe made of all men amonge all thy people Israell, whiche shall knowe euery man his owne sore and hys owne greffe, & shal stretche oute theyr handes towarde thys house:
2 Chronicles 6:30 thou shalte heare from heauen thy dwellyng place and shalte be mercyfull, and geue euery man accordynge vnto all hys waye, euen as thou shalte knowe euery mannes herte: for thou onelye knoweste the hertes of the chyldren of Adam:
2 Chronicles 6:31 that they maye feare the, and walke in thy wayes as long as they lyue vpon the earth whiche thou gauest to oure fathers.
2 Chronicles 6:32 Therto a straunger which is not of thy people Israel, yf he come from a farre lande for thy greate names sake, and thy myghtye hande, and stretched oute arme, and therfore come & praye at thys house:
2 Chronicles 6:33 thou shalte heare hym from heauen thy dwellyng place, & shalt do accordyng to all that the straunger calleth to the for. That all the nacyons of the earthe maye knowe thy name, and feare the, as doth thy people Israell: and that it maye be knowen how that this house which I haue buylt, is called after thy name.
2 Chronicles 6:34 When thy people shall go oute to warre, agaynste theyr ennemyes the waye that thou shalte send them. If they pray to the, the way towarde thys cytye whiche thou haste chosen and house whiche I haue buylt for thy name:
2 Chronicles 6:35 then heare from heauen, theyr supplicacyon & prayer, and helpe them in theyr ryghte.
2 Chronicles 6:36 If they shall synne agaynste the (as there is no man but that he shall synne) & thou be angrye wyth them, and delyuer them to their enemyes, and they layde them away captyue vnto a lande ferre or neare,
2 Chronicles 6:37 yet yf theyr hertes come to them agayne in the lande where they be in captiuite, and turne and praye vnto the in the land where they be in captiuite, saying: we haue synned & haue done euyl & wickedly
2 Chronicles 6:38 & turne agayne to the, wyth all theyr hertes & all theyr soules, in the lande of theyr captyuite where they be kepte in bondage, and so praye towarde theyr lande which thou gauest vnto theyr fathers, and cytye which thou hast chosen, and to thys house whiche I haue built for thy name:
2 Chronicles 6:39 Then heare from heauen thy dwellyng place, their supplicacyon & prayers & iudge theyr cause, and be mercifull vnto thy people, though they haue synned against the.
2 Chronicles 6:40 So now my God let thyne eyes be open & thyne eares attente vnto the prayers made in thys place.
2 Chronicles 6:41 And now vp Lorde God in thy restynge place: both thou and the arcke of thy strengthe, and let thy priestes put on vyctorye and thy saynctes reioyse in goodnesse.
2 Chronicles 6:42 And Lorde God turne not away the face of thyne anointed. But remembre the mercyes promysed to Dauid thy seruaunte.

CHAPTER: 7

2 Chronicles 7:1 And when Salomon had made an ende of praying, there came doune fyre from heauen & consumed the burntofferyng and the sacryfyces. And the glorye of the Lorde fylled the house:
2 Chronicles 7:2 that the priestes coulde not go into the house of the Lorde, because the glorye of the Lord had fulfilled the house of the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 7:3 And all the children of Israell saw how the fyre came doune and the glory of the Lorde vpon the house, & stouped with their faces to the earth vpon the pauement & bowed them selues & confessed vnto the Lord, that he was good, and that hys mercye lasted euer.
2 Chronicles 7:4 And the kynge and all the people offered offerynges before the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 7:5 So that kynge Salomon offered .xxij. thousand oxen, and an hundred and twentye thousand shepe. And so the kynge & all the people halowed the house of God.
2 Chronicles 7:6 And the priestes wayted on theyr offices, and the Leuites with instrumentes of musycke of the Lorde which kinge Dauid made to confesse vnto the Lorde that hys mercye lasteth euer, when Dauid gaue prayse thorowe theyr handes. And the priestes blewe trompettes faste by them: and all Israell stode.
2 Chronicles 7:7 Moreouer Salomon halowed the myddle of the courte that was before the Lorde: for there he offered burntofferynges and the fat of the peaceofferynges, because the brasen aulter which Salomon had made, was not able to receyue the burntofferynges and the meat offerynges and the fatte.
2 Chronicles 7:8 And Salomon kepte a feast the same ceason of seuen dayes, and all Israel with hym, an exceadynge great congregacyon, euen from Hemath vnto the ryuer of Egypte.
2 Chronicles 7:9 And the eyght daye they made a gatheryng. For they kept the halowyng of the aulter seuen dayes, & the feast seuen dayes.
2 Chronicles 7:10 And the .xxiij. daye of the seuenth moneth, he let the people departe into theyr tentes, glad & merye in herte for the goodnesse that the Lord had shewed to Dauid, to Salomon & to Israel hys people.
2 Chronicles 7:11 And so Salomon fynyshed the house of the Lorde & the kynges house and al that came in his hert to make in the house of the Lorde and in hys owne house, and that prosperouslye.
2 Chronicles 7:12 And the Lorde apeared to Salomon by nyght, and said to him: I haue hearde thy peticyon & haue chosen thys place for my self to be an house of sacryfyce.
2 Chronicles 7:13 Moreouer yf I shut vp heauen that there be no rayne, or yf I commaund the locustes to deuoure the lande, or yf I send pestilence among my people:
2 Chronicles 7:14 yet yf my people that are named after my name, shall humble themselues & make intercessyon & seke my presence, & turne from their wicked wayes, then wyll I heare from heauen and be mercyfull to theyr synnes, & wyl heale theyr lande.
2 Chronicles 7:15 Therto myne eyes shalbe open & myne eares attente vnto the prayers made in thys place.
2 Chronicles 7:16 And fynally I haue chosen and sanctyfyed this house, that my name be there for euer, & myne eyes & myne herte shalbe there perpetuallye.
2 Chronicles 7:17 And yf thou shalte walke before me as Dauid thy father walked, to do accordynge to all that I haue commaunded the, & shalt obserue myne ordynaunces & my lawes:
2 Chronicles 7:18 then I wyll stablyshe the seate of thy kyngedome, accordynge to the couenaunt I made with Dauid thy father, saying: thou shalt haue euer one or other that shall rule in Israel.
2 Chronicles 7:19 But and yf ye turne awaye & forsake myne ordinaunces & my commaundementes which I haue set before you, and shal go & serue other Goddes & bowe youre selues to them:
2 Chronicles 7:20 then wyll I plucke them vp by the rotes oute of my lande which I haue geuen them, & wyll cast thys house which I haue sanctyfyed for my name out of my syght, & wyll make a prouerbe & a tale of it amonge all nacyons.
2 Chronicles 7:21 And this house that is so hye, shalbe a wonder to al that passeth therby, that they shall saye: why hath the Lorde dealte on thys fashyon with thys lande and with this house?
2 Chronicles 7:22 And it shalbe aunswered them because they forsoke the Lorde God of theyr fathers whiche brought them oute of the lande of Egypte, and caught holde on other Gods, and bowed to them, and serued them: euen therfore broughte he on them all thys euyll.

CHAPTER: 8

2 Chronicles 8:1 And after .xx. yeare when Salomon had buylt the house of the Lorde and hys owne house:
2 Chronicles 8:2 he buylte the cytyes that Hiram gaue him, and put of the children of Israel in them.
2 Chronicles 8:3 And Salomon went to Hemath Zobah and strengthed it.
2 Chronicles 8:4 And he buylte Thadmor in the wyldernesse and all the store cytyes whiche he buylte in Hemath.
2 Chronicles 8:5 And he buylt Bethhoron the vpper & Bethhoron the nether, and made them stronge cytyes wyth walles, gates, & barres.
2 Chronicles 8:6 And Baalath & all the store cyties that Salomon had, & al the charet cytyes & the cities of Horsmen, and all that Salomon had lust to buyld in Ierusalem and Libanon, and thorowoute all the lande of his domynyon.
2 Chronicles 8:7 And all the people that were left of the Hethites, Amorites, Pheresites, Heuites and Iebusites, which were not of the chyldren of Israel:
2 Chronicles 8:8 euen the children of them, which were left after them in the lande, and were not consumed of the chyldren of Israel, then dyd Salomon make trybutaryes vnto thys daye.
2 Chronicles 8:9 But of the chyldren of Israel dyd Salomon make no bondemen in his worke: but they were men of warre & rulers & great Lordes wyth him, & capytaynes ouer hys charettes and horsmen.
2 Chronicles 8:10 And kyng Salomons offycers that ouersaw and ruled the people, were two hundred and fyftye.
2 Chronicles 8:11 And Salomon brought the doughter of Pharao oute of the citie of Dauid into the house that he had made for her. For he saide: my wyfe shall not dwelle in the house of Dauid kynge of Israel, for it is holy, because the arcke of the Lorde came into it.
2 Chronicles 8:12 And from thence forthe Salomon offered burntofferynges vnto the Lorde on the aulter of the Lord which he had buylt before the porc
2 Chronicles 8:13 to offer day by daye accordynge to the commaundement of Moses, & in the Sabbotes & newe mones, and the thre solempne feastes of the yeare, the feast of swete breade, the feast of wekes and the feast of bothes.
2 Chronicles 8:14 And Salomon put the sortes of pryestes in companyes as Dauid hys father had ordered them, vnto the offyces, & the Leuites vnto theyr wayt, for to prayse & mynystre before the priestes daye by daye, and the porters by course at euerye gate. For so had Dauid the man of God commaunded.
2 Chronicles 8:15 And the commaundement of the kynge vnto the priestes & the Leuites concernyng whatsoeuer cause it was, and concernynge the treasures, was not disobeyed.
2 Chronicles 8:16 And all the worke of Salomon wente lustely forwarde euen vnto the daye of the foundacyon of the house of the Lorde was layde: & from thence tyll he had fynyshed it, that the house of the Lorde was perfecte.
2 Chronicles 8:17 And then went kynge Salomon to Azion Gaber and to Eloth & to the seas syde in the land of Edom.
2 Chronicles 8:18 And Hiram sent hym by the hande of his seruauntes, shyppes and seruauntes that coulde saille of the sea. Which went with the seruauntes of Salomon to Ophir, and brought thence foure hundred and fyftye talentes of goulde, and brought it to kinge Salomon.

CHAPTER: 9

2 Chronicles 9:1 And the quene of Saba heard of the fame of Salomon, and came to proue hym with ryddelles at Ierusalem, wyth a very great companye, & wyth camelles that bare swete odours and plentye of goulde & precyouse stone. And when she was come to Salomon, she communed with him of all that was in her herte.
2 Chronicles 9:2 And Salomon foyled her all her questyons, that there was nothynge hyd from Salomon, which he tolde her not.
2 Chronicles 9:3 And when the quene of Saba had sene the wysdome of Salomon and the house that he had buylt,
2 Chronicles 9:4 and the meate of hys table and the syttynge of hys seruauntes and the standyng of hys wayters, and theyr apparell, and hys buttelars wyth theyr apparell, & his parlour out of which he went into the house of the Lord there was no more herte in her.
2 Chronicles 9:5 And then she said to the king: the sayinge which I hearde in myne owne lande, of thyne actes and of thy wysdome is truet
2 Chronicles 9:6 But I beleued not the wordes of them, vntyll I came & myne eyes had sene it. And se, the one halfe of thy wysdome was not tolde me: thou exceadest the fame that I heard,
2 Chronicles 9:7 happye are thy men, & happye are these thy seruauntes which stande before the all waye and heare thy wysdome.
2 Chronicles 9:8 Blessed be the Lorde thy God whiche had luste to the, to make the kyng on hys seat, vnto the Lorde thy God. Because thy God loued Israel, to make them contynue euer, therfore made he the kynge ouer them to do ryght and equyte.
2 Chronicles 9:9 And she gaue the kyng an hundred & .xx. talentes of goulde, and of swete odoures excedynge great aboundaunce wyth preciouse stones, that there was no suche swete odoures as the quene of Saba gaue kynge Salomon.
2 Chronicles 9:10 And therto the seruauntes of Hyram and the seruauntes of Salomon which brought gould from Ophir, broughte also Algume woode and precyouse stones.
2 Chronicles 9:11 And the kynge made of the Algume wood steyares in the house of the Lorde and in the kynges palace, and harpes & psalteryes for syngers. And there was no suche woode sene before in the lande of Iuda.
2 Chronicles 9:12 And Kynge Salomon gaue to the quene of Saba all her desyre that she asked aboue that she brought vnto the kyng. And so she turned and went awaye to her owne lande wyth her seruauntes.
2 Chronicles 9:13 The summe of goulde that came to Salomon in one yeare, was syxe hundred .lxvi. talentes of goulde,
2 Chronicles 9:14 besydes that whiche chapmen and marchauntes brought, and all the kynges of Arabia and dukes of countreyes broughte goulde & syluer to Salomon.
2 Chronicles 9:15 And kynge Salomon made two hundred bokelars of gould .vi. hundred sicles of Beten gould to be a bokelar:
2 Chronicles 9:16 & thre hundred shyldes of Beten goulde, thre hundred sicles of goulde to a shylde, & he put them in the house of the forest of Lybanon.
2 Chronicles 9:17 And the king made a great seate of Iuorie and ouerlayde it with pure goulde.
2 Chronicles 9:18 And there were sixe steppes to the seate with a fote stole of goulde fastened to the seate: & pomelles on eche syde of the sittyng place,
2 Chronicles 9:19 & two lyons standynge by the pomelles. And .xij. lyons stode on the one syde & on the other vpon sixe steppes, that there was no such in any kyngdomm.
2 Chronicles 9:20 And all the drynckynge vesselles of kynge Salomon were gould, & al the vesselles of the house of the forest of Libanon, were pure gould And as for syluer, it was counted nothynge worthe in the dayes of Salomon.
2 Chronicles 9:21 For the kynges shyppes wente to Tharsis with the seruauntes of Hiram euery thre yeare once. And the shyppes of Tharsis brought gould, siluer the tethe of elephantes, apes, and pecockes.
2 Chronicles 9:22 And kynge Salomon passed all the kinges of the earth in rychesse and wysdome.
2 Chronicles 9:23 And al the kynges of the earth sought the presence of Salomon, to heare the wysdome that GOD had put in hys herte.
2 Chronicles 9:24 And they brought euery man his present in vesselles of syluer and vesselles of goulde, and rayment, harnesse, swete odoures, horses and mules yeare by yeare.
2 Chronicles 9:25 And Salomon had foure thousand maungers of horsses and charettes for them, and twelue thousande horsmen. And he bestowed them in the charet cityes & with the king at Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 9:26 And he raigned ouer all the kinges from Euphrates vnto the lande of the Philistines & so to the borders of Egypte.
2 Chronicles 9:27 And the kyng made syluer in Ierusalem as plenteous as stones, and Cedar trees as plenteous as the mulbery trees that growe in the valeys.
2 Chronicles 9:28 And Salomon had horses brought hym oute of Egypte and out of all landes.
2 Chronicles 9:29 And the rest of the actes of kyng Salomon both fyrste and last are wryten in the boke of Nathan the Prophete and in the prophesie of Ahiah the Silonite and in the vysyons of Iadi the sear of visyons agaynst Ieroboam the sonne of Nabat.
2 Chronicles 9:30 And when Salomon had raigned in Ierusalem vpon all Israel fourty yeares,
2 Chronicles 9:31 he layed hym to reste wyth his fathers, and was buryed in the cytie of Dauid hys father, and Rehoboam hys sonne raigned in hys steade.

CHAPTER: 10

2 Chronicles 10:1 And Rehoboam went to Sichem: for to Sichem were all Israell come to make him kinge.
2 Chronicles 10:2 And when Ieroboam the sonne of Nabat, beynge in Egypte heard it (for he was fled for fear of Salomon the king) he returned out of Egypt.
2 Chronicles 10:3 And they sent and called hym. And so Ieroboam and al Israel came and communed wyth Rehoboam, and sayde.
2 Chronicles 10:4 Thy father made vs a greuouse youck: but remytte thou somewhat of the greuouse seruyce of thy father and of hys heuy youcke that he put vpon vs, and we wyll serue the.
2 Chronicles 10:5 And he sayde to them: come agayne after thre dayes to me. And the people departed.
2 Chronicles 10:6 And Kynge Rehoboam counceled with the elders that stode before Salomon his father whyle he lyued, & sayde: what councell geue ye me, to answere thys people agayne?
2 Chronicles 10:7 And they tolde hym, saying: If thou shalt be kynd to thys people, & please them, and shalt speake louynge wordes to them, they wyl be thy seruauntes for euer.
2 Chronicles 10:8 But he lefte the councell whiche the elders gaue hym, & toke councell wyth the young men that were noursed vp wt hym, & had stande in hys presence,
2 Chronicles 10:9 and said to them: what aduise geue ye that I may answer thys people which haue communed with me, sayinge: Abate somewhat of the youck which thy father dyd put vpon vs.
2 Chronicles 10:10 And the young men that were nourced vp wyth hym talked wyth hym saying: thus answere the people that spake to the saying. Thy father made oure youcke heauye: But make thou oure youcke somewhat lyghter. Thus wyse aunswere them: my lytle fynger shalbe heuyer then my fathers loynes.
2 Chronicles 10:11 For where my father put a heauye youcke vpon you. I wyl put more therto, & where my father chastised you with whyppes, I wyl chastyse you with scorpyons.
2 Chronicles 10:12 And when Ieroboam and all Israel were come the thyrd day, as the king bade, saying: come agayne to me the thyrd daye.
2 Chronicles 10:13 The king answered them cruellye, for kinge Rehoboam lefte the councell of the aged men,
2 Chronicles 10:14 & answered them after the aduise of the young men saying: If my father made youre youcke greuouse, I wyll adde therto, and where my father chastised you wyth whippes, I will chastyse you with scorpions.
2 Chronicles 10:15 And so the kynge herkened not vnto the people, for the turnynge awaye was of God, that the Lord might make good hys sayinge whiche he spake by the hande of Ahiah the Silonite to Ieroboam the sonne of Nabat.
2 Chronicles 10:16 And when all Israell sawe that the kinge wolde not heare them, the people aunswered the king, sayinge: what parte haue we wyth Dauid or enheritaunce wt the sonne of Isai? let euerye man of Israel go to hys tent. And nowe Dauid se to thyne owne house. And therevpon all Israel get them to theyr tentes,
2 Chronicles 10:17 so that Rehoboam raygned ouer no moo of the children of Israell then dwelte in the cytyes of Iuda.
2 Chronicles 10:18 Then Kyuge Rehoboam sente to them Haduram that was ouer the trybute, and the chyldren of Israell stoned hym with stones that he dyed. But kinge Rehoboam made spede, and gat hym vp to hys charet to flye to Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 10:19 And so Israell departed from the house of Dauid vnto this daye.

CHAPTER: 11

2 Chronicles 11:1 And when Rehoboam was come to Ierusalem, he gathered of the house of Dauid & Beniamin to the nombre of nine skore thousande choise men of warre to fyght wyth Israel, for to brynge the kyngdome agayne to Rehoboam.
2 Chronicles 11:2 But the worde of the Lorde came to Semeiah the man of God sayinge:
2 Chronicles 11:3 speake vnto Rehoboam the sonne of Salomon kynge of Iuda & to all Israell that are in Iuda, and to Beniamin, and saye:
2 Chronicles 11:4 thus sayth the Lorde. Go not nor fyght with your brethren: But returne euery man to his house, for thys thynge is done of me. And they obeyed the wordes of the Lord and returned from goynge agaynst Ieroboam.
2 Chronicles 11:5 And Rehoboam dwelte in Ierusalem, and buylt stronge cyties in Iuda:
2 Chronicles 11:6 as Bethlehem, Etam & Thekua:
2 Chronicles 11:7 Bethzur, Socho & Odollam:
2 Chronicles 11:8 Geth, Maresah & Ziph:
2 Chronicles 11:9 Adurahim, Lachis and Asecah:
2 Chronicles 11:10 Yarah Aialon & Hebron. Which were the stronge cytyes of Iuda and Beniamin.
2 Chronicles 11:11 And when he had repayred suche strong cytyes, he put capytaynes in them and store of vitayle, and of oyle and of wyne.
2 Chronicles 11:12 And he ordened in all cytyes shyldes & speares, & made them exceadyng stronge. And so Iuda and Beniamin were vnder hym.
2 Chronicles 11:13 And the priestes & the Leuytes that were in all Israell resorted to hym, oute of all theyr coastes.
2 Chronicles 11:14 In so much that the Leuites left theyr Suburbes & possessyons, and came to Iuda & Ierusalem: for Ieroboam and his sonnes had cast them oute from mynystrynge vnto the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 11:15 And he ordeyned hym priestes of hyl aulters bothe to felde deuylles and also to the calues which he had made.
2 Chronicles 11:16 And after them ther came of all the trybes of Israel (such as theyr hertes moued them to seke the Lorde God of Israel) to Ierusalem to offer vnto the Lorde God of theyr fathers.
2 Chronicles 11:17 And so they strengthed the kyngedome of Iuda, & made Rehoboam the sonne of Salomon myghty thre yeare long for thre yeare they walked in the way of Dauid and Salomon.
2 Chronicles 11:18 And Rehoboam toke hym Mahalath the doughter of Ierimoth the sonne of Dauid to wyfe, and Abihail the doughter of Eliab the sonne of Isai,
2 Chronicles 11:19 which bare hym chyldren: Ieus, Samariah, and Zaham.
2 Chronicles 11:20 And after her he toke Maacah the doughter of Absalom which bare hym Abiah, Etha, Ziza and Salumith.
2 Chronicles 11:21 But Rehoboam loued Maacah the doughter of Absalom aboue all hys other wyues and concubines for he toke .xviij. wyues & thre skore concubynes, and begat thre skore doughters, and .xxviij. sonnes
2 Chronicles 11:22 And Rehoboam made Abiah the sonne of Maacah the chefe ruler amonge hys brethren, for to make hym kynge.
2 Chronicles 11:23 And he played wysely & skatered of al hys children thorow out all the countreyes of Iuda & Beniamin in euerye strong cyty. And he gaue them aboundaunce of vytayle, and asked manye wyues.

CHAPTER: 12

2 Chronicles 12:1 And when Rehoboam had stablyshed the kingdome, & made it stronge he forsoke the law of the Lorde, & all Israell wyth hym,
2 Chronicles 12:2 wherfore the fyft yeare of kynge Rehoboam, Sesac the kynge of Egypte came vp agaynste Ierusalem, because they had transgressed agaynst the Lord,
2 Chronicles 12:3 with twelue hundred charettes and thre skore thousande horsmen. And the people were wythout nombre that came wyth him oute of Egypte, with them of Lybia, and the Succhites and the blackemores.
2 Chronicles 12:4 And they toke the stronge cytyes that were in Iuda, and came to Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 12:5 Then came Semeiah the Prophete to Rehoboam & to the Lordes of Iuda that were gathered to Ierusalem for feare of Sesac, & saide to them: thus sayth the Lorde: ye haue left me, & therfore wyll I leue you also in the handes of Sesac.
2 Chronicles 12:6 Wherevpon the Lordes of Israel & the kyng humbled them selues and sayde: the Lorde is ryghteous.
2 Chronicles 12:7 And when the Lord saw that they submytted themselues, the worde of the Lorde came to Semeiah, sayinge: they meke them selues, and therfor I wyl not destroy them. But I wyll delyuer them somewhat, & my wrath shall not falle vpon Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 12:8 Neuerthelater they shalbe hys seruauntes, to know what dyfference is betwene my seruice and the seruyce of the kyngedomes of other landes.
2 Chronicles 12:9 And Sesac kynge of Egypte came to Ierusalem, and toke awaye the treasures of the house of the Lorde, and the treasures of the kynges house, & shortlye he toke all. And he toke also the shyldes of goulde whiche Salomon made.
2 Chronicles 12:10 In steade of whiche kynge Rehoboam made shyldes of brasse, & put them in the kepyng of the capytaynes of hys garde whiche wayted in the gate of the kynges house.
2 Chronicles 12:11 And as ofte as the kynge wente to the house of the Lorde, the garde wente, and fet them, & brought them agayne vnto the garde chambre.
2 Chronicles 12:12 And so because he humbled hym self, the wrath of the Lorde turned from hym, & destroyed not al together. And therto there were manye good thynges yet in Iuda.
2 Chronicles 12:13 And kinge Rehoboam waxed myghtye in Ierusalem, and raygned. And Rehoboam was .xli. yeare olde when he was made kynge, and he raygned .xvij. yeares in Ierusalem the citie which the Lorde had chosen out of all the trybes of Israell to put hys name there. And his mothers name was Naamah an Ammonite.
2 Chronicles 12:14 And he dyd euyll: for he prepared not hys herte to seke the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 12:15 The actes of Rehoboam fyrst and last are written in the sayinges of Semeiah the Prophete, & of Ado the sear of vysyons, so muche as hys genealogye, and the perpetuall warre that was betwene Rehoboam & Ieroboam during theyr lyfe.
2 Chronicles 12:16 And Rehoboam layd him to slepe wt his fathers, & was buried in the citie of Dauid and Abiah hys sonne raygned in hys steade.

CHAPTER: 13

2 Chronicles 13:1 The .xviij. yeare of king Ieroboam began Abiah to raygne ouer Iuda,
2 Chronicles 13:2 & he raygned thre yeare in Ierusalem. His mothers name was Michaiah the doughter of Vriel of Gabaah. And there was warre betwene Abiah and Ieroboam.
2 Chronicles 13:3 And Abiah made a battel with an hoste of fyghtynge men of foure hundred thousande chosen men. And Ieroboam put in araye to fight agaynst hym, with .viij. hundred thousande pycte men and stronge.
2 Chronicles 13:4 And Abiah stode vp vpon Zemaraim an hyl in mount Ephraim, & sayd: heare me thou Ieroboam & all Israel.
2 Chronicles 13:5 Becometh it not you to knowe how that the Lorde God of Israell gaue the kyngedome of Israel to Dauid for euer, euen to him & to his sonnes, with a salted couenaunte.
2 Chronicles 13:6 But Ieroboam the sonne of Nabat the seruaunt of Salomon the sonne of Dauid, rebelled agaynste the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 13:7 And there gathered to hym lewde men and vnthryftes, and preuayled agaynste Rehoboam the sonne of Salomon: for Rehoboam was young & tender hearted, and not stronge ynough for them.
2 Chronicles 13:8 And now ye thinke to preuayle against the kyngedome of the Lorde in the hande of the sonnes of Dauid, because ye be a great multytude & haue with you the golden calues which Ieroboam made you for Gods.
2 Chronicles 13:9 And haue ye not caste out the priestes of the Lord the sonnes of Aaron, & the Leuites, & haue made you priestes lyke the nacyons of other landes: euen whosoeuer cometh, and fylleth his hand with an oxe & seuen rammes, the same is made priest to them that are no Goddes.
2 Chronicles 13:10 But with vs is the Lorde oure God whome we haue not forsaken, and the priestes of the sonnes of Aaron mynistring vnto the Lorde, & the Leuites in office,
2 Chronicles 13:11 burnyng vnto the Lorde euery morninge & euery euen burntofferinges & swete cense: & the shewbread put in ordre vpon a pure table: & the candelsticke of goulde with the lampes of the same, to be light euery euen. For we kepe the watche of the Lord oure God: but ye haue forsaken him.
2 Chronicles 13:12 Moreouer se, God is with vs in the forewarde, and his priestes, and the rorynge trompettes to crye alarum agaynst you. Ye chyldren of Israell fight not with the Lorde God of youre fathers: for it wyll not prospere wyth you.
2 Chronicles 13:13 But for all that Ieroboam sent men pryuelye aboute to come behynd vpon them: and so they were before Iuda, & the layers in wayte were behynd them.
2 Chronicles 13:14 And when Iuda turned and saw the battel behynde and before, they cryed vnto the Lorde, & the priestes blew the trompettes
2 Chronicles 13:15 & the men of Iuda gaue a shoute. And as the men of Iuda shouted, God smote Ieroboam & all Israel before Abiah and Iuda.
2 Chronicles 13:16 And the chyldren of Israel fled before Iuda, & the Lorde delyuered them into the handes of Iuda.
2 Chronicles 13:17 And Abiah and hys people slue a greate slaughter of them, so that there were strycken doune deade of Israel fiue hundred thousand chosen men.
2 Chronicles 13:18 And so the chyldren of Israel were brought vnder at that tyme, and the children of Iuda preuayled: because they leaned vnto the Lord God of their fathers.
2 Chronicles 13:19 And Abiah folowed after Ieroboam & wanne certayne cities from him. Bethel with the townes belongynge therto, and Iesanah wyth the townes that longed therto, and Ephron with her townes.
2 Chronicles 13:20 And Ieroboam recouered not strength agayne in the dayes of Abiah. And at the last the Lord plaged him, that he dyed.
2 Chronicles 13:21 And Abiah waxed myghty, and toke hym .xiiij. wyues, and begat .xxij. sonnes, and .xvi. doughters.
2 Chronicles 13:22 The rest of the actes of Abiah and his wayes and his doynges are wrytten in the storye of the Prophete Ado.

CHAPTER: 14

2 Chronicles 14:1 And when Abiah was layd to slepe wyth his fathers, they buryed hym in the citie of Dauid, and Asa his sonne raygned in his steade. In whose dayes the lande was quyet ten yeare.
2 Chronicles 14:2 And Asa did that was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God,
2 Chronicles 14:3 & toke away the aulters of straungers and the hylaulters, & brake the ymages & cut doune the groues,
2 Chronicles 14:4 and commaunded Iuda to seke the Lorde God of their fathers, & to do accordyng to the lawe and commaundement.
2 Chronicles 14:5 And he put away oute of all the cyties of Iuda, the hylaulters and the ydolles: for the kyngedom was quiet before hym.
2 Chronicles 14:6 And he buylt stronge cytyes in Iuda: because the lande was in rest, and he had no warre in those yeares. For the Lorde had geuen him reste.
2 Chronicles 14:7 And therfore he sayde to Iuda: let vs build these cyties, and compase them wyth walles and toures, gates, and barres, while we haue the lande quiet. For we haue sought the Lord oure God: & because we haue sought hym, he hath geuen vs reste on euery syde. And so they buylt and prospered.
2 Chronicles 14:8 And Asa had an Army that bare shylde and speare, out of Iuda thre hundred thousand, and out of Beniamin that bare shilde and drewe bowes two hundred and .lxxx. thousande, and were all stronge men.
2 Chronicles 14:9 And there came oute agaynst them Zarah the Morian wyth an Hoste of ten hundred thousande, and thre hundred charettes, and came as ferre of Maresa.
2 Chronicles 14:10 And Asa went out to him. And they put in araye to battel in the valeye of Zephatah beside Maresa.
2 Chronicles 14:11 And Asa cryed vnto the Lorde his God and sayd: lord it is all one wyth the to helpe them that haue no power, with few or with many: helpe vs O Lorde oure God, for we truste to the, & in thine name be come agaynst thys multitude. Thou arte the Lorde oure God, let not man preuayle agaynst the.
2 Chronicles 14:12 And the Lord smote the blacke Mores before Asa & Iuda, that they fled.
2 Chronicles 14:13 And Asa & the people that was with hym, folowed after them as ferre as Gerar. And the blacke Mores were ouerthrowen, that there bode none alyue of them, but were destroyed of the lord, and of the Hoste. And they caryed awaye a myghty greate pray.
2 Chronicles 14:14 And they smote all the cities rounde aboute Gerar. For the feare of the Lorde came vpon them. And they robbed all the cities, for there was exceadyng muche to be robbed in them.
2 Chronicles 14:15 And therto they smote the tentes of cattel, and caryed awayed plentye of shepe and camelles, and returned to Ierusalem.

CHAPTER: 15

2 Chronicles 15:1 And the spyryt of God came on Azariah the sonne of Obed.
2 Chronicles 15:2 And he went oute agaynste Asa, and sayd to hym: heare me Asa and al Iuda and Beniamin. The Lorde is wyth you, while ye be wyth hym, and yf ye shall seke hym, he wylbe founde of you: but and yf ye shal forsake him, he wil forsake you.
2 Chronicles 15:3 There wil come many daies in Israel, in whiche there shalbe no true God nor prieste that teacheth, nor any law.
2 Chronicles 15:4 And in their tribulacion they shal turne vnto the Lorde God of Israel and shall seke him, and he shalbe founde of them.
2 Chronicles 15:5 And in those daies there shalbe no peace to them that go out & in. But greate vexacyon vpon the enhabiters of all landes.
2 Chronicles 15:6 For one nacion shal destroye another, and one cytye another: for God wyl trounce them wyth aduersyte.
2 Chronicles 15:7 But plucke you vp your hertes, and let not your handes faynte, for youre workes shalbe rewarded.
2 Chronicles 15:8 When Asa hearde those wordes and the prophesye of Azariah the sonne of Obed the Prophete, he toke courage, and put away the abhomynacions oute of al the lande of Iuda and Beniamin, and oute of the cytyes which he wanne in mount Ephraim, and renued the aulter of the Lord that was before the porche of the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 15:9 And he gathered al Iuda & Beniamin, and the straungers wyth them oute of Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon. For there fel many to him out of Israel, when they sawe that God was with him.
2 Chronicles 15:10 And they assembled at Ierusalem in the thirde monethe of the fyftene yeare of the raygne of Asa.
2 Chronicles 15:11 And they offered vnto the Lord that same time of the spoyle whych they had brought .vij. hundred oxen and .vij. thousand shepe.
2 Chronicles 15:12 And they made a couenaunt to seke the Lorde God of their fathers, wyth all their hertes, & all their soules:
2 Chronicles 15:13 so that al that sought not the Lorde God of Israel, shoulde dye for it, whether he were small or great, man or woman.
2 Chronicles 15:14 And they sware vnto the Lorde wt a loude voyce and showtynge and wyth trompettes and hornes.
2 Chronicles 15:15 And all Iuda reioysed in the othe, for they hath sworne wyth all their hertes, and sought him with al their luste, & he was founde of them. And the Lorde gaue them reste rounde aboute.
2 Chronicles 15:16 And therto kynge Asa put Maacah hys mother out of auctorite, because she had made an ydole in a groue: & brake doune her ydole, & stampte it and burnt it by the broke Cedron.
2 Chronicles 15:17 But they put not the hilaulters out of Israel: neuerthelesse the herte of Asa was pure in all his lyfe.
2 Chronicles 15:18 And he brought into the house of God the dedicat gyftes whyche he and hys father had dedicate, in goulde, syluer & other Iewelles.
2 Chronicles 15:19 And there was no more warre vnto the .xxxv. yeare of the raygne of Asa.

CHAPTER: 16

2 Chronicles 16:1 In the .xxxvi. yeare of the raygne of Asa, came Baasa kyng of Israel agaynst Iuda and built Rumah, to the entent that he woulde let uone that pertayneth to Asa kynge of Iuda haue passage in and oute.
2 Chronicles 16:2 Whervpon Asa fet oute syluer and goulde oute of the treasures of the house of the Lorde, and of the kynges house, & sent it to Benhadad kynge of Siria that dwelt at Damasco, and sayde.
2 Chronicles 16:3 There is a confederacion betwene me and the, and so was betwene my father & thine, wherfore I haue sent the siluer and goulde, that thou go and breake thyne appoyntment wyth Baasa kynge of Israel, that he maye departe from me.
2 Chronicles 16:4 And Benhadad graunted vnto kyng Asa, and sent the captaynes of hys armye agaynste the cities of Israell. And they bet Aion, Dan, Abelmaim and all the store cities of Nephtali.
2 Chronicles 16:5 And when Baasa hearde that, he left buyldinge of Ramah & let his worcke cease.
2 Chronicles 16:6 And then Asa the kinge toke all Iuda, and caryed away and stones & tymbre of Ramah, wherwhyth Baasa was a buyldynge: and he buylt therwyth Gabaa and Marphah.
2 Chronicles 16:7 At that same tyme Hanani the sear, came to Asa kyng of Iuda & sayde to hym: because thou trustest in the king of Siria, and trustest not in the Lorde thy God therfore is the host of the kynge of Siria escaped oute of thyne hande.
2 Chronicles 16:8 Were not the blacke Mores, and they of Libya a great host wyth exceading many charettes and horsemen? And yet because thou trustedest in the Lorde, he delyuered them into thyne handes.
2 Chronicles 16:9 For the eyes of the Lorde beholde all the earthe, to strength the hertes of them that are hole with him. Herin thou hast done folyshly, and therfore from henceforth thou shalt haue warre.
2 Chronicles 16:10 Whervpon Asa was wrothe with the sear and put hym in the conuertynge house, for he was dyspleased wyth him because of that. Moreouer Aza oppressed certayne of the people the same ceason.
2 Chronicles 16:11 The dedes of Aza bothe fyrst and last, are written in the boke of the kynges of Iuda & Israel.
2 Chronicles 16:12 And the .xxxix. yeare of his raigne Asa fel sycke on hys fete, and that his disease exceaded. And therto in his sycknesse he asked no counsel of the Lorde, but of Physycyons.
2 Chronicles 16:13 And at the last Asa fel on slepe wyth hys fathers, and dyed when he raygned .xli. yeare.
2 Chronicles 16:14 And they buryed hym in his owne sepulchre whiche he had made in the citie of Dauid, and layde hym in the bedde whyche he had filled with swete odoures of dyuerse kyndes, made by the crafte of the potecaryes. And they dyd exceadynge greate coste aboute buryeng of hym.

CHAPTER: 17

2 Chronicles 17:1 And Iehosaphat his sonne raigned in his stead, and was mightyer then Israel.
2 Chronicles 17:2 And he put souldioures in all the stronge cities of Iuda, and set rulers bothe in the lande of Iuda, and also in the cytyes of Ephraim, whyche Asa his father had wonne.
2 Chronicles 17:3 And the Lorde was wyth Iehosaphat, because he walked in the olde wayes of his father Dauid, & sought not Baals,
2 Chronicles 17:4 but sought the Lorde God of his father, and walked in hys commaundementes, and not after doynges of Israel.
2 Chronicles 17:5 Therfore the Lorde stablyshed the kyngedome in his hande, and all Iuda brought him presentes, that he became exceadinge ryche and gloriouse.
2 Chronicles 17:6 And his herte was corageous in the wayes of the Lorde, & he put doune yet more of the hilalaulters and groued out of Iuda.
2 Chronicles 17:7 And the thirde yeare of hys raigne he sent of his Lordes: Benhail, Abdiah, Zachariah, Nathanael and Michaah to teache in the cyties of Iuda:
2 Chronicles 17:8 and with them, Semeiah, Nathaniah, Zabadiah, Asahel. Semiramoth, Iehonathan, Adoniah, Thobiah, and Thobodoniah Leuites: and with them Elisama & Ioram priestes.
2 Chronicles 17:9 And they taught in Iuda, and had the boke of the law with them, & went aboute thorowout all the cytyes of Iuda and taught the people.
2 Chronicles 17:10 And the feare of the Lorde fel vpon al the kyngedomes of the landes that were rounde aboute Iuda, that they durst not warre with Iehosaphat.
2 Chronicles 17:11 And the Philistines brought Iehosaphat gyftes and tribute siluer. And therto the Arabians brought hym of shepe, seuen thousand and seuen hundred rammes, & seuen thousande & seuen hundred he gottes.
2 Chronicles 17:12 And so Iehosaphat he prospered and grue vpon hye. And he buylt in Iuda, castels and store cities.
2 Chronicles 17:13 And he had great substaunce in the cyties of Iuda, & fyghtynge men and men of myghte in Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 17:14 And this is the order in the houses of their fathers, of the capitaynes ouer thousandes in Iuda: Ednah the captayne, and with hym of fyghthynge men thre hundred thousande.
2 Chronicles 17:15 And nexte to him Iehohanan a captayne and with him two hundreth & .lxxx. thousand.
2 Chronicles 17:16 And by his side Amaziah the sonne of Zechri willynge vnto the Lord, & with him two hundred thousand myghty men.
2 Chronicles 17:17 And of the children of Beniamin, Eliada was a man of might, and had with hym armed with bowes & shyldes two hundred thousande.
2 Chronicles 17:18 And by his syde Iehosabad wyth whome were an hundred & .lxxx. thousande trimmed for warre.
2 Chronicles 17:19 These waited on the kynge, besydes those whyche the kinge had put in stronge cities thorowout al Iuda.

CHAPTER: 18

2 Chronicles 18:1 And Iehosaphat became verye ryche and gloryouse, and ioyned affinite with Ahab.
2 Chronicles 18:2 And after certayne yeares he went doune to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab slue shepe and oxen plenteously for him & for the people that came wt him, and entreated him to go vp vnto Ramoth in Galaad.
2 Chronicles 18:3 And Ahab kynge of Israel sayde to Iehosaphat kynge of Iuda: wylt thou go wyth me to Ramath in Galaad? And he answered him: I wylbe as thou, and my people shalbe as thyne, and we wylbe with the in the warre.
2 Chronicles 18:4 But Iehosaphat sayde vnto the kynge of Israell: aske I pray the, the worde of the lorde.
2 Chronicles 18:5 And the kynge of Israell gathered together of the Prophetes foure hundred men, & saide vnto them: shal we go to Ramoth in Galaad to fyght, or shall I cease? And they saide: go, the Lord shall delyuer it into the kinges hand.
2 Chronicles 18:6 And Iehosaphat sayde: is there yet here neuer a Prophete more of the Lordes, that we myght aske of hym?
2 Chronicles 18:7 And the kyng of Israell sayde to Iehosaphat: there is yet one, to aske the Lorde by hym: But I hate him, for he neuer prophesyed me good, but alwaye euyll, one Micheah the sonne of Iemla. And Iehosaphat sayde: let not the kynge saye so.
2 Chronicles 18:8 Then the kynge of Israel called one of his chambrelaines and said: fetche hether quickly Micheah the sonne of Iemla.
2 Chronicles 18:9 And the kynge of Israel and Iehosaphat kyng of Iuda sate ether of them on his seate in their apparell, in a thressynge floure besyde the gate of Samaria, and al the Prophetes prophesying before them.
2 Chronicles 18:10 And one Zedekiah the sonne of Chananah made him horne of yron, and said: thus sayth the Lord: with these thou shalt winowe Siria, vntil thou had brought them to nought.
2 Chronicles 18:11 And all the Prophetes prophesyed euen so sayinge: Go vp to Ramoth in Galaad & prospere, for the Lorde shall delyuer it into the hande of the kynge.
2 Chronicles 18:12 And the messenger that went to call Micheah, spake to him sayinge: beholde, the wordes of the Prophetes are pleasaunt to the king with one assent, let thy wordes I pray the, be lyke one of theirs, & speake that which is pleasaunt.
2 Chronicles 18:13 And Micheah sayde: as truly as the Lord lyueth, euen what my God sayeth, that wyl I speake.
2 Chronicles 18:14 And when he was come to the kynge, the kynge saide to him: Micheah, shal we go to Ramoth in Galaad to fyght, or shal I be in reste? And he answered go ye and prospere, for the lord shal deliuer it into your handes.
2 Chronicles 18:15 But the kyng sayd to him: how oftentymes shal I adiure the that thou say nothyng but truthe to me, in the name of the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 18:16 Then he sayd: I se al Israel skatered in the mountaines, as shepe that haue no shepard. And the Lorde sayde: these haue no mayster, let them returne euery man to his house in peace.
2 Chronicles 18:17 Then sayde the kinge of Israel to Iehosaphat: dyd I not tel the, that he would not prophecye good vnto me, but euyll?
2 Chronicles 18:18 And he answered: therfore heare ye the worde of the Lorde. I sawe the Lorde sit vpon this seat, and all the company of heauen stanstynge on his ryght hand & on his lefte.
2 Chronicles 18:19 And the Lorde sayd: who shal deceyue Ahab king of Israel, that he maye go & be ouerthrowen at Ramoth in Galaad. And whyle one sayd thus, & another that,
2 Chronicles 18:20 there came out a spyryte and stode before the Lorde and sayde: I wyll deceyue hym. And the Lord said to him: how?
2 Chronicles 18:21 And he said: I wyll go out & wilbe a lyinge spirite in the mouthes of all his prophetes. And the Lorde sayde: thou shalt deceyue him & shalt preuayle, go out and do euen so.
2 Chronicles 18:22 And now beholde the Lorde hath put a lyinge spyryte in the mouthes of all these thy prophetes & yet the Lorde hath spoken euyl against the.
2 Chronicles 18:23 And Zedekiah the sonne of Chananah, went to & smote Micheah vpon the cheke, & said: by what way went the spirite of the Lord from me, to speake in the?
2 Chronicles 18:24 And Micheah sayd: thou shalt se the daye when thou shalt runne from chambre to chambre, for to hyde thy selfe.
2 Chronicles 18:25 Then sayde the kynge of Israel: take ye Micheah & delyuer hym to Amon the gouerner of the citie, & to Ioas the kynges sonne,
2 Chronicles 18:26 & saye: thus saith the kinge: put this felow in preson, and fede him with bread & water of tribulacion, vntyl I come agayne in peace.
2 Chronicles 18:27 And Micheah said: yf thou come agayn in peace, then hath not the Lord spoken in me. And Micheah said moreouer: herken to ye people euery one of you.
2 Chronicles 18:28 And so the kinge of Israel & Iehosaphat the kyng of Iuda went vp to Ramoth in Galaad.
2 Chronicles 18:29 Then sayd the kinge of Israel to Iehosaphat: chaunge the & get the to battel, but se that thou haue thine owne apparel vpon the. And the king of Israel chaunged hym selfe, & they went to battell.
2 Chronicles 18:30 But the kynge of Siria commaunded the captaines of his charettes sayinge: se that ye fight not against smal or great saue against the kinge of Israel onlye.
2 Chronicles 18:31 And when the captaynes of the charettes sawe Iehosaphat, they had went he had bene the king of Israel, & therfore compased about him, to fyghte. But Iehosaphat cryed out, & the Lord holpe hym, & God tised them away from him.
2 Chronicles 18:32 For when the captaynes of the charettes perceiued that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from him:
2 Chronicles 18:33 & a certayne man drew his bow ignorauntly & smote the kyng of Israel betwene the yointes of his habergin. And he sayde to the charet man: turne thyne hand, and carye me oute of the Hoste, for I am hurte.
2 Chronicles 18:34 And the battel arose that day. How be it, the kynge of Israel continueth standinge in hys charet agaynst the Sirians vntyll euen. And aboute the sonne goynge doune he dyed.

CHAPTER: 19

2 Chronicles 19:1 And Iehosophat kynge of Iuda returned to his house safe and sounde to Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 19:2 And Iehu the sonne of Hanani the sear, wente oute agaynst him and said to king Iehosaphat: oughtest thou to helpe the wicked, & to loue them that hate the Lorde. And thys verely is the wrathe of the Lorde vpon the.
2 Chronicles 19:3 Neuerthelater there are good thinges founde in the, in that thou hast put awaye groues out of the lande & hast prepared thyne herte to seke God.
2 Chronicles 19:4 And as Iehosaphat dwelt at Ierusalem, he went to agayne and went amonge the people from Bersabe to mount Ephraim, & brought them agayne vnto the Lorde God of their fathers.
2 Chronicles 19:5 And he sent iudges in the lande, thorow oute all the stronge cities of Iuda, cytye by cytye
2 Chronicles 19:6 and sayde to the iudges: take hede what ye do for ye be not iudges in the lawe of man, but of God, whyche is wyth you in the wordes of the law.
2 Chronicles 19:7 Wherfore let the feare of the lord be wyth you, and take hede and do it. For there is no vnryghteousnesse in the Lord our God nor regarding of persones, nor taking of rewardes.
2 Chronicles 19:8 Moreouer in Ierusalem dyd Iehosaphat set of the Leuites & of the pryestes and of the auncyent heades of Israel, ouer the customes of the Lorde & causes of stryfe. And then they returned agayn to Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 19:9 And he charged them saying: do euen so in the feare of the lord with truthe and pure herte.
2 Chronicles 19:10 And whatsoeuer come to you of youre brethren that dwell in their cytyes, betwene bloude & bloude, lawe, commaundement, ordinaunces, and customes, so that ye warne them, that they trespace not agaynst the Lorde, leste wrath come vpon you and on youre brethren. Thus do and ye shal not offende.
2 Chronicles 19:11 And se here Amariah the prieste whyche is heade ouer you in all matters of the Lorde, and Zabadiah the sonne of Ismael a ruler in the house of Iuda, he is ouer al causes concernynge the kynge, wyth offycers of the Leuites before you. Take courage to you, and go vpon it, and the Lorde shalbe wyth the good.

CHAPTER: 20

2 Chronicles 20:1 After that came the chyldren of Moab and the chyldren of Ammon and wyth them of the Ammonites agaynst Iehosaphat to battel.
2 Chronicles 20:2 And there came that told Iehosaphat saying: ther cometh a great multitude against the from the other syde the sea oute of Siria. And se they be in Hasason Thamar whyche is Engadi.
2 Chronicles 20:3 And Iehosaphat feared, & let him selfe to seke the Lorde, & proclaymed fastinge thorow out al Iuda.
2 Chronicles 20:4 And Iuda gathered them selues together for to aske counsel of the lord. And therto there came oute of al the cytyes of Iuda to seke the Lord.
2 Chronicles 20:5 And Iehosaphat stode in the congregacion of Iuda and Ierusalem in the house of the Lord before the new court
2 Chronicles 20:6 and sayde: Lorde God of oure fathers, arte not thou God in heauen, & raygnest not thou on all the kyngedomes of the Heathen? And in thyne hande is power and might, that noman can stande before the.
2 Chronicles 20:7 Art not thou oure God whiche diddest cast oute the enhabyters of this lande before thy people Israel, & gauest it to the seade of Abraham thy louer for euer?
2 Chronicles 20:8 And they dwelt therin and haue buylt the a temple therin vnto thy name, and said:
2 Chronicles 20:9 when euyll cometh vpon vs, as the swerde of iudgement, pestilence or hongre: then yf we stande before this house and before the (for thy name is in thys house) and shall crye vnto the in oure trybulacyon, thou shalt heare and helpe.
2 Chronicles 20:10 And now beholde, the children of Ammon & Moab & mount Seir, by whiche thou wouldest not let Israel go, when they came out of Egypte: but they departed from them & destroyed them not.
2 Chronicles 20:11 And se, how they reward vs, to come for to cast vs oute of thy possession whyche thou hast possessed vs with al.
2 Chronicles 20:12 O oure God, wylt thou not iudge them? for we haue no myght agaynst this great company that cometh against vs. Neyther wote we what to do: but oure eyes be vnto the.
2 Chronicles 20:13 And as all Iuda stode before the lorde wt their younge ones, their wyues and their children,
2 Chronicles 20:14 the spyryte of the Lorde came vpon Iahaziel the sonne of Zachariah the sonne of Banaiah the sonne of Ieiel the sonne of Mathaniah a Leuite of the sonnes of Asaph, euen as he was in the myddes of the congregacion:
2 Chronicles 20:15 And he sayde: herken all Iuda, and the enhabiters of Ierusalem, and also kynge Iehosaphat. Thus sayth the Lorde vnto you: be not afrayde or faynte herted by reason of thys great multitude. For the warre is not youres, but Goddes.
2 Chronicles 20:16 And to morow ye shall go doune to them: se, they come vp at Ziz, & ye shall mete them in the flagges of the broke before the wyldernesse of Ieruel.
2 Chronicles 20:17 Moreouer it belongeth not to you for to fight in this quarell: but stepe forth and stande and behold the helpe of the Lorde whiche is wyth you: feare not, nor let youre hartes fayle you, O ye of Iuda and of Ierusalem. To morow go out to them: for the Lorde is with you.
2 Chronicles 20:18 And Iehosaphat bowed hym self with his face to the citie, & al Iuda and the enhabiters of Ierusalem fell before the Lorde, to bowe them selues vnto the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 20:19 And the Leuites and the children of the Cahathites & of the Corathites stode vp, to prayse the Lorde God of Israel with a loud voyce on hye.
2 Chronicles 20:20 And so they arose erlye in the mornyng, and get them out vnto the wyldernesse of Tekua. And as they went out, Iehosaphat stode and sayde: heare me Iuda, and ye enhabyters of Ierusalem. Beleue in the Lorde youre God, and so shall ye continue: and beleue his prophetes & so shall ye prospere.
2 Chronicles 20:21 And he gaue the people counsell, & set the syngers of the Lorde, & them that praysed in holy apparel, to go out before the army and to saye: prayse the Lorde, for hys mercye lasteth euer.
2 Chronicles 20:22 And what tyme they beganne to laude & praise, then the Lord set laiers awaite agaynste the children of Ammon and Moab and mounte Seir, to destroye them vtterly & to wype them out.
2 Chronicles 20:23 And when they had made an ende of the enhabyters of Seir, then they holpe to destroye eche other.
2 Chronicles 20:24 And when Iuda came to Mazphah in the wyldernesse, they loked vnto the multitude. And beholde, they were deade carcases fallen to the earthe, and none escaped.
2 Chronicles 20:25 And Iehosaphat and hys people went to robbe awaye the spoyle of them and founde amonge them aboundaunce of goodes and rayment & of pleasaunt Iewelles, and caught from them more then they coulde carye awaye: so that they were thre dayes in gatherynge of the spoyle, it was so muche.
2 Chronicles 20:26 And the fourth daye they assembled in the valeye of blessynge, for there they blessed the Lord. And therfore they called the name of the sayd place the valeie of blessynge vnto thys daye.
2 Chronicles 20:27 And also the men of Iuda and Ierusalem returned & Iehosaphat amonge the thyckest of them, for to go again to Ierusalem wyth gladnesse: for the Lorde hath made them to reioyse of their enemyes.
2 Chronicles 20:28 And they came to Ierusalem wyth psalteries & harpes and trompettes, euen vnto the house of the Lorde.
2 Chronicles 20:29 And the feare of God fell in the kyngedomes of all landes, when they had hearde, that the Lord fought agaynst the enemyes of Israel.
2 Chronicles 20:30 And so the reaulme of Iehosaphat was in tranquyllytie, for hys God had geuen hym rest on euery syde.
2 Chronicles 20:31 And Iehosaphat raigned vpon Iuda, and was .xxxv. yeare olde when he beganne to raygne, and raygned .xxv. yeare in Ierusalem. And his mothers name was Asuba the doughter of Silhi.
2 Chronicles 20:32 And he walked in the waye of Asa his father & bowed not therfrom, to do that was pleasaunt in the syght of the Lord.
2 Chronicles 20:33 How be it, they put not doune the hilaulters, nether did the people yet prepare their hertes vnto the God of their fathers.
2 Chronicles 20:34 The rest of the actes of Iehosaphat fyrste and laste are written in the worckes of Iehu the sonne of Hanani, which noted them in the boke of the kinges of Israel.
2 Chronicles 20:35 After this, Iehosaphat king of Iuda ioyned hym selfe with Ohoziah kynge of Israel whiche was a wycked doar.
2 Chronicles 20:36 And he coupled hym selfe with him, to make shippes to go to Tharsis. And they made the shippes in Azion Gaber.
2 Chronicles 20:37 And Eliezer the sonne of Dodonah of Maresa prophesyed agaynste Iehosaphat saynge: because thou hast ioyned thy selfe wt Ohoziah, the Lord hath broken thy workes. And the shyppes were broken that they were not able to go to Tharsis.

CHAPTER: 21

2 Chronicles 21:1 Iehosaphat layd him to reste wt hys fathers, and was buryed with his fathers in the cytie of Dauid, and Iehoram his sonne raygned in hys roume:
2 Chronicles 21:2 whiche Iehoram had other brethren, sonnes of Iehosaphat, Asariah, Iehiel, Zachariah, Asariah, Michael and Zephatiah. All these were the sonnes of Iehosaphat kynge of Iuda.
2 Chronicles 21:3 And their father gaue them many great gyftes in syluer, goulde & other preciouse thinges with stronge cytyes in Iuda: but the kingedom he gaue to Iehoram, because he was the eldest.
2 Chronicles 21:4 And when Iehoram was vpon the kingdom of his father & setelde, he slue al his other brethren with the swerde, & dyuerse of the lordes of Israel therto.
2 Chronicles 21:5 Iehoram was .xxxij. yeare olde when he beganne to raygne, & he raigned .viij. yeare in Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 21:6 And he walked in the waies of the kinges of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab (for a doughter of Ahab was his wife) & he wrought euil in the eyes of the Lord.
2 Chronicles 21:7 How be it, the Lord would not destroy the house of Dauid, because of the couenaunt that he had made wt Dauid, & as he promised to geue a light to hym & to hys sonnes for euer.
2 Chronicles 21:8 In hys dayes the Edomites departed from vnder the hand of Iuda & made them a king.
2 Chronicles 21:9 And Iehoram went forth with his Lordes & all his charettes with him, & rose by nyghte & layd on the Edomites. Which compased him in, & the captaynes of his charettes.
2 Chronicles 21:10 And so Edom departed from vnder the hande of Iuda vnto thys day. That same time also dyd Cobnah departe from vnder his power, because he lefte the Lord God of his fathers.
2 Chronicles 21:11 Moreouer he made hilaulters in the mountaynes of Iuda & caused the enhabiters of Ierusalem to commit adultery, & he thrust Iuda out of the waye.
2 Chronicles 21:12 And there came a writting to him from Eliah the prophet of this tenoure. Thus saith the Lord God of Dauid thy father: because thou walkedest not in the wayes of Iehosaphat thy father, and in the waies of Asa king of Iuda,
2 Chronicles 21:13 but walkest in the waies of the kinges of Israel, & hast made Iuda & the dwellers of Ierusalem go a whoringe, like to the whoring of the house of Ahab, & had therto slaine thy brethren that were thy fathers house, which were better then thou.
2 Chronicles 21:14 Therfore behold the lord wil smyte the wyth a mightye plage in thy folke, in thy chyldren, in thy wiues and in thy goodes.
2 Chronicles 21:15 And thou shalt haue muche dysease thorowe infirmitye in thy bowelles, vntil thy bowelles fal out by reason of thy sycknesse, daye by daye.
2 Chronicles 21:16 And the Lorde stered vp agaynst Iehoram the spyryt of the Philistines & the Arabians the border on the blacke Mores.
2 Chronicles 21:17 Which came against Iuda & al to tare the lande, & caryed away al the substaunce that was found in the kinges house, & therto his sonnes & his wiues: so that there was neuer a sonne lefte him saue Iehoa has hys youngest sonne.
2 Chronicles 21:18 And after all that, the Lorde smote him in hys bowelles with an incurable disease.
2 Chronicles 21:19 And in processe of tyme, euen about the ende of two yeare hys guttes fell out by reason of his sycknesse, & so he dyed of euil diseases. But they made him no bonefire lyke the bonefires of his fathers.
2 Chronicles 21:20 When he beganne to raygne, he was .xxxii. yeare old, & raigned in Ierusalem .viij. yeare. And he walked not pleasauntly, & they buryed him in the cyty of Dauid, but not in the sepulchre of the kinges.

CHAPTER: 22

2 Chronicles 22:1 And the enhabiters of Ierusalem made Ohoziah hys youngest sonne kynge in hys steade. For the men of warre that came with the Arabians in the hoste, had slayne all hys elder sonnes. And so Ohoziah the sonne of Iehoram kynge of Iuda was made kynge.
2 Chronicles 22:2 Two & fourtie yeare olde was he when he beganne to raygne, & raygned one year in Ierusalem. His mothers name was Athaliah the doughter of Amri.
2 Chronicles 22:3 And he walked also in the wayes of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counseler for to do euill.
2 Chronicles 22:4 Wherfore he did that displeased the lorde like the house of Ahab for they were his counselers after the death of his father, to his destruccion. And he also walked after their counsel.
2 Chronicles 22:5 And Iehoram sonne of Ahab kynge of Israel went to fyght wt Hazael kynge of Siria at Ramoth in Galaad: & they of Ramoth wounded him.
2 Chronicles 22:6 Wherfore he returned to be healed in Iezrahel of the woundes whiche were geuen him at Ramoth, when he sought wt Hazael king of Siria. And Ohoziah the sonne of Iehoram king of Iuda went doune to se Iehoram the sonne of Ahab at Iezrahel, because he was diseased.
2 Chronicles 22:7 For it was thrust into Ohoziah of God to go to Iehoram, & that when he was come, he should go out wt Iehoram against Iehu the sonne of Namsi, whome the Lorde had annoynted to destroy the house of Ahab.
2 Chronicles 22:8 And as Iehu was executinge iustice vpon the house of Ahab. He founde the Lordes of Iuda, and the sonnes of the brethren of Ohoziah that wayted on Ohoziah, and he slue them.
2 Chronicles 22:9 And he sought Ohoziah, & they caught him where he was hid in Samaria, & brought him to Iehu. And when they had slayne him, they buryed him: because (sayde thy) he was the sonne of Iehosaphat, whyche sought the Lorde with all hys hert. And there was none of the house of Ohoziah, that coulde obtayne to be kyng.
2 Chronicles 22:10 For Athaliah the mother of Ohoziah, when she saw her sonne was deade, arose & spake wt al the seade of the kingedom of the house of Iuda.
2 Chronicles 22:11 But Iehosabeath the doughter of the king toke. Iehoas the sonne of Ohoziah & stale him from among the kinges sonnes that were slayn, & put him & his nource in a sleping chambre. And so Iehosabeath the doughter of kinge Iehoram & wyfe of Iehoiada the pryeste (because she was the sister of Ohoziah) hid him from Athaliah that he slue him not.
2 Chronicles 22:12 And he was wyth them hid in the house of God syxe yeare. And Athaliah raygned ouer the lande.

CHAPTER: 23

2 Chronicles 23:1 And in the seuenth yeare Iehoiada toke hert, & made a bonde wt the capitaynes of hundredes Azariah the sonne of Iehoram, Ismael the sonne of Iohanan, Azariah the sonne of Obed, Maasiah the sonne of Adaiah and Elisaphat the sonne of Zechri.
2 Chronicles 23:2 And they went about in Iuda, and gathered the Leuites of all the cyties out of Iuda & the auncyent heades of Israel, and they came to Ierusalem.
2 Chronicles 23:3 And all the congregacyon made a bonde wyth the kynge in the house of God. And Iehoiada sayde to them: behold, the kinges sonne must raygne ouer the children of Dauid, as the Lorde hath sayde.
2 Chronicles 23:4 This is it therfore that ye shal do. The third parte of you priestes & Leuites whiche come in the Saboth daye, shall kepe the dores
2 Chronicles 23:5 & another third parte shalbe in the kinges house & another thyrd parte shalbe in the gate of the foundacyon, and all the people shalbe in the courtes of the house of the Lorde
